  44 employees.
- Key takeaway: ~128 active Customer Community Plus portal logins (the
  intake's "~135 active portal users") are the workforce; the User table is
  the login/security layer, while the business identity of staff lives on
  Recruiter__c ("Employee").

================================================================================
OBJECT: Lead  (Label: "Lead")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Lead is THE intake object of the whole platform - the standard Salesforce Lead
heavily customized (65 custom fields) to capture three different kinds of
newcomers before they become "real" records:

  a) B2C PROSPECTIVE CANDIDATES - job seekers Techsara wants to sign up for its
     paid career-placement program. This is ~99% of all Lead data. The lead
     carries the sales conversation (rating, plan, pricing, upfront amount)
     until the person pays and is CONVERTED into a candidate Person Account.
  b) B2B WEBSITE CANDIDATES - external candidates who applied to a posted job
     on the Techsara website. A REST endpoint + flow auto-creates these leads
     and immediately auto-creates a Job Submission against the applied Job
     Requirement.
  c) B2B CLIENT LEADS - prospective client/vendor COMPANIES that might send
     Techsara job requirements. The "person" on the lead is the company
     contact; conversion creates a business Account instead of a candidate.

Conversion is the object's whole purpose: the Convert button runs
Lead_Conversion_Flow, which calls the LeadConversionHandler Apex
(@InvocableMethod "Convert Lead") to duplicate-check by email/phone and turn
the lead into a Person Account (candidate) plus Contact and optional
Opportunity. Users are blocked from converting any other way (validation rule).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- STANDARD object with 65 custom fields (90 fields total).
- Has its own owner; org-wide sharing is Public Read/Write/Transfer, so any
  internal user can see and take leads (this is in scope for the role-
  hierarchy/security redesign).
- 3 record types in the source metadata, 5 validation rules, 8 list views,
  4 page layouts (Lead Layout, Lead Layout 2, B2B Client Lead Layout,
  B2B Website Candidate Layout) and 3 Lightning record pages.
- Scale: ~2,823 records in preprod (Aug 2024 - Aug 2026), ~25% converted.
- NOTE ON DRIFT: the live preprod org has a FOURTH active record type
  ("Prospect" - the legacy default holding ~99.6% of records) and is missing
  5 fields that exist in the source metadata (see part 8). The local source
  contains a not-yet-deployed intake redesign - verify with team before
  relying on those pieces in the live org.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES (3 in source, 4 live)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- "B2C Prospective Candidate" (developer name: B2C_Prospective_Candidate) -
  "Used for internally created leads to track potential candidate details."
  The B2C sales path: an internally sourced job seeker being sold the career
  program. Uses the "Prospect" status process (New -> Contacted -> Negotiation
  -> Payment -> Converted, or Junk/Lost). Its validation rule forces the
  Plan / Offer letter amount / Salary % / Upfront amount fields to be filled
  before the status can reach Negotiation, Payment or Converted.
- "B2B Website Candidate Lead" (B2B_Website_Candidate_Lead) - "Create lead for
  external candidate applied from our website." Created automatically by the
  website job-application REST endpoint (only 6 records so far - the pipeline
  is new). Uses the B2B status process (New -> Contacted -> Negotiation ->
  Agreement -> Converted, or Junk/Lost).
- "B2B Client Lead" (B2B_Client_Lead) - "Create direct client company lead or
  vendor partnered lead." A prospective CLIENT COMPANY, not a person seeking a
  job (6 records so far). Exempt from the resume-before-conversion rule, but
  cannot convert until it has at least one Job Requirement AND one Job
  Submission (validation rule).
- LIVE-ORG EXTRA: "Prospect" - an older, still-active record type not present
  in the source snapshot. It holds 2,811 of 2,823 live records (~99.6%) - the
  entire historical B2C book. B2C_Prospective_Candidate (0 records yet)
  appears to be its designed replacement. Treat "Prospect" and "B2C
  Prospective Candidate" as the same business flavor when answering questions.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - A LEAD ARRIVES. Three entry paths:
  - B2C: a sales/marketing employee creates the lead manually (sourced from
    purchased lists, referrals, LinkedIn - the top three LeadSource values).
  - Website: a candidate applies on the Techsara website; the
    JobRequirementRestService REST endpoint launches the
    Create_Lead_From_Application flow. It dedupes by email + job (the same
    email applying to the same job is rejected with a 409), creates or reuses
    the Lead, stamps Website_Job_External_ID__c and
    Applied_Job_Requirement__c, attaches the resume file, AUTO-CREATES a Job
    Submission (source "Website Applicant"), starts a Slack thread in
    #b2b-submissions, and emails the Account Manager and the candidate.
  - B2B: a sales employee logs a prospective client company as a B2B Client
    Lead and records the contact person, company details and any requirement
    the client mentioned.

STEP 2 - WORKING THE LEAD (B2C sales conversation). The employee drives the
  standard Status field: New -> Contacted (requires at least one of Email /
  Phone / LinkedIn URL - validation rule) -> Negotiation -> Payment ->
  Converted. During the calls they fill the candidate profile (experience,
  technology, visa, relocation) and the commercial terms (Plan, Offer letter
  amount, Salary %, Upfront amount - all four required before Negotiation).
  Rating (Hot/Warm/Cold) captures how the pricing call went; its help text
  defines Hot as "Call Done, Pricing explained - agreed or open to consider".

STEP 3 - PRE-ENROLMENT FORM (optional, B2C). The "Send Pre-Enrolment Request"
  button (flow send_pre_enrollment_form) generates a tokenized public form
  link (CreateToken Apex), emails it to the candidate, and creates a
  Pre_Enrolment_Request__c child record. The candidate fills the form as a
  guest (Guest_Pre_Enrolment flow - education history, visa, address,
  declarations). The Pre_Enrolment_Requests record-triggered flow then stamps
  the six "Latest Pre-Enrolment" fields on the Lead so the employee can see
  sent/opened/submitted progress without opening the child record.

STEP 4 - RESUME AND INVOICING. The resume must be attached before conversion
  (validation rule, non-B2B-client only); the Attached_Resume_To_Lead screen
  flow sets the Resume_Attached__c flag when a file is uploaded. Billing can
  start at the Lead stage: "Create Invoice" (Create_Invoice_Payment flow)
  creates an Invoice__c under the lead, and "Send Invoice"
  (QB_Send_Invoice_To_QuickBooks flow) pushes it to QuickBooks (creates or
  finds the QB customer, creates the QB invoice, emails it) and stores the QB
  customer id on the lead. Payment_Completed__c records that the candidate
  paid.

STEP 5 - CONVERT. The user clicks Convert / "Convert Lead", which runs
  Lead_Conversion_Flow. The flow calls LeadConversionHandler to:
  - CHECK DUPLICATES: a true duplicate is an existing Person Account with the
    SAME EMAIL OR SAME PHONE (name alone never counts). The user resolves
    matches on screen.
  - CONVERT: the handler sets Flow_Only_Field__c = true (which is what the
    Lead_Conversion_Validation rule checks - any other path to Status
    "Converted" is blocked), reassigns the record to the running user, and
    runs Database.convertLead. Result: a candidate PERSON ACCOUNT (the flow
    copies ~30 fields onto it - contact numbers, visa, niche, relocation,
    declarations, QB customer id...), a Contact, and optionally an
    Opportunity. Education_History__c children are re-parented from the Lead
    to the new candidate. B2B client leads instead produce a business Account
    (or a Contact on an existing client Account - "Create Contact" handler
    modes with duplicate-rule override).
  - The LeadConversionTrigger (before insert/update) always BLANKS the
    standard Company field, so standard conversion cannot silently create a
    business Account named after the company - candidate conversion must
    produce a Person Account.

STEP 6 - AFTER CONVERSION. The candidate life continues on Account
  (onboarding, training, marketing, interviews). Two things still reference
  the old lead: Invoice__c records created at lead stage (the
  Update_Invoice_Records_with_Candidate_Details flow fires when the lead
  converts and relinks its invoices to the new Account), and lookups on
  downstream objects (Interview__c.Lead__c, Job_Submission__c.Lead__c,
  Internal_Interview__c.Lead__c...) that let B2B records be created before a
  lead is converted.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOKUPS FROM LEAD TO OTHER OBJECTS:
- Job_Requirement__c (Applied_Job_Requirement__c): the posted job the website
  candidate applied to. Auto-populated by the website intake flow, which
  matches the Website Job External ID to the requirement.
- Company__c (Company_Name__c): the company the person is associated with,
  from the Company__c master list (rarely used - 11 records).
- Pre_Enrolment_Request__c (Pre_Enrolment_Request__c, label "Current Pre
  Enrolment Request"): the most recent pre-enrolment form request sent to
  this lead. The Latest_Pre_Enrolment_* fields mirror its status.
- Campaign (CampaignId): standard campaign attribution (shown read-only on
  the page; barely used).
- User/Queue (OwnerId): the employee working the lead. Reassigned to the
  converting user by LeadConversionHandler at conversion.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT LEAD (children / references):
- Pre_Enrolment_Request__c (Lead__c): every pre-enrolment form request sent
  to this lead (related list on the page).
- Education_History__c (Lead__c): education rows captured via the guest
  pre-enrolment form; re-parented to the candidate Account at conversion.
- Invoice__c (Lead__c): invoices raised while still a lead (program fees);
  relinked to the Account after conversion by flow.
- Job_Submission__c (Lead__c): B2B submissions made for a not-yet-converted
  website candidate (the website intake flow creates these).
- Job_Requirement__c (Client_Lead__c): job requirements sent in by a B2B
  CLIENT lead before that client company is converted - the basis of the
  Total_Job_Requirements__c counter and the B2B conversion gate.
- Interview__c (Lead__c): external interviews scheduled before conversion
  (either Candidate or Lead is required on an interview).
- Internal_Interview__c (Lead__c): internal screening interviews run against
  the lead (the "Create Interview" button on the Lead page creates THESE, not
  Interview__c records).
- Resume__c (Lead__c): resume records tied to the lead (used by the internal
  interview / resume tooling).
- Session__c (Lead__c): scheduled meetings (Zoom/Calendar) booked with the
  lead.
CONVERSION TARGETS (standard): Account - a Person Account for candidates or a
business Account for B2B clients - plus Contact and optional Opportunity.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules, all active)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Attach_Resume_Before_Conversion: "Please attach the resume before
  converting this Lead." - Status cannot be Converted while Resume_Attached__c
  is false (B2B Client leads are exempt - companies have no resume).
- Background_Required_In_Negotiation: "Fill Out the Background Information
  before moving the status to Negotiation." - on B2C Prospective Candidate
  leads, Plan, Offer letter amount, Salary % and Upfront amount must ALL be
  filled before Status can be Negotiation, Payment or Converted.
- Contact_Details_Requried (note the typo in the API name): "Provide either
  Email or Phone or LinkedIn URL before moving this Lead to Contacted."
- Lead_Conversion_Validation: "Avoid converting lead from here. Use the
  'Convert Lead' button." - Status can only change to Converted when
  Flow_Only_Field__c is true, which only the LeadConversionHandler sets. This
  forces every conversion through the governed flow.
- Prevent_Lead_Conversion: "You can't convert this lead because it doesn't
  have a job requirement or a job submission." - a B2B Client Lead may only
  convert once it has at least one Job Requirement AND one Job Submission
  (checked via the two Flow-maintained counter fields).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
APEX TRIGGER (LeadConversionTrigger, before insert + before update):
- Blanks the standard Company field on every save (except in tests) so the
  standard convert path can never auto-create a business Account named after
  the company. Candidate conversion must yield a Person Account.

APEX INVOCABLE (LeadConversionHandler, called by Lead_Conversion_Flow):
- One @InvocableMethod ("Convert Lead") with modes used by the flow's five
  action calls: Check_Dupe (Person-Account duplicate detection by email OR
  phone), Convert_Lead / Convert_Website_Lead (sets Flow_Only_Field__c,
  reassigns owner, Database.convertLead with duplicate-allow), and
  Create_Contact_Existing_Account / Create_Contact_New_Account (B2B: insert a
  Contact on a client Account with the duplicate-rule "Save Anyway" header).
  Test classes: LeadConversionHandlerTest, LeadConversionTriggerTest.

INBOUND REST (JobRequirementRestService): the website job-application
endpoint creates the resume file and launches Create_Lead_From_Application.

RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOW ON LEAD (active):
- Update_Invoice_Records_with_Candidate_Details (after update; entry on
  Status + ConvertedAccountId): when the lead converts, finds its Invoice__c
  children and relinks/updates them with the new candidate Account.

FLOWS ELSEWHERE THAT WRITE LEAD FIELDS:
- Create_Lead_From_Application (autolaunched, website intake): creates or
  reuses the Lead; writes Applied_Job_Requirement__c,
  Website_Job_External_ID__c, Resume_Attached__c, Processed_for_JS__c,
  Company_Name__c / Company_Email__c; creates the Job Submission; Slack +
  email notifications.
- Pre_Enrolment_Requests (record-triggered on Pre_Enrolment_Request__c
  status change): stamps the six Latest_Pre_Enrolment_* fields on the Lead.
- Update_Lead_JA_Count_On_Create (on Job Submission create) and
  B2B_Jr_update_submission_counts (on Job Submission create/update): recount
  and write Total_Job_Applications__c on the (client) lead.
- Update_Lead_JR_Count_On_Create / Update_Lead_JR_Count_On_Delete (on Job
  Requirement create/update/delete): recount Total_Job_Requirements__c on the
  requirement's Client Lead.
- Attached_Resume_To_Lead (screen flow): sets Resume_Attached__c = true when
  a resume file is uploaded against the lead.
- Lead_Conversion_Flow: updates Status / Flow_Only_Field__c during convert.

SCREEN-FLOW BUTTONS ON THE LEAD PAGES:
- Convert / "Convert Lead": Lead_Conversion_Flow (see above). On all three
  Lightning record pages.
- "Create Interview": Interview_Create_Reschedule_Flow - creates an
  INTERNAL_INTERVIEW__c screening record for the lead (NOT an Interview__c).
- "Create Invoice": Create_Invoice_Payment - creates an Invoice__c under the
  lead.
- "Send Invoice": QB_Send_Invoice_To_QuickBooks - pushes the invoice to
  QuickBooks (create/find customer, create invoice, email it).
- "Send Pre-Enrolment Request": send_pre_enrollment_form - tokenized public
  form link emailed to the candidate + Pre_Enrolment_Request__c created.
- Plus standard quick actions: Send Email, Log a Call, Zoom Phone dialer,
  Chatter posts; a GoogleMaps custom link maps the address.

GUEST-FACING FLOWS: Guest_Pre_Enrolment (the public pre-enrolment form the
candidate fills via the token link) reads the Lead and writes the
Pre_Enrolment_Request__c + Education_History__c records.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 90, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NOTE: 5 fields below exist in the SOURCE METADATA but are NOT yet deployed to
the live preprod org (queries for them fail): Contact_Number_Calling__c,
Conversion_Status__c, Current_State_in_USA__c, Current_Visa_Status__c,
Target_Role_n__c. They are marked "(source only - not in live org yet)".

--- GROUP A: IDENTITY & CONTACT DETAILS ---------------------------------------

Name (Name) [Standard: Salutation + First + Last]
    The person's name (or the contact person's name on a B2B client lead).
    Required. Salutations: Dr. | Mr. | Mrs. | Ms. | Mx. | Prof.

First_Name__c (First Name) [Text]
Last_Name__c (Last Name) [Text]
    Custom copies of the name parts, intended for form/flow use (the guest
    pre-enrolment form writes name parts). NEVER populated in live data (0
    records each) - the standard Name is the real field.

Email (Email) [Standard, Email]
    The person's email - the PRIMARY identity key: duplicate detection at
    conversion and the website intake dedupe both key on it. 97% populated.
    One of Email / Phone / LinkedIn is required at status "Contacted".

Email__c (Email) [Email]
    Custom duplicate of Email. Never used (0 records) - use standard Email.

Phone (Phone) [Standard, Phone]
    Main phone number; the second identity key for duplicate detection at
    conversion. 62% populated.

MobilePhone (Mobile) [Standard, Phone]
    Mobile number (54% populated). Shown in the hover mini-layout.

Contact_Number_WhatsApp__c (Contact Number WhatsApp) [Phone]
    The number the candidate uses on WhatsApp - the sales team often works
    candidates over WhatsApp. Copied to the candidate Account at conversion.
    ~6% populated (newer intake field).

Contact_Number_Calling__c (Contact Number Calling) [Phone]
    (source only - not in live org yet) Companion to the WhatsApp number: the
    number to actually CALL. Mapped to the Account by Lead_Conversion_Flow.

LinkedIn_URL__c (LinkedIn URL) [Url]
    Link to the person's LinkedIn profile (23% populated). Accepted as the
    third alternative contact detail by the "Contacted" validation rule.

Address (Address) [Standard, compound address]
    The person's mailing address (street/city/state/zip). The GoogleMaps
    custom link on the layout maps it.

--- GROUP B: PIPELINE STATE & CLASSIFICATION ----------------------------------

Status (Lead Status) [Standard, Picklist, required]
    THE lifecycle field, driven manually by the employee working the lead.
    Values differ by record type (business process):
    - B2C/Prospect path: New (default) -> Contacted -> Negotiation ->
      Payment -> Converted, or Junk / Lost.
    - B2B path: New -> Contacted -> Negotiation -> Agreement -> Converted,
      or Junk / Lost.
    Guarded by validation rules: contact details required at Contacted;
    commercial fields required at Negotiation+; resume required and the
    Convert button mandatory at Converted. Live spread: New 57%, Converted
    25%, Contacted 12%, Junk 3%, Lost 2%, Negotiation 11, Payment 4 records.

    A CUSTOM shadow status: New | Contacted | Negotiation | Agreement |
    Converted | Lost | Junk | Convert To Candidate Lead. Effectively unused
    (13 records, all "New") - the standard Status is the real field. The
    extra value "Convert To Candidate Lead" hints it was meant to hand a B2B
    website candidate over to the B2C path, but that never went live
    (not fully documented - verify with team).

    Referral | Employee Referral | External Referral | Facebook | Google
    AdWords | Instagram | LinkedIn | Other | Partner | Purchased List |

    expected from the intake flow but the live Website count is only 6).
    Live spread: blank 35%, Purchased List 24%, Customer Referral 23%,
    LinkedIn 14%, everything else marginal.

Rating (Rating) [Standard, Picklist]
    Sales temperature: Hot | Warm | Cold. The org's help text redefines it
    around the PRICING call: Hot = call done, pricing explained, agreed or
    open to consider; Warm/Cold = colder responses. 40% populated and
    dominated by Hot (794 of 1,134).

Rating__c (Rating) [Picklist: 1|2|3|4|5]
    A numeric 1-5 rating that duplicates the standard Rating. Never used
    (0 records).

Lead_Category__c (Lead Category) [Picklist: Candidate | B2B Client]
    Help text: select "Candidate" for job seekers and placement prospects,
    "B2B Client" for companies sending requirements. Redundant with the

    The employee working the lead. LeadConversionHandler reassigns ownership

    apply. Lead ownership is a target of the role-hierarchy redesign

Header_Display__c (Lead - Company) [Formula, Text]

================================================================================
OBJECT: Recruiter__c  (Label: "Employee")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Recruiter__c is Techsara's INTERNAL STAFF REGISTRY. Despite the API name
"Recruiter", its label is "Employee" and it holds EVERY kind of internal
person - recruiters, interview support persons, trainers, senior recruiters,
managers, HR staff. One record = one Techsara employee (current or former).

It exists as a PARALLEL object to the standard Salesforce User because most
staff historically did not have Salesforce logins - work assignment across the
whole org ("who is this candidate's recruiter?", "who supports this
interview?", "who trains this cohort?") points at Recruiter__c records, not at
User. A minority of employee records additionally link to a real User via
Recruiter_User__c (the portal-login population).

The record carries four jobs at once:
  a) Basic HR data: name, email, Slack id, joining/leaving dates, employment
     status, experience level.
  b) The REPORTING LINE: Assigned_Sr_Recruiter__c is a self-lookup to the
     employee's senior. Chained together, these links form the whole company
     org chart - rendered as a tree by the RecruiterHierarchyService /
     RecruiterHierarchyController Apex + LWC, used for Slack escalations, and
     the load-bearing input to the current role-hierarchy security redesign.
  c) The INTERVIEW-SUPPORT CAPABILITY PROFILE read by the external COMPASS AI
     engine: an "active for support" flag, per-skill-track confidence scores,
     daily max hours, buffer minutes, IST workday window and lunch time.
  d) The COMPASS ENGINE'S PER-EMPLOYEE STATE: the engine persists its full
     mathematical state (Kalman filter, momentum, velocity EMAs) per employee
     in COMPASS_State_JSON__c between runs.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, the People/staffing domain's anchor.
- TOP-LEVEL object (no master-detail parent). Records have their own Owner.
- Org-wide default is PUBLIC READ/WRITE - internally AND for external (portal)
  users. Every employee record is editable by anyone with object permissions;
  tightening this is part of the role-hierarchy security redesign.
- Name field is plain TEXT labeled "Employee Name" (not an auto-number). It is
  auto-stamped from First Name + Last Name by a flow at creation.
- 44 custom fields in preprod (47 in source - 3 portal-login "Provisioning"
  fields are built in this repo / piloted in the dev10 sandbox but NOT yet
  deployed to preprod), 0 record types, 1 validation rule, 2 list views
  ("All", "All Active Recruiters"). Field history tracking is enabled.
- Scale: 280 records in preprod (created Aug 2024 to Aug 2026); roughly half
  are former employees kept for history.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All employees share one record type; role distinctions are carried by
fields (Experience_Level__c, Active_For_Interview_Support__c, the reporting
line) rather than record types.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - ONBOARDING A NEW EMPLOYEE. HR/admin creates the record manually (the
  standard New button on the Employee tab/page). They enter First/Last Name,
  Email, Slack User Id, Date of Joining, Experience Level, and - critically -
  "Reporting to" (Assigned_Sr_Recruiter__c), which slots the person into the
  org chart. On save, the Employee_Populate_FullName flow stamps the record
  Name as "First Last".

STEP 2 - OPTIONAL PERSON-ACCOUNT LINK. The "Create Contact" button runs the
  Create_Recruiter_Contact screen flow: it creates a Person Account for the
  employee (copying name, email, Slack id) and writes it back to
  Recruiter_Contact__c (+ the PersonAccount__c text field). This gives the
  employee a presence in the Account-centric side of the org.

STEP 3 - WORK HANGS OFF THE RECORD. Once created, the employee record is what
  everything else assigns work to: candidates get Assigned_Recruiter__c (kept
  in sync from Marketing__c by flow), Marketing engagements and daily
  Application__c logs carry Recruiter__c, interviews carry Recruiter__c and
  Interview_Support_Person__c, internal interviews carry Interviewer__c,
  trainings carry Assigned_Trainer__c, sessions reference Host_User__c and
  additional attendees, resumes record Uploaded_By__c / Approved_By__c.

STEP 4 - THE ORG CHART. The Assigned_Sr_Recruiter__c chain is read by two
  Apex classes behind org-chart LWCs: RecruiterHierarchyService (returns the
  tree of ACTIVE employees only, with cycle/depth guards) and the older
  RecruiterHierarchyController (excludes Former Employees; also exposes
  Experience_Level__c per node). The same chain drives Slack escalation: the
  scheduled AccountSchedulerJob pings a recruiter AND their senior (via both
  employees' Slack ids) when an active candidate has no interviews scheduled.
  The departments/ org-chart diagrams and the role-hierarchy redesign
  (Role_Hierarchy_Blueprint) are built directly from this field.

STEP 5 - INTERVIEW-SUPPORT POOL & COMPASS. Employees who help candidates
  through interviews are flagged Active_For_Interview_Support__c (17 people
  today). The external COMPASS AI engine (AWS Lambda, named-credential
  callouts) picks a support person for each Interview__c from this pool. The
  capability fields (daily max hours, buffer, workday window, lunch) exist as
  engine inputs; after each supported interview the engine updates the
  employee's per-track Confidence_Score_* ratings and re-saves its full state
  into COMPASS_State_JSON__c. (The per-interview before/after audit of those
  updates lives on Interview__c, section 8 group L of that object.)

STEP 6 - LEAVE. The "Create Leave Request" button runs the Request_Leave
  screen flow, which creates an Employee_Leave__c record (full/partial day,
  reason, dates) linked to this employee. A manager approves it via the
  Manager_Decision flow (which resolves the approver through Recruiter_User__c);
  the Tentative_calendar_Event flow auto-creates a tentative calendar Event
  as soon as the leave is logged, and the Leave_Event_Sync flow keeps that
  Event in step with later changes. The leave fields ON the employee record
  itself (On Leave Today, Leave Start/End) predate this and are barely used -
  Employee_Leave__c is the real leave system.

STEP 7 - OFFBOARDING. Employment_Status__c is set to "Former Employee" and
  Last_Working_Date__c recorded. Former employees stay in the database (131
  of 280 records) so historic interviews/candidates keep their references,
  and the hierarchy code simply filters them out.

PLANNED (built in source, not yet in preprod; piloted in the dev10 sandbox):
  an HR portal-login toolkit on this record. "Provision Portal User" and
  "Reset Portal Password" quick actions run the Provision_Employee_Portal_User
  and Reset_Employee_Portal_Password screen flows, and the Employee_Offboarding
  record-triggered flow deactivates the login when Employment_Status__c flips
  to "Former Employee". All three call the PortalUserAdminAction invocable
  Apex, which calls the org's own PortalUserAdminRest endpoint through the
  Admin_Identity named credential so the User create/reset/deactivate runs
  under an admin identity. Outcomes are tracked by the three Provisioning_*
  fields, which the HR_Department permission set grants. Separately, the
  role-hierarchy project plans a flow that auto-assigns permission sets when
  a new Employee record is created (Components_needs/create_list.docs).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT: none - standalone object with its own owner and sharing.

SELF-RELATIONSHIP:
- Recruiter__c (via Assigned_Sr_Recruiter__c, "Reporting to"): the employee's
  senior/manager. This single self-lookup encodes the entire company
  hierarchy (94% populated; the ~17 blanks are the top-level leaders).

LOOKUPS FROM EMPLOYEE TO OTHER OBJECTS:
- User (Recruiter_User__c): the employee's actual Salesforce/portal login,
  when they have one (44 of 280). Used to route approvals and to host
  calendar events/sessions as a real User.
- Account (Recruiter_Contact__c, label "Employee Contact"): the employee's
  own Person Account, created by the Create Contact flow (76% populated).

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT EMPLOYEE (who assigns work to whom):
- Account (Assigned_Recruiter__c): the recruiter responsible for a candidate;
  synced from the Marketing engagement by flow. Basis of candidate ownership
  reporting and the no-interview Slack escalations.
- Marketing__c (Recruiter__c): recruiter running the candidate-marketing
  engagement.
- Application__c (Recruiter__c): recruiter credited with each daily
  application batch (copied from Marketing by the ApplicationRecordCreator
  Apex job).
- Interview__c - THREE lookups: Recruiter__c (handling recruiter),
  Interview_Support_Person__c (the AI-assigned support person),
  Interviewer_Assignment_Constraint__c (a pinned "must use" support person).
  (Quirk: Interview__c's Preferred/Previous Support Person fields point at
  the STANDARD Salesforce "Employee" object, not this custom one - a
  metadata subtlety to remember when reporting.)
- Interview_Participant__c (Employee__c): roster row when an employee joins
  an interview call.
- Internal_Interview__c (Interviewer__c): the employee conducting an internal
  screening interview.
- Candidate_Training__c / CandidateTrainingStep__c (Assigned_Trainer__c): the
  trainer running a candidate's training and its steps.
- Session_Window__c (Trainer__c): a trainer's recurring availability window
  for session scheduling.
- Session__c (Host_User__c, Additional_Attendee_1__c/_2__c): who hosts /
  additionally attends a scheduled meeting.
- Employee_Leave__c (Employee__c, HR_Approver__c): leave requests by, and
  approved by, employees.
- Resume__c (Uploaded_By__c, Approved_By__c): who uploaded/approved a
  candidate resume version.
- AI_Assignment_Logs__c - FIVE lookups (Compass_R_scheduler_run_by__c,
  Manual_Main_AI_Assignment_run_by__c, Main_AI_Assignment_scheduler_run_by_
  old__c, Reassignment_by__c, Last_Support_Person1__c): audit of which
  employee ran/was affected by each COMPASS assignment run.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
One active rule:
- Start_End_Time_Required_If_Tomorrow_Avai: "Start Time IST and End Time IST
  are required when Tomorrow Availability is checked." An employee cannot
  declare themselves available tomorrow without saying which IST hours they
  will cover.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOW (active):
- Employee_Populate_FullName (before save, create): stamps the record Name
  as First_Name__c + " " + Last_Name__c. This is why Name is a text field.

SCREEN FLOWS / BUTTONS ON THE PAGE (quick actions on the Recruiter Layout):
- Create Contact -> Create_Recruiter_Contact flow: creates the employee's
  Person Account and updates Recruiter_Contact__c / PersonAccount__c.
- Create Leave Request -> Request_Leave flow: creates an Employee_Leave__c
  (leave type, full/partial day, dates, reason) for this employee.
- (Pilot, not in preprod) Provision Portal User -> Provision_Employee_Portal_
  User flow: HR requests an AIC Portal login; the flow calls the
  PortalUserAdminAction invocable Apex, which calls the org's own
  PortalUserAdminRest endpoint through the Admin_Identity named credential
  (so the User is created under an admin identity), then stamps
  Provisioning_Status__c = "Provisioned". Companions in the same pilot:
  Reset Portal Password quick action -> Reset_Employee_Portal_Password flow,
  and the Employee_Offboarding record-triggered flow on this object, which
  deactivates the login when Employment_Status__c becomes "Former Employee".

FLOWS THAT READ EMPLOYEE RECORDS (lookups, no writes): the interview-creation
flows (Interview_Creation, Interview_Creation_V2, B2B_Create_Interview_from_
Submission, Interview_Record_Initial_Call_Flow), Interview_Preferred_Support_
Person, Slack_Notification_When_There_is_an_interview (reads Slack_User_Id__c
to @-mention the recruiter), Marketing_Update_Assigned_Recruiter_on_Candidate
(copies the Marketing recruiter onto the candidate Account),
Background_Check_Session_Creation, Extension_Requested_Notify_Trainer,
Manager_Decision and Tentative_calendar_Event (leave approval/calendar),
View_Interview_Log_Flow.

APEX:
- RecruiterHierarchyService / RecruiterHierarchyController: build the org-
  chart tree from Assigned_Sr_Recruiter__c for the hierarchy LWCs (active
  employees only; cycle and depth guarded).
- AccountSchedulerJob (scheduled): Slack-escalates inactive marketing
  candidates to the assigned recruiter AND their senior via the two
  employees' Slack ids.
- ApplicationRecordCreator: copies Marketing__c.Recruiter__c onto each daily
  Application__c record it creates.
- SessionSchedulerController: resolves a training session's host User through
  the trainer's Recruiter_User__c field.

EXTERNAL WRITER: the COMPASS AI engine (AWS Lambda) writes the six
Confidence_Score_* fields, COMPASS_State_JSON__c, COMPASS_State_Last_Saved_
UTC__c and COMPASS_State_Schema_Version__c after each run. No Salesforce code
computes these.

RECORD PAGE: Lightning page "Recruiter Record page" (fields + related lists:
Interviews, Applications, Candidates, Employee Leaves, Internal Interviews).
Note the record page marks Slack_User_Id__c required and Recruiter_Contact__c
read-only.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 47, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: IDENTITY & CONTACT ----------------------------------------------

Name (Employee Name) [Text - standard name field]
    The employee's full name. NOT typed by users: the Employee_Populate_
    FullName flow stamps it from First + Last Name at creation. Every lookup
    to this object displays this value.

First_Name__c (First Name) [Text(20)]
    Given name, entered by HR at creation (100% populated). Source for the
    Name stamp and for the org-chart node labels built by
    RecruiterHierarchyService.

Last_Name__c (Last Name) [Text(20)]
    Family name, entered by HR (99% populated - a few single-name records).
    Second half of the Name stamp.

Email__c (Email) [Email]
    The employee's work email, entered manually (88% populated). Used when
    the employee needs to be reached/invited outside Slack.

Phone_No__c (Phone No) [Text(13)]
    Contact phone number. Barely used in practice (10 of 280 records).

Date_of_Birth__c (Date of Birth) [Date]
    HR birthday field. Effectively unused (1 record).

Description__c (Description) [LongTextArea]
    Free-form notes about the employee (background, remarks). Manual.

Slack_User_Id__c (Slack User Id) [Text(255)]
    The employee's Slack member id (e.g. "U0123ABC") - THE key integration
    field, required on the record page and 94% populated. Every Slack
    notification that @-mentions a person resolves it from here: interview
    reminders to recruiters, the AccountSchedulerJob escalation to recruiter
    + senior, support-request posts. An employee without a Slack id silently
    misses these pings.

--- GROUP B: LINKS TO USER & PERSON ACCOUNT ----------------------------------

Recruiter_User__c (Recruiter User) [Lookup -> User]
    The employee's real Salesforce/portal User login, when they have one
    (44 of 280 - the portal-user population). Read by the Manager_Decision
    leave-approval flow to route to the right approver and by
    SessionSchedulerController to pick the User who hosts a session's
    calendar event. Central to the role-hierarchy redesign, which needs every
    active employee mapped to a portal User.

Recruiter_Contact__c (Employee Contact) [Lookup -> Account]
    The employee's own Person Account, created and linked by the "Create
    Contact" button (Create_Recruiter_Contact flow). Read-only on the record
    page - the flow owns it. 76% populated.

PersonAccount__c (PersonAccount) [Text(50)]
    Text companion to Recruiter_Contact__c, written by the same Create
    Contact flow when it links the Person Account (77% populated). Kept as
    text for lists/automation; not maintained by hand.

--- GROUP C: REPORTING LINE (THE ORG CHART) ----------------------------------

Assigned_Sr_Recruiter__c (Reporting to) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c]
    THE most important field on the object: who this employee reports to.
    Help text: "Enter the name of the Sr Recruiter under whom the application
    recruiter will be working on." Set by HR at creation/re-org. 94%
    populated - the ~17 blank records are the company's top-level leaders
    (roots of the tree). Read by RecruiterHierarchyService/Controller (org-
    chart LWCs), by AccountSchedulerJob (escalate to the senior's Slack), and
    it is the source structure for the departments/ org charts and the whole
    role-hierarchy security redesign. Chains can nest many levels; the Apex
    guards against accidental cycles.

--- GROUP D: EMPLOYMENT / HR LIFECYCLE ---------------------------------------

Employment_Status__c (Employment Status) [Picklist]
    Lifecycle state, maintained by HR: Active Employee (148 records) |
    Former Employee (131) | Leave of Absense (1 - note the org's spelling).
    Drives who appears in the org chart (hierarchy Apex filters on it), who
    counts as assignable staff, and offboarding reporting. Roughly half the
    table is Former - departed staff are kept, not deleted, so history stays
    intact.

Date_of_Joining__c (Date of Joining) [Date]
    Hire date, entered by HR (94% populated). Tenure reporting.

Last_Working_Date__c (Last Working Date) [Date]
    Final employment date, set at offboarding. Only 6 records have it -
    most offboardings just flip the status without recording the date.

Experience_Level__c (Experience Level) [Picklist]
    Overall professional maturity: Fresher level (118) | Beginner Level (88)
    | Mid Level (40) | Senior Level (27). Entered by HR; exposed per node in
    the RecruiterHierarchyController org chart. The dominance of Fresher/
    Beginner reflects the largely junior staff base.

Seniority_Level__c (Seniority Level) [Picklist]
    Junior | Mid | Senior | Lead. NEVER USED in practice (0 populated) -
    Experience_Level__c is the field the team actually fills. Likely added
    for the support/assignment model and not adopted.

Primary_Track__c (Primary Track) [Picklist]
Secondary_Track__c (Secondary Track) [Picklist]
    The employee's main/secondary competency track: Salesforce | Data | QA |
    BA. Both NEVER USED (0 populated). Intended to tag staff by training/
    delivery track; skill data actually lives in the COMPASS confidence
    scores instead.

--- GROUP E: LEAVE & DAY-TO-DAY AVAILABILITY ---------------------------------

On_Leave_Today__c (On Leave Today) [Picklist]
    Half Day | Full Day - a quick "out today" marker on the employee (3
    records). Set manually; the authoritative leave system is the
    Employee_Leave__c child object created via the Create Leave Request
    button, so this field is mostly vestigial.

Leave_Start_Date_Time__c (Leave  Start Date/Time) [DateTime]
Leave_End_Date_Time__c (Leave End Date/Time) [DateTime]
    Old on-record leave window fields. NEVER populated in preprod (0 each) -
    superseded by Employee_Leave__c records.

Tomorrow_Availability__c (Tomorrow Availability) [Checkbox]
    Declares "I am available tomorrow" for interview-support shift planning.
    The object's one validation rule forces Start/End Time IST to be filled
    when this is checked. Currently false on ALL records - the team is not
    using the daily self-declaration loop (assignment relies on the COMPASS
    engine and its own configuration instead).

Start_Time_IST__c (Start Time IST) [Picklist, global value set "Times"]
End_Time_IST__c (End Time IST) [Picklist, global value set "Times"]
    The IST time window the employee will cover tomorrow, from the shared
    org-wide time-slot list. Required with Tomorrow_Availability__c; 0
    populated in practice (same unused loop as above).

--- GROUP F: INTERVIEW-SUPPORT CAPABILITY PROFILE (COMPASS INPUTS) -----------
These fields describe HOW an employee can be scheduled by the external
COMPASS support-assignment engine. Admins set them; the engine reads them.
In current data only the pool flag is used - the tuning fields are all empty,
meaning the engine runs on its defaults / its own stored state.

Active_For_Interview_Support__c (Active For Interview Support) [Checkbox]
    Membership flag for the interview-support pool: only flagged employees
    are candidates when COMPASS assigns an Interview_Support_Person__c to an
    interview. 17 of 280 records are flagged (all Active Employees) - that
    IS the current support team. Maintained by admins.

Daily_Max_Interview_Hours__c (Daily Max Interview Hours) [Number(3,1)]
    Cap on how many hours of interviews the engine may load onto this person
    per day (workload protection). 0 populated - engine default caps apply.

Allow_Buffer_Time__c (Allow Buffer Time) [Checkbox]
Buffer_Minutes_Before_After__c (Buffer Minutes Before/After) [Number(2,0)]
    Whether, and how many, breathing-room minutes the engine must leave
    before/after each assigned interview for this person. Unused so far
    (false / 0 populated everywhere).

Workday_Start_Time_IST__c (Workday Start Time (IST)) [Time]
Workday_End_Time_IST__c (Workday End Time (IST)) [Time]
    The employee's standing IST working window - assignments should fall
    inside it. 0 populated (engine defaults / external config used instead).

Preferred_Lunch_Start_IST__c (Preferred Lunch Start (IST)) [Time]
    Lunch-break start the engine should schedule around. 0 populated.

--- GROUP G: COMPASS SKILL RATINGS & ENGINE STATE ----------------------------
All written by the external COMPASS Lambda on AWS - no flow or Apex in the
org touches them. Populated only for the support pool (~22 records).

Confidence_score__c (Confidence score) [TextArea]
    LEGACY first-generation score field - its default value is literally a
    placeholder JSON array template ('[ "num_1" , "num_2" ,...]'). Superseded
    by the six per-track number fields below; ignore for reporting.

Confidence_Score_Leetcode__c (Confidence_Score_Leetcode) [Number(18,4)]
Confidence_Score_System_Design__c (Confidence_Score_System_Design) [Number(18,4)]
Confidence_Score_Backend_Coding__c (Confidence_Score_Backend_Coding) [Number(18,4)]
Confidence_Score_Frontend_Coding__c (Confidence_Score_Frontend_Coding) [Number(18,4)]
Confidence_Score_AI_ML_Coding__c (Confidence_Score_AI/ML_Coding) [Number(18,4)]
Confidence_Score_Final_Round__c (Confidence_Score_Final_Round) [Number(18,4)]
    The employee's CURRENT skill rating per interview track (matching the
    Round_Info__c track of interviews they support): Leetcode-style coding,
    system design, backend, frontend, AI/ML coding, and final-round
    performance. Updated by the COMPASS engine after each supported
    interview using its Kalman-filter math; the engine uses these to decide
    who is best suited to support each upcoming interview. The before/after
    audit of every single update is written to the Interview__c record
    (its Score_Before_*/Score_After_* fields). Populated on 22 records
    (8% - the support pool). There is no "Overall" field here; the overall
    rating lives inside the state JSON and on the interview audit fields.

COMPASS_State_JSON__c (COMPASS State JSON) [LongTextArea(131072)]
    The engine's FULL serialized per-employee state: Kalman filter values,
    momentum, histories, velocity EMAs, etc. Help text: written by the
    COMPASS Lambda after each run and read back on the next run to resume
    state - "Opaque JSON - do not hand-edit." Field history tracking is on,
    so state overwrites are auditable. Populated for the ~20 processed
    support-pool employees.

COMPASS_State_Last_Saved_UTC__c (COMPASS State Last Saved (UTC)) [DateTime]
    UTC timestamp of the most recent COMPASS run that wrote the state JSON.
    Help text: "Use this to spot stale/skipped employees" - if a pool
    member's timestamp stops advancing, the engine is skipping them.
    20 records populated.

COMPASS_State_Schema_Version__c (COMPASS State Schema Version) [Text(10)]
    Version tag of the JSON blob format, so future Lambda releases can evolve
    the state structure safely (read old versions, write new).

--- GROUP H: MARKETING TARGETS & WORKLOAD ------------------------------------

No_of_Assigned_Candidates__c (No of Assigned Candidates) [Number(18,0)]
    How many candidates this recruiter currently carries. 54% populated.
    No flow or Apex in the org maintains it, so it is kept manually or by an
    external/reporting process (not fully documented - verify with team).

Target_Per_Candidate__c (Target Per Candidate) [Number(18,0)]
    The recruiter's daily job-application quota PER candidate (the marketing
    pipeline logs daily Application__c batches against such targets). Entered
    by managers; 19% populated.

Total_Target__c (Total Target) [Number(18,0)]
    The recruiter's overall daily application target across all their
    candidates (roughly candidates x per-candidate target). Entered by
    managers; 21% populated.

--- GROUP I: PORTAL LOGIN PROVISIONING (PILOT - NOT YET IN PREPROD) ----------
These three fields exist in this repo's source and in the dev10 pilot sandbox
but are NOT deployed to preprod (queries against them fail there). They back
the planned HR "Provision Portal User" feature.

Provisioning_Status__c (Portal Login Status) [Picklist]
    Requested | Provisioned | Failed. Lifecycle marker of a portal-login
    request: "Requested" while HR's ask is pending, flipped to "Provisioned"
    by the Provision_Employee_Portal_User flow once its PortalUserAdminAction
    callout has created the AIC Portal User. "Failed" is defined but the
    current flow leaves an unsuccessful request at "Requested" and shows the
    error on screen instead. (The field's own description mentions an
    "EmployeeProvisioningService" scheduled job - that class does not exist
    in source; the design moved to the synchronous PortalUserAdminAction
    path.)

Provisioning_Requested_At__c (Portal Login Requested At) [DateTime]
    Timestamp of when HR submitted the login request, intended for auditing
    and ordering of requests. In current source no flow or Apex writes it -
    a designed-but-unwired audit field (not fully documented - verify with
    team).

Provisioning_Error__c (Portal Login Error) [Text(255)]
    Failure detail for a login that could not be created (e.g. no license
    available, duplicate username), so HR can see why directly on the
    Employee record. In current source nothing writes it - the provisioning
    flow surfaces the callout error on screen instead - so it is a
    designed-but-unwired audit field.

9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 280 (created 2024-08-21 to 2026-08-03).
- Employment status: Active Employee 148 (53%) | Former Employee 131 (47%) |
  Leave of Absense 1. Half the table is departed staff kept for history.
- Reporting line: Assigned_Sr_Recruiter__c filled on 263 (94%); the 17 blanks
  are the tree roots (top-level leaders).
- Interview-support pool: Active_For_Interview_Support__c true on 17 records,
  all of them Active Employees.
- COMPASS fields: confidence scores populated on 22 records (8%); state JSON
  last-saved timestamp on 20. The engine only touches the support pool.
- Experience level: Fresher 118 | Beginner 88 | Mid 40 | Senior 27 | blank 7.
- Key populations: First Name 100%, Last Name 99%, Slack User Id 263 (94%),
  Date of Joining 263 (94%), Email 246 (88%), PersonAccount 215 (77%),
  Employee Contact 213 (76%), No of Assigned Candidates 152 (54%),
  Total Target 59 (21%), Target Per Candidate 54 (19%), Recruiter User 44
  (16%), Phone 10, Last Working Date 6, On Leave Today 3, Date of Birth 1.
- Completely unused fields (0 records): Primary/Secondary Track, Seniority
  Level, Daily Max Interview Hours, Buffer Minutes, Workday Start/End Time,
  Preferred Lunch Start, Start/End Time IST, Leave Start/End Date-Time;
  Tomorrow Availability and Allow Buffer Time are false on every record.
- The Provisioning_* fields do not exist in preprod yet (dev10 pilot only).
- Key takeaway for answering questions: the object's LIVE usage today is
  (1) the HR roster + Slack ids, (2) the Assigned_Sr_Recruiter__c org chart,
  and (3) the 17-person COMPASS support pool with its AI-maintained scores.
  The availability/track/target tuning fields are largely aspirational.
