################################################################################
################################################################################
PART 2: B2B STAFFING PIPELINE
################################################################################
################################################################################

================================================================================
OBJECT: Job_Requirement__c  (Label: "Job Requirement")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Job_Requirement__c is ONE open job requisition received from a B2B client or
vendor - "Client X needs 2 Salesforce Developers, remote, W2, submit profiles
by Friday 5 PM". It is the anchor record of the B2B STAFFING pipeline: every
candidate submission (Job_Submission__c) and every B2B interview
(Interview__c, record type "B2B Interviews") hangs off a Job Requirement.

It carries four jobs at once:
  a) The requisition itself - title, skills, location, work mode, employment
     type, duration, openings, accepted visa types.
  b) The commercial side - client bill rate, target candidate pay rate and
     the auto-computed margin (marked SENSITIVE; meant for the Account
     Manager and Leadership only, never for recruiters or the website).
  c) The SLA machine - a required submission deadline, an auto-stamped
     "requirement received" timestamp, a live SLA status formula, and a
     recurring urgent-alert loop that nags the Account Manager 24 hours
     before (and again after) a deadline with zero submissions.
  d) The public website posting - a separate cleaned-up public description,
     publish flags, and a unique External Job ID; the company careers site
     reads published requirements through the JobRequirementRestService REST
     API (GET /jobRequirements/) and posts applicants back (POST), which
     auto-creates a Lead plus a Job Submission.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, part of the B2B staffing domain.
- TOP-LEVEL object (no master-detail parent): it has its own Owner and a
  Public Read/Write org-wide sharing model - anyone who can use the object
  can see and edit every requirement.
- 38 custom fields, 0 record types, 11 validation rules (7 active, 4
  inactive - the most validation rules of any object in the org), 6 list
  views (All, My Client Requirements, Open Jobs - Need Profiles, Open Jobs
  With Zero Submissions, Urgent Jobs Due in 24 Hours, Website Published
  Jobs).
- Auto-number Name in the format JR-XXXXX (e.g. JR-00012).
- Field history tracking is switched on at the object level, but no
  individual field is flagged for tracking yet.
- Scale: only 3 records in preprod (all created 2026-08-07). Like the rest
  of the B2B flavor, this object is newly built and barely has data yet.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Every Job Requirement is the same flavor; the one real variation -
whether the client is still a PROSPECT (Client Company + Client Lead) or a
CONVERTED B2B client (Client Account + Client Contact) - is carried by the
two lookup pairs and their validation rule, not by record types.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - INTAKE. A client or vendor sends an open position (email/call). The
  Account Manager (or sales) creates the Job Requirement and links exactly
  one complete "who is the client" pair (validation rule):
  - Prospect path: Client Company (Company__c master list) + Client Lead
    (a "B2B Client Lead" record-type Lead) - used until the prospect is
    converted into a real client Account/Contact.
  - Converted path: Client Account (business Account, never a candidate
    Person Account) + Client Contact (a contact of that account).
  Job Status starts at "New" (default).

STEP 2 - AUTO-SETUP ON SAVE. The Job_Requirement_Set_Defaults_On_Create flow
  stamps Requirement_Received_Date_Time__c and generates the unique
  External_Job_ID__c, then notifies the Account Manager by email, bell
  notification and a Slack channel post. The JR_Notification_Anchor_Bootstrap
  flow (before save) stamps Last_Notification_Sent__c and normalizes a null
  Submission Count to 0 so the deadline-alert loop can register. Editing any
  key field later (title, priority, status, deadline, location, work mode,
  employment type, openings, AM) re-notifies the AM via the
  B2b_job_requirement_updated_notification_flow.

STEP 3 - OPENING THE JOB. The AM moves Job Status New -> Open. Opening
  requires a Submission Deadline (two validation rules enforce it) and the
  deadline must be later than the received timestamp. Status transitions are
  locked down: New -> Open, Open -> On Hold/Closed, On Hold -> Open/Closed;
  only a System Administrator can reopen a Closed requirement.

STEP 4 - SOURCING CANDIDATES. Two channels feed submissions:
  - Internal: a recruiter opens the requirement and clicks the "Submit
    Candidate Profile" button (screen flow B2B_Submit_Candidate_Profile).
    The flow validates the job is Open, checks duplicates, captures rate/
    availability/visa answers, creates the Job_Submission__c, attaches the
    resume, starts a Slack thread and emails the AM.
  - Website: publishing the job (Website Status = Published + the publish
    checkbox + public description) makes it visible to the careers site,
    which reads jobs via GET /jobRequirements/ (only Published records are
    ever returned). A website applicant POSTs to the same service, which
    runs the Create_Lead_From_Application flow: dedupes by email+job,
    creates/reuses a Lead, links the requirement via the Lead's
    Applied_Job_Requirement__c, attaches the resume, auto-creates a Job
    Submission (source "Website Applicant"), starts the Slack thread and
    emails both the AM and the applicant.
  Every submission create/update re-counts Submission_Count__c and
  Client_Submission_Count__c on the requirement (flow-based rollup, because
  the relationship is a lookup, not master-detail) and rolls totals up to
  the Client Lead.

STEP 5 - THE DEADLINE RACE. The B2B_Deadline_Alert flow watches every Open
  requirement with a deadline: 24 hours out with ZERO submissions it fires
  an urgent email + Slack + bell alert to the Account Manager; once overdue
  it fires overdue alerts; leadership gets a daily summary instead of
  per-job noise. The SLA_Status__c formula (On Track / Due Today / Overdue /
  Closed) drives the "Urgent Jobs Due in 24 Hours" and "Open Jobs With Zero
  Submissions" list views. The flow alerts but never changes the job status
  itself - extending or closing stays a human (AM) decision.

STEP 6 - INTERVIEWS AND FILLING. From a Job Submission the "Create B2B
  Interview" flow creates Interview__c records that link back here and bump
  Interview_Count__c. When interview outcomes come in, the
  B2B_Interview_Outcome_Sync_With_Job_Submission_Flow updates the
  submission and, when all openings are placed, marks the Job Requirement
  filled (note: the current Job Status picklist has no "Filled" value -
  only the SLA formula still references one; verify the final wiring with
  the team).

STEP 7 - CLOSURE. The AM sets Job Status = Closed with a Reason for JR
  Closure (Completed / Cancelled / No Response / Expired / Other) and a
  free-text reason when "Other". Creating or deleting a requirement also
  keeps the linked Client Lead's Total_Job_Requirements__c counter honest
  (paired count flows on create and delete).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOKUPS FROM JOB REQUIREMENT TO OTHER OBJECTS:
- Account (Client_Account__c): the paying B2B client or vendor company
  (business Account). Delete-restricted; a validation rule blocks Person
  Accounts (candidates). Half of the "converted client" pair.
- Contact (Client_Contact__c): the hiring manager / vendor contact who sent
  the requirement and receives candidate profiles. A lookup filter limits
  choices to contacts OF the selected Client Account whose account record
  type is "B2B Client" or "Vendor / Implementation Partner".
- Company__c (Client_Company__c): the client company from the market-company
  master list - the PROSPECT stand-in for Client Account until the client is
  converted into a real Account. Delete-restricted.
- Lead (Client_Lead__c): the client-side Lead (record type "B2B Client
  Lead") - the prospect stand-in for Client Contact. A lookup filter requires
  the Lead's company to match the selected Client Company.
- User (Account_Manager__c): the Techsara AM who owns this requirement -
  auto-populated from the client account, changeable. Receives every alert
  the automation sends.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT JOB REQUIREMENT:
- Job_Submission__c (lookup Job_Submission__c.Job_Requirement__c): one row
  per candidate submitted against this requirement. Because this is a lookup
  (not master-detail), the submission counters are maintained by flow, not
  native roll-up summaries. 7 submissions exist in preprod.
- Interview__c (lookup Interview__c.Job_Requirement__c): B2B interviews for
  this requirement, created from submissions ("B2B Interviews" record type).
  8 interviews link to a requirement so far.
- Lead (lookup Lead.Applied_Job_Requirement__c): website applicants - the
  job the person applied to on the careers site, stamped by the
  Create_Lead_From_Application flow (5 leads so far).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules - 11, the most in the org)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ACTIVE (7):
- Client_Account_Cannot_Be_Candidate: "Client Account must be a B2B Client
  or Vendor Business Account, not a Candidate Person Account."
- Invalid_Status_Transition: "Invalid Job Status transition. Allowed
  transitions are: New -> Open, Open -> On Hold or Closed, and On Hold ->
  Open or Closed. Only System Administrators can reopen a Closed Job
  Requirement." (Checked by profile name "System Administrator".)
- Max_Submissions_Allowed: "Max Submissions Allowed must be greater than the
  Number of Openings" - blocks a submissions cap at or below the openings
  count (you must be allowed to show more profiles than seats).
- Open_Job_Needs_Deadline: "Submission Deadline is required when Job Status
  is Open."
- Submission_Deadline: "Submission Deadline is required when Job Status is
  Open. Please enter the date and time by which candidate profiles must be
  submitted to the client." (A duplicate of Open_Job_Needs_Deadline - both
  are active, so users would see this pair as one blocked save.)
- Require_One_Complete_Client_Pair: "Enter either Client Company + Client
  Lead (prospect) or Client Account + Client Contact (converted client) -
  not a mix, and not just one of the pair."
- Submission_After_Req_Received: "Submission Deadline must be later than the
  Requirement Received Date/Time."

INACTIVE (4) - built but currently switched off:
- Job_Requirement_Required_Fields: "Please fill in all required fields: Job
  Title, Client Account, Account Manager, Job Status, Priority, Requirement
  Received DateTime, Location, Work Mode, Employment Type, Primary Skills,
  Job Description, External Job ID." (An all-in-one completeness gate.)
- Published_Job_Needs_Description: "Public Website Description and External
  Job ID are required when Website Status is Published." (Off - so today a
  job CAN be flagged Published without a public description.)
- Req_Received_Before_Submission: "Requirement Received Date/Time must be
  earlier than the Submission Deadline." (Inactive twin of the active
  Submission_After_Req_Received rule.)
- submissionDeadlineDateValidation: "Submission Deadline should be in future
  (at least later than today)."

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOWS (active):
- Job_Requirement_Set_Defaults_On_Create (after save, create): stamps
  Requirement Received Date/Time + External Job ID, then emails, bell-
  notifies and Slacks the Account Manager about the new requirement.
- JR_Notification_Anchor_Bootstrap (before save, create+update): the loop
  starter - stamps Last_Notification_Sent__c and normalizes a null
  Submission Count to 0 the moment a job is Open with a deadline, so the
  deadline-alert scheduled paths register from day one.
- B2B_Deadline_Alert (after save, create+update, 3 scheduled paths): the
  urgency engine - 24-hours-out alert (email + Slack + bell) to the AM when
  an Open job still has zero submissions, overdue alerts once the deadline
  passes, and a daily leadership summary. Updates Last_Notification_Sent__c
  to throttle the recurring reminder loop. Never changes Job Status.
- B2b_job_requirement_updated_notification_flow (after save, update): when a
  key field changes (title, priority, status, deadline, location, work mode,
  employment type, openings, AM), notifies the AM by email + bell + Slack.
- Update_Lead_JR_Count_On_Create (after save, create+update): recounts all
  requirements of the linked Client Lead into Lead.Total_Job_Requirements__c.
- Update_Lead_JR_Count_On_Delete (before delete): same recount excluding the
  record being deleted, so the Lead counter survives deletes.

FLOWS ON OTHER OBJECTS THAT WRITE THIS ONE:
- B2B_Jr_update_submission_counts (on Job_Submission__c): recounts
  Submission_Count__c and Client_Submission_Count__c whenever submissions
  change, then rolls totals up to the Client Lead.
- B2B_Create_Interview_from_Submission (screen flow on Job Submission):
  bumps Interview_Count__c when a B2B interview is created.
- B2B_Interview_Outcome_Sync_With_Job_Submission_Flow (on Interview__c):
  designed to mark the requirement filled once all openings are placed.

SCREEN FLOW / BUTTON ON THE PAGE:
- Submit Candidate Profile (quick action on the Job Requirement Lightning
  record page) -> B2B_Submit_Candidate_Profile: the recruiter-facing wizard
  that validates the job, dedupes, and creates the Job Submission with
  Slack/email notifications.

APEX / REST (JobRequirementRestService, endpoint /jobRequirements/*):
- GET: the public careers-website feed. Returns ONLY Website Status =
  "Published" requirements, paginated (default 20, max 200 per page), with
  optional filters jobStatus, employmentType, priority, workMode, location
  (contains), searchTerm (title contains). Runs in USER_MODE (the calling
  user's field access applies); the Client Company name is fetched
  separately in system context as the display fallback for unconverted
  clients, and the client name honors Show_Client_Name_on_Website__c /
  the account's Confidential Client flag. NOTE: the response wrapper also
  carries Client Bill Rate / Target Candidate Rate / Estimated Margin, so
  the site guest user must never be granted those fields or they leak.
- POST: the website application intake. Parses the applicant JSON, hands it
  to the Create_Lead_From_Application flow (dedupe by email+job -> 409;
  create/reuse Lead; auto Job Submission; Slack thread; AM + candidate
  emails) and returns the flow's status. The class also exposes the
  "Attach Resume To Lead" invocable that base64-decodes the uploaded
  PDF/DOC/DOCX into a Salesforce File on the Lead. Unexpected errors are
  emailed to a hard-coded admin address.
- There is NO Apex trigger on Job_Requirement__c.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 38, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHO THE CLIENT IS (THE TWO CLIENT PAIRS + THE AM) ----------------

Client_Account__c (Client Account) [Lookup -> Account]
    The B2B client or vendor company that sent this requirement - must be a
    business Account, never a candidate Person Account (validation rule
    blocks it, and the delete of a referenced Account is restricted). Half
    of the "converted client" pair; selected manually at intake. Read by
    every notification flow and returned by the website API as the client
    name (when allowed). 3/3 records populated.

Client_Contact__c (Client Contact) [Lookup -> Contact]
    The hiring manager or vendor contact who sent the requirement and should
    receive candidate profiles - used for submission emails and interview
    scheduling. A lookup filter restricts choices to contacts of the chosen
    Client Account whose account is a "B2B Client" or "Vendor /
    Implementation Partner" record type. Other half of the converted pair.
    3/3 populated.

Client_Company__c (Client Company) [Lookup -> Company__c]
    PROSPECT stand-in for Client Account: the client company from the
    Company__c master list, used while the B2B client has not yet been
    converted into a real client Account (help text says exactly this).
    Delete-restricted. The website API uses this company's name as the
    display fallback when no Client Account exists yet. 1/3 populated.

Client_Lead__c (Client Lead) [Lookup -> Lead]
    PROSPECT stand-in for Client Contact: the client-side Lead (record type
    "B2B Client Lead") until conversion. A lookup filter requires the Lead's
    company to match the chosen Client Company. The Lead JR/submission
    counter flows key off this field - a requirement without a Client Lead
    updates no Lead counters. 1/3 populated.

Has_Client_Side__c (Has Client Side) [Formula, Checkbox]
    TRUE when Client Account OR Client Contact is filled - a helper flag for
    reports/automation to spot the "converted client" side without null
    checks.

Has_Prospect_Side__c (Has Prospect Side) [Formula, Checkbox]
    TRUE when Client Company OR Client Lead is filled - the matching helper
    for the prospect side. Together with Has_Client_Side__c it makes the
    pair rule auditable in list views.

Account_Manager__c (Account Manager) [Lookup -> User]
    The Techsara Account Manager who owns this requirement and the client
    relationship. Auto-populated from the client account's AM at creation
    (help text), changeable by hand. This is THE person every automation
    talks to: new/updated notifications, 24-hour urgent alerts, overdue
    alerts, submission notifications. Also copied onto Job Submissions and
    B2B Interviews downstream. 3/3 populated.

--- GROUP B: THE JOB ITSELF ---------------------------------------------------

Job_Title__c (Job Title) [Text]
    The open position's title exactly as the client provided it (e.g.
    "Salesforce Developer", "Java Backend Engineer"). Manual entry. Shown on
    website listings, searched by the REST API's searchTerm filter, and used
    for candidate matching. 3/3 populated.

Job_Description__c (Job Description) [Rich Text]
    The FULL INTERNAL job description - client details, technical
    requirements, interview process, anything the team needs. Explicitly
    NEVER shown on the website (that is what Public_Website_Description__c
    is for). Manual entry.

Primary_Skills__c (Primary Skills) [LongTextArea]
    The required skill list (e.g. "Salesforce Apex, LWC, REST integration").
    Manual entry; used by recruiters for candidate matching and displayed on
    website listings via the API.

Location__c (Location) [Text]
    Free-text job location ("Austin TX", "New York City", "Hybrid -
    Chicago"). Manual entry; shown on the website and matchable via the REST
    API's contains-filter. 3/3 populated.

Work_Mode__c (Work Mode) [Picklist]
    The work arrangement: Remote (fully remote) | Hybrid (mix of remote and
    office) | Onsite (full time at the client location). Manual entry;
    website-visible and an API filter. Data: Remote 2, Hybrid 1.

Employment_Type__c (Employment Type) [Picklist]
    The engagement/tax structure of the role: C2C (corp-to-corp) | W2
    Contract (W2 employee of the staffing entity) | Full-Time (permanent
    employee) | Contract-to-Hire (starts contract, may convert). Manual
    entry; an API filter and a key field for the AM-update notifications.
    Data note: one record holds the value "Full Time" (no hyphen), which is
    NOT in the current restricted picklist - written before the restriction
    or through the API.

Duration__c (Duration) [Text]
    Expected engagement length as free text ("6 months", "Long-term",
    "3 months with extension"). Manual entry; used for matching and website
    display. 3/3 populated.

Number_of_Openings__c (Number of Openings) [Number]
    How many seats the client needs to fill (default 1). When this many
    candidates are placed the requirement can be marked filled. Also feeds
    the Max Submissions validation (the cap must exceed the openings).
    Data: 40, 100 and 2 on the three records (totals 142) - being used for
    large batch requisitions, not just single seats.

Required_Visa_Status__c (Required Visa Status) [MultiselectPicklist]
    Which work authorizations the client accepts: USC | GC | H1B | H4 EAD |
    OPT | CPT | TN | Any. Blank or "Any" = all accepted. Manual entry; used
    to filter candidates during the submission flow and returned by the
    website API so applicants self-select.

Minimum_Experience_Required__c (Experience Required) [Text]
    Short free-text minimum-experience statement written specifically for
    the website listing (help text: "used to show required experience to
    website"). Manual entry; returned by the REST API. 3/3 populated.

--- GROUP C: MONEY (CONFIDENTIAL - AM/LEADERSHIP ONLY) ------------------------

Client_Bill_Rate__c (Client Bill Rate) [Currency]
    SENSITIVE. The agreed rate Techsara CHARGES the client (per the Rate
    Type). Field description says visible only to the Account Manager and
    Leadership - never to recruiters or the website. Manual entry at intake.
    Snapshotted onto interviews at scheduling time on the B2B path. 3/3
    populated.

Target_Candidate_Rate__c (Target Candidate Rate) [Currency]
    SENSITIVE. The target PAY rate for the candidate. Combined with the bill
    rate to plan margin. Manual entry; same confidentiality rules. 3/3
    populated.

Estimated_Margin__c (Estimated Margin) [Formula, Currency]
    Client_Bill_Rate__c - Target_Candidate_Rate__c: the estimated per-unit
    profit on this requirement, auto-calculated. Same AM/Leadership-only
    intent. NOTE: all three money fields are included in the website API's
    response wrapper - field-level security on the site guest user is the
    only thing keeping them off the public site.

Rate_Type__c (Rate Type) [Picklist]
    What unit the rates are in: Hourly (contract/C2C/W2) | Salary
    (full-time permanent) | Daily (some consulting arrangements). Manual
    entry; copied onto Job Submissions by the submit flows. Data: Hourly 2,
    Salary 1.

--- GROUP D: LIFECYCLE STATUS & CLOSURE ---------------------------------------

Job_Status__c (Job Status) [Picklist]
    The requirement's lifecycle state: New (default - just recorded) | Open
    (actively sourcing; requires a Submission Deadline) | On Hold (client
    paused it) | Closed (done). Transitions are locked by validation rule
    (New -> Open, Open -> On Hold/Closed, On Hold -> Open/Closed; only a
    System Administrator may reopen Closed). Gates everything: submissions
    are only allowed while Open, website publication requires Open, the
    deadline alerts only watch Open jobs, and the REST API exposes it as a
    filter. Data: all 3 records are Open. (The SLA formula still references
    legacy values "Filled"/"Cancelled"/"Expired" that are no longer in the
    picklist.)

Priority__c (Priority) [Picklist]
    Urgency of the requirement: Urgent | High | Medium. Manual entry;
    changing it re-notifies the AM, and it is returned/filterable via the
    API. Help text still describes an older Critical/High/Medium/Low scale -
    read "Urgent" as the same-day/24-hour tier. Data: Urgent 2, High 1.

Reason_for_JR_Closure__c (Reason for JR Closure) [Picklist]
    Why the requirement was closed: Completed (filled) | Cancelled (client
    pulled it) | No Response (client went quiet) | Expired (deadline passed
    unfilled) | Other | Client Hold (inactive value, no longer selectable).
    Manual entry at closure; used for closure-pattern reporting. 0/3
    populated (nothing closed yet).

Other_Closure_Reason__c (Other Closure Reason) [Text]
    Free-text closure detail, meant to be filled when the reason chosen is
    "Other". (No validation rule enforces the pairing today.) 0/3 populated.

--- GROUP E: DEADLINE & SLA TRACKING ------------------------------------------

Submission_Deadline__c (Submission Deadline) [DateTime, required]
    THE clock of the whole object: the date/time by which candidate profiles
    must reach the client. Required at the field level and doubly enforced
    when the job is Open (two active validation rules); must be later than
    the received timestamp. Drives the SLA Status formula, the 24-hour and
    overdue alert paths, and the "Urgent Jobs Due in 24 Hours" list view.
    Manual entry by the AM. 3/3 populated.

Requirement_Received_Date_Time__c (Requirement Received Date/Time) [DateTime]
    When the requirement arrived from the client. Defaults to NOW() and is
    stamped by the Job_Requirement_Set_Defaults_On_Create flow - help text
    says do not edit manually. Used to compute "average time to first
    submission" SLA reporting and as the lower bound for the deadline
    validation. 3/3 populated.

SLA_Status__c (SLA Status) [Formula, Text]
    Live traffic light for list views and dashboards: "Closed" when the job
    status is Closed (or the legacy Filled/Cancelled/Expired values), blank
    when no deadline is set, otherwise "Overdue" (deadline passed), "Due
    Today", or "On Track" (deadline in the future). Nobody sets it - it is
    pure formula.

Last_Notification_Sent__c (Last Notification Sent) [DateTime]
    Throttle timestamp for the recurring urgent-reminder loop: when the last
    urgent reminder went out (help text calls it the 4-hour loop; the
    bootstrap flow doc describes a 4-minute cadence in this sandbox - verify
    the production cadence with the team). Written by the
    JR_Notification_Anchor_Bootstrap and B2B_Deadline_Alert flows, never by
    users. 3/3 populated.

--- GROUP F: SUBMISSION & INTERVIEW COUNTERS ----------------------------------

Submission_Count__c (Submission Count) [Number]
    How many Job Submissions exist against this requirement - a flow-
    maintained rollup (B2B_Jr_update_submission_counts recounts on every
    submission change; needed because the relationship is a lookup, so a
    native roll-up summary is impossible). Zero-normalized at creation.
    "Zero submissions" is exactly what triggers the 24-hour urgent alert.
    Data: totals 7 across the 3 records, matching the 7 live submissions.

Client_Submission_Count__c (Client Submission Count) [Number]
    Of those submissions, how many were actually SENT TO THE CLIENT (the
    subset with a client-submission timestamp) - same flow maintains it.
    Internal-vs-client funnel metric. Data: 2 in total.

Max_Submissions_Allowed__c (Max Submissions Allowed) [Number]
    The client's cap on how many profiles they will review; blank = no
    limit. Must be greater than the Number of Openings (validation rule);
    help text says the system warns as the limit approaches (the warning
    lives in the submission screen flow). Manual entry. 3/3 populated
    (50, 999, 5).

Interview_Count__c (Interview Count) [Number]
    How many B2B interviews this requirement has generated - incremented by
    the B2B_Create_Interview_from_Submission flow when an interview is
    created. Data reality: sums to 4 while 8 Interview__c records actually
    link to a requirement, so treat it as best-effort; it can drift from
    the true related-list count.

--- GROUP G: WEBSITE PUBLISHING -----------------------------------------------

Publish_to_Website__c (Job Post on Website) [Checkbox]
    Eligibility switch for the careers site: help text says the job appears
    only when this is checked AND Website Status = Published AND the public
    description is filled. Manual. Data note: currently FALSE on all 3
    records (even the one marked Published), and the REST API filters on
    Website Status only - so today this checkbox is aspirational, not
    enforced by the feed. (Verify intended enforcement with the team.)

Website_Status__c (Job Posting Status) [Picklist]
    The actual publication state the REST API filters on: Draft (default -
    not public) | Published (shows on the website while the job is Open and
    the deadline is future) | Unpublished (removed from the website but the
    job can stay Open internally). Manual. Data: one record in each state.

Public_Website_Description__c (Public Website Description) [LongTextArea]
    The CLEANED, public-safe job description shown to website visitors -
    explicitly must not contain a confidential client's name, internal
    rates, or internal notes (contrast with the internal
    Job_Description__c). Manual entry; the validation rule that would
    require it for Published jobs exists but is switched OFF.

Show_Client_Name_on_Website__c (Show Client Name on Website) [Checkbox]
    Whether the client's name may appear on the public listing. Overridden
    by the "Confidential Client" flag on the Account - a confidential
    client's name NEVER shows regardless of this checkbox. Manual; read by
    the website when rendering the API response.

External_Job_ID__c (External Job ID) [Text, unique, external ID]
    The public reference ID of this job - auto-generated by the
    Job_Requirement_Set_Defaults_On_Create flow, unique, used in website
    URLs and application forms so an inbound application can be matched back
    to the right requirement (the POST /jobRequirements/ payload carries
    it). Help text: do not edit manually. 3/3 populated.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 3, all created 2026-08-07. This object is BRAND NEW - it
  and the whole B2B pipeline (7 Job Submissions, 8 linked Interviews,
  5 website-applicant Leads) are effectively in pilot.
- Job Status: Open 3 (100%). Nothing has been put On Hold or Closed yet;
  both closure fields are empty on every record.
- Website: one record each in Draft / Published / Unpublished; the "Job Post
  on Website" checkbox is false on all three.
- Classification: Work Mode - Remote 2, Hybrid 1. Priority - Urgent 2,
  High 1. Rate Type - Hourly 2, Salary 1. Employment Type - W2 Contract 2
  plus one legacy "Full Time" value that is not in the current picklist.
- Counters: Submission Count totals 7 (matches the 7 real submissions);
  Client Submission Count totals 2; Interview Count totals 4 versus 8
  interviews actually linked (the counter drifts); Openings total 142
  (40 / 100 / 2 - big batch requisitions).
- Population: Client Account, Client Contact, Account Manager, Submission
  Deadline, both rates, External Job ID, Max Submissions, Openings,
  Location, Duration, Experience Required, Requirement Received and Last
  Notification Sent are 100% populated (3/3). Client Company and Client
  Lead are on 1 record - and that record carries BOTH client pairs at once,
  which the active pair validation rule would now block (it predates the
  rule or was API-loaded).
- Key takeaway for answering questions: treat everything here as the
  freshly-built B2B foundation. The object's design (SLA alerts, website
  API, counters, 11 validation rules) is fully wired, but with 3 pilot
  records there is no meaningful historical distribution yet - expect the
  data profile to change fast as the B2B pipeline goes live.

================================================================================

================================================================================
OBJECT: Job_Submission__c  (Label: "Job Submission")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Job_Submission__c is the JUNCTION between a candidate and a client's open job:
one record = one candidate proposed for one Job Requirement. It is the heart of
the B2B staffing pipeline - it carries the candidate's pitch (summary, skills
match, rate, visa status, availability), tracks the submission through its
whole lifecycle (Suggested by Team -> Pending AM Review -> Submitted to Client
-> Interview Scheduled -> ... -> Placed), and records the money terms: the
candidate's pay rate, the bill rate submitted to the client, and the expected
margin between them.

It is also the LAUNCH PAD for B2B interviews: the "Create B2B Interview"
button lives on this record's page, and the rate snapshots on Interview__c
(Candidate_Rate__c / Submission_Rate__c) are copied FROM this object at
interview-creation time. Submissions can be created by a recruiter (from the
Job Requirement page), auto-created from a website job application ("Flow 7" -
a web applicant Lead instantly becomes a Job Submission), or - by design,
though not yet in use - from the Candidate Portal.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, part of the B2B staffing domain.
- A LOOKUP-BASED junction (NOT master-detail): it has lookups to Account
  (candidate), Job_Requirement__c, Lead, and two Users - but it has its own
  OwnerId. Because Job_Requirement__c is a lookup, native roll-up summaries
  are impossible; flows recount submissions onto the requirement instead.
- Sharing model: Public Read/Write - any internal user who can log in can see
  and edit submissions.
- 26 custom fields, 0 record types, 4 validation rules, 4 list views
  (All | Pending AM Review | Submitted to Client | Interview Requested/
  Scheduled - the list views mirror the AM's work queues).
- Auto-number Name in the format JS-XXXXX (e.g. JS-00007).
- Scale: only 7 records in preprod, all created on 2026-08-07 - the B2B
  submission pipeline is brand new and this is essentially test/build data.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Every Job Submission is the same shape; the Submission_Source__c
picklist (Internal Recruiter | Website Applicant | Candidate Portal) carries
the "flavor" instead of record types.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATION. Three entry points:
  - RECRUITER PATH: on a Job Requirement record, a recruiter runs the "Submit
    Candidate Profile" screen flow (B2B_Submit_Candidate_Profile). It checks
    the job is still open, blocks duplicates (same candidate + same job),
    collects the pitch (candidate, rate, summary, skills match, visa,
    availability), attaches the resume file, then creates the Job Submission
    with status "Pending AM Review" and source "Internal Recruiter". It also
    stamps Submitted_By, Internal Submission Date/Time and the Unique
    Submission Key, starts a Slack thread in the b2b-submissions channel
    (saving the Thread ID), and emails + Slack-DMs the Account Manager.
  - WEBSITE PATH ("Flow 7"): when someone applies on the public website, the
    REST endpoint (JobRequirementRestService.createLead) runs the
    Create_Lead_From_Application flow - the org's internal nickname for it is
    "Flow 7 (Website Lead to JS)". It dedupes by email + job (the same email
    applying to the same job is rejected), creates or reuses a Lead, and
    auto-creates a Job Submission with source "Website Applicant", status
    "Pending AM Review", the Lead linked (no Candidate yet), the website visa
    answer in Visa_Confirmation__c, and the resume file attached. It starts
    the Slack thread and emails the AM and the applicant. This replaced an
    older manual "Convert to Job Submission" button.
  - CANDIDATE PORTAL: a Submission_Source__c value exists for portal
    self-submission, and the required-fields validation rule already exempts
    it, but no live automation creates portal submissions yet.

STEP 2 - AM REVIEW AND SUBMIT TO CLIENT. The Account Manager (auto-copied
  from the Job Requirement) reviews the submission from the "Pending AM
  Review" list view. On the record page they click "Submit to Client"
  (screen flow Approve_and_Submit_to_Client): it confirms/edits the
  Submitted Bill Rate and Rate Type, sets the status to "Submitted to
  Client", stamps Client Submission Date/Time, then emails the client, the
  recruiter, the candidate and leadership, and replies into the submission's
  Slack thread. Two validation rules enforce that the bill rate and the
  client date/time are present whenever the status says "Submitted to
  Client".

STEP 3 - COUNTERS ROLL UP. Every create/update fires
  B2B_Jr_update_submission_counts, which recounts the parent Job
  Requirement's Submission Count (all submissions) and Client Submission
  Count (only those actually sent to the client, i.e. with a Client
  Submission Date/Time), and rolls the total up to the client Lead's
  Total_Job_Applications__c. Update_Lead_JA_Count_On_Create does the same
  Lead recount on create. (Flows, because lookup junctions cannot use
  roll-up summary fields.)

STEP 4 - INTERVIEW. When the client shortlists the candidate (status
  "Client Shortlisted", shown to users as "Shortlisted for Interview"), the
  user clicks "Create B2B Interview" on the submission page (screen flow
  B2B_Create_Interview_from_Submission). The flow creates the Interview__c
  (record type "B2B Interviews"), copying candidate, Lead, Job Requirement,
  Job Submission, client account, AM, recruiter and applicant email, and
  SNAPSHOTS the money: Candidate_Rate__c and Submitted_Bill_Rate__c are
  frozen onto the interview. It then ticks Interview_Requested__c on this
  submission, moves the status to "Interview Scheduled", bumps the Job
  Requirement's Interview Count, and sends confirmation emails plus Slack
  messages. One submission can spawn several interviews (one per round).

STEP 5 - OUTCOME SYNC (AUTOMATIC). As each linked B2B interview progresses,
  the B2B_Interview_Outcome_Sync_With_Job_Submission_Flow (running on
  Interview__c) writes the result back here: interview status Scheduled ->
  submission "Interview Scheduled"; Completed -> "Interview Completed";
  outcome Moved to Next Round -> "Shortlisted for Next Round"; Rejected ->
  "Rejected"; Offer Received -> "Offer Received" plus the Offer_Received__c
  checkbox. It also emails the candidate the matching template (next round /
  offer / rejection) and marks the Job Requirement "Filled" when all its
  openings are placed.

STEP 6 - CLOSE-OUT. The team records the final result: status "Placed" when
  the candidate starts, "Withdrawn" if the candidate pulls out, "Rejected"
  with a Rejection_Reason__c otherwise. Placement_Status__c exists as a
  separate final-outcome field (Not Placed / Offered / Placed / Lost) but has
  never been filled in practice - Submission_Status__c is what the team
  actually drives (via the Path on the record page). Placement leads to
  Onboarding downstream.

LEAD CONVERSION LINK: when a website Lead is later converted into a candidate
Person Account, the Lead_Conversion_Flow looks up the lead's Job Submissions
by applicant email as part of wiring the new candidate up (read-only lookup
in the flow definition - exact relinking behavior not fully documented -
verify with team).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOKUPS FROM JOB SUBMISSION TO OTHER OBJECTS:
- Account (Candidate__c): the candidate Person Account being submitted.
  Filled on recruiter-path submissions; website-path submissions start with
  only a Lead. Either Candidate or Lead must be present (validation rule).
- Lead (Lead__c): the website applicant Lead, for submissions created by
  "Flow 7" before the person exists as a candidate.
- Job_Requirement__c (Job_Requirement__c): the client's open job this
  candidate is submitted against. Required (validation rule) and treated as
  immutable after creation (help text; not system-enforced). The requirement
  counts its submissions via flow (Submission_Count__c /
  Client_Submission_Count__c / Interview_Count__c).
- User (Account_Manager__c): the AM who must review/approve, auto-copied
  from the Job Requirement.
- User (Submitted_By__c): the user who ran the submit flow - recruiter
  performance reporting.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT JOB SUBMISSION:
- Interview__c (lookup Interview__c.Job_Submission__c): the B2B interviews
  created from this submission - one per round. The interview snapshots this
  record's rates at creation and its outcomes sync back to this record's
  status. (8 interviews link to the 7 submissions so far.)

INDIRECT/UPSTREAM: the client Lead behind the Job Requirement receives a
rolled-up Total_Job_Applications__c count from this object's flows; the
resume travels with the submission as an attached File (ContentDocumentLink),
not a field.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules, all active)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Candidate_OR_Lead_Required: "Either Candidate or Lead must be linked to
  this Job Submission." (Website submissions have only a Lead; recruiter
  submissions have the Candidate.)
- Bill_Rate_Required_On_Submit: "Submitted Bill Rate is required when
  submitting profile to client." (status = Submitted to Client and the bill
  rate is blank).
- Client_Date_Required_On_Submit: "Client Submission Date/Time is required
  when status is Submitted to Client."
- Submission_Required_Fields_Validation: on save, Job Requirement, Submitted
  By, Account Manager, Submission Status, Internal Submission Date/Time,
  Candidate Rate, Candidate Summary and Unique Submission Key must all be
  filled - EXCEPT for self-service sources (Website Applicant, Candidate
  Portal), which are exempt because those recruiter-only fields are filled
  in later. (The error message also lists "Candidate", but the formula
  itself does not check it - the Candidate-or-Lead rule covers that.)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOWS (active, on this object):
- B2B_Jr_update_submission_counts (after save, create+update): recounts the
  parent Job Requirement's Submission Count and Client Submission Count and
  rolls total submissions up to the client Lead's Total_Job_Applications__c.
- Update_Lead_JA_Count_On_Create (after save, create): same Lead
  job-application recount when a submission is created.

SCREEN FLOWS / BUTTONS:
- "Submit to Client" button on the record page -> Approve_and_Submit_to_Client
  (AM approval: sets status, stamps client date/time and bill rate, emails
  client/recruiter/candidate/leadership, replies in the Slack thread).
- "Create B2B Interview" button on the record page ->
  B2B_Create_Interview_from_Submission (creates the B2B Interview__c, ticks
  Interview_Requested__c, sets status "Interview Scheduled", bumps the
  requirement's interview count, emails + Slack).
- B2B_Submit_Candidate_Profile (launched from the Job Requirement page):
  CREATES submissions on the recruiter path.

FLOWS ON OTHER OBJECTS THAT WRITE HERE:
- Create_Lead_From_Application ("Flow 7", autolaunched from the website REST
  endpoint JobRequirementRestService.createLead): auto-creates website
  submissions with the Lead linked.
- B2B_Interview_Outcome_Sync_With_Job_Submission_Flow (record-triggered on
  Interview__c): writes interview progress back to Submission_Status__c and
  Offer_Received__c and emails the candidate.
- Lead_Conversion_Flow: looks up submissions by applicant email during lead
  conversion.

APEX / TRIGGERS: none. No Apex class references Job_Submission__c - this
object is 100% flow-driven. The record page also has a Path component
(driving Submission_Status__c) and the standard activity/files panels.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 26, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHO IS BEING SUBMITTED (THE CANDIDATE) ---------------------------

Candidate__c (Candidate) [Lookup -> Account]
    The candidate Person Account being submitted. Help text: only Candidate
    Person Accounts are valid; the Submit Candidate Profile flow filters to
    Person Accounts. Set by the recruiter in the submit flow. Website
    submissions start WITHOUT it (Lead only) until conversion. Either this
    or Lead must be filled (validation rule). 6 of 7 records have it.

Lead__c (Lead) [Lookup -> Lead]
    The website applicant Lead behind this submission. Help text: "Auto-set
    by Flow 7 (Website Lead to JS) when creating JS from a website applicant
    Lead" - that flow is Create_Lead_From_Application in the org. Populated
    on 4 of 7 records (the website-path ones).

Applicant_Name__c (Applicant Name) [Text]
    The applicant's name as plain text - filled on every record (7/7) by the
    creating flow, so the submission is readable/emailable even before a
    Candidate Person Account exists. Used in the client and candidate email
    templates.

Applicant_Email__c (Applicant Email) [Email]
    The applicant's email address, stamped by the creating flow (7/7
    populated). This is the address the outcome-sync flow prefers when
    emailing the candidate (falling back to the Person Account or Lead
    email), and the key the Lead_Conversion_Flow uses to find this
    submission at conversion time. Also copied onto the B2B Interview.

Availability__c (Availability) [Text]
    When the candidate can start, in free text. Help text examples:
    "Immediate", "2 weeks notice", "Available from June 15", "Currently on
    project until July". Entered by the recruiter in the submit flow;
    3 of 7 records filled (website submissions skip it).

Visa_Confirmation__c (Visa Confirmation) [Text]
    The candidate's work-authorization status, confirmed before entry. Help
    text examples: "US Citizen", "Green Card Holder", "H1B (valid through
    2027)". On the website path it is auto-filled from the applicant's Visa
    Status answer. 7/7 populated - a key screening fact for clients.

--- GROUP B: THE JOB AND THE PEOPLE HANDLING IT -------------------------------

Job_Requirement__c (Job Requirement) [Lookup -> Job_Requirement__c]
    The client's open job this candidate is submitted for. Required in
    practice (validation rule for non-self-service sources; 7/7 populated)
    and, per help text, should never be changed after creation. Parent of
    the whole submission: the AM, rate type and dedupe key all derive from
    it, and the requirement's submission/interview counters count through
    this link.

Account_Manager__c (Account Manager) [Lookup -> User]
    The Account Manager who must review and approve this submission -
    auto-copied from the Job Requirement by the creating flow (7/7
    populated). Receives the "new submission" email and Slack DM, and is the
    person who runs "Submit to Client". Also the audience of the
    Expected_Margin__c field.

Submitted_By__c (Submitted By) [Lookup -> User]
    The user who ran the Submit Candidate Profile flow - auto-populated by
    the flow (7/7). Used for recruiter performance reporting ("who sourced
    this placement").

Submission_Source__c (Submission Source) [Picklist]
    Where the submission came from: Internal Recruiter (a recruiter
    submitted the candidate from the Job Requirement page) | Website
    Applicant (auto-created by "Flow 7" from a public website application) |
    Candidate Portal (reserved for portal self-submission - no automation
    uses it yet). Set by the creating flow, never by hand. Also the switch
    that exempts self-service records from the required-fields validation.
    Data: 4 Website Applicant, 3 Internal Recruiter.

--- GROUP C: LIFECYCLE STATUS & OUTCOME ---------------------------------------

Submission_Status__c (Submission Status) [Picklist]
    THE lifecycle field, driven via the Path on the record page and by
    flows. Values in pipeline order:
      - Suggested by Team: internal suggestion, pre-review (help text).
      - Pending AM Review: waiting for the Account Manager - the status
        every new submission is created with (both creation flows set it).
      - Approved: AM approved but not yet sent.
      - Submitted to Client: AM ran "Submit to Client" (requires bill rate
        + client date/time via validation rules).
      - Client Shortlisted (shown to users as "Shortlisted for Interview"):
        the client wants to interview - the state the "Create B2B
        Interview" button expects. NOTE the API name and the on-screen
        label differ.
      - Interview Scheduled / Interview Completed: written automatically by
        the interview create + outcome-sync flows.
      - Shortlisted for Next Round: auto-set when an interview outcome is
        "Moved to Next Round".
      - Offer Received: auto-set from the interview outcome (with the
        Offer_Received__c checkbox).
      - Placed: the candidate started - the terminal success state.
      - Rejected: turned down at any stage (pair with Rejection_Reason__c).
      - Withdrawn: the candidate pulled out.
    Data so far: 5 Pending AM Review, 2 Placed.

Placement_Status__c (Placement Status) [Picklist]
    Intended final-outcome rollup: Not Placed (default) | Offered (offer
    received) | Placed (candidate started) | Lost (offer declined or fell
    through). Manual entry. NEVER USED in practice (empty on all 7 records,
    including the 2 whose Submission_Status is already "Placed") - the team
    drives Submission_Status__c instead.

Rejection_Reason__c (Rejection Reason) [Picklist]
    Why a rejected submission failed: Rate High | Skill Mismatch | Visa |
    Location | Availability | No Response | Duplicate | Other. Selected
    manually when marking a submission Rejected; feeds the "Rejected
    Submissions by Reason" dashboard component. Empty on all records so far
    (nothing has been rejected yet).

Interview_Requested__c (Interview Requested) [Checkbox]
    System flag: auto-checked by the Create B2B Interview flow when an
    interview is created from this submission. Help text says "Do not
    manually edit". Drives the "Interview Requested/Scheduled" list view.
    TRUE on 2 of 7 records.

Offer_Received__c (Offer Received) [Checkbox]
    System flag: auto-checked by the Interview Outcome Sync flow when the
    client makes an offer. Used for offer tracking and submission-to-offer
    conversion-ratio reporting. TRUE on 2 of 7 records (the two Placed
    ones).

Client_Feedback__c (Client Feedback) [LongTextArea]
    What the client said about this candidate, updated after each client
    response. Help text examples: "Rate too high", "Strong technical fit
    but location concern", "Interested - scheduling interview". Manual
    entry by the AM. (Long-text - population not queryable via SOQL.)

--- GROUP D: MONEY (RATES & MARGIN) -------------------------------------------

Candidate_Rate__c (Candidate Rate) [Currency]
    What the CANDIDATE expects to be paid - per-hour rate for hourly, annual
    amount for salary (help text). Entered by the recruiter in the submit
    flow; required for the margin calculation (and by the required-fields
    rule for recruiter-path records). Snapshotted onto Interview__c
    (Candidate_Rate__c) at interview creation. 4 of 7 records filled
    (website submissions arrive without a rate).

Submitted_Bill_Rate__c (Submitted Bill Rate) [Currency]
    What Techsara bills the CLIENT for this candidate. May differ from the
    Job Requirement's Client Bill Rate if the AM negotiated differently
    (help text). Entered/confirmed by the AM in the Submit to Client flow;
    required once status is "Submitted to Client" (validation rule).
    Snapshotted onto Interview__c as Submission_Rate__c. 3 of 7 filled.

Rate_Type__c (Rate Type) [Picklist]
    How both rates are quoted: Hourly (contract positions) | Salary
    (full-time) | Daily (daily consulting rates). Defaults from the Job
    Requirement; confirmed in the submit / submit-to-client flows. Data:
    6 Hourly, 1 Salary.

Expected_Margin__c (Expected Margin) [Formula, Currency]
    Submitted_Bill_Rate__c - Candidate_Rate__c: the expected profit per
    hour (or per year) on this specific submission. Help text says it is
    meant to be visible only to Account Managers and Leadership - the
    field-level security is what enforces that, so check FLS when granting
    access to this object.

--- GROUP E: THE PITCH (CONTENT SENT TO THE CLIENT) ---------------------------

Candidate_Summary__c (Candidate Summary) [LongTextArea]
    The 3-5 sentence sales pitch: why this candidate fits - years of
    experience, key skills, availability (help text). Written by the
    recruiter in the submit flow; the AM reviews it before sending to the
    client. Required for recruiter-path records (validation rule).

Skills_Match_Notes__c (Skills Match Notes) [LongTextArea]
    Point-by-point mapping of the candidate's skills to the job's
    requirements. Help text example: "Job requires Apex - Candidate has 5
    years Apex experience." Written by the recruiter in the submit flow;
    backs up the summary during AM review and client conversations.

--- GROUP F: TIMESTAMPS, DEDUPE & SYSTEM PLUMBING -----------------------------

Internal_Submission_Date_Time__c (Internal Submission Date/Time) [DateTime]
    When the candidate was submitted INTERNALLY (recruiter -> AM).
    Auto-populated by the creating flow (7/7). Used to measure the time
    from requirement received to first internal submission - a recruiting
    speed KPI.

Client_Submission_Date_Time__c (Client Submission Date/Time) [DateTime]
    When the AM actually sent the candidate to the CLIENT. Auto-set by the
    Approve and Submit to Client flow; required whenever the status says
    "Submitted to Client" (validation rule). The internal-to-client gap
    measures AM review speed, and this field is also what the Job
    Requirement's "Client Submission Count" counts. 2 of 7 filled.

Unique_Submission_Key__c (Unique Submission Key) [Text, unique]
    Duplicate blocker: auto-generated by the creating flows as Job
    Requirement ID + Candidate ID (or Lead-based on the website path). The
    database-level unique constraint plus a flow check stop the same
    candidate being submitted twice to the same job - the flow shows an
    error and stops. 7/7 populated. Never edit by hand.

Slack_Thread_ID__c (Slack Thread ID) [Text]
    The Slack thread timestamp/ID of this submission's thread in the
    b2b-submissions channel, saved by the creating flow (7/7 populated).
    Later flows (Submit to Client, Create B2B Interview) post their updates
    as replies INTO that same thread, so each submission has one continuous
    Slack conversation. No help text on the field; system-managed.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 7 - all created on 2026-08-07 (a single build/test day).
  The B2B submission pipeline is brand new; treat every number here as
  early-days test data, not production behavior.
- Submission Status: Pending AM Review 5 | Placed 2.
- Submission Source: Website Applicant 4 | Internal Recruiter 3 (the
  Candidate Portal source is still unused).
- Rate Type: Hourly 6 | Salary 1.
- Checkboxes: Interview_Requested TRUE on 2; Offer_Received TRUE on 2.
- Population (out of 7): Applicant Name/Email, Visa Confirmation, Job
  Requirement, Account Manager, Submitted By, Internal Submission Date/Time,
  Unique Submission Key, Slack Thread ID = 7 each (the flows fill them
  reliably); Candidate 6; Lead 4; Candidate Rate 4; Submitted Bill Rate 3;
  Availability 3; Client Submission Date/Time 2; Rejection Reason 0;
  Placement Status 0 (never used - Submission_Status carries the outcome).
- Cross-reference: 8 Interview__c records point back at these 7 submissions
  (at least one submission already has a multi-round interview chain).
- Key takeaway for answering questions: this object is fully automated
  end-to-end (creation, approval, interview creation, outcome sync are all
  flows; there is no Apex on it), but the org has barely started using it -
  expect the numbers to grow quickly as the B2B path goes live.
