================================================================================
OBJECT: Opportunity  (Label: "Opportunity")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Opportunity is the STANDARD Salesforce sales-deal object: one record per
potential sale, moved through pipeline stages to Closed Won/Lost, with an
amount, probability and forecast rollups.

IN THIS ORG IT IS NOT A WORKED PIPELINE - IT IS MOSTLY AN ACCIDENTAL
BYPRODUCT OF LEAD CONVERSION. There are 658 records, but 608 of them (92%)
sit on candidate Person Accounts, were created automatically when a candidate
Lead was converted, are named after the candidate, sit untouched at the
default first stage "Qualification" with no Amount, and nobody ever works
them. The remaining 50 sit on business Accounts and are largely Salesforce
sample/demo data (names like "Acme - 300 Widgets (Sample)") plus a few test
records. Techsara's real "deal" objects are Job_Requirement__c /
Job_Submission__c (B2B staffing) and Invoice__c / Payment__c (billing) -
questions about revenue pipeline belong there, not here.

WHY THE BYPRODUCT HAPPENS: the Convert Lead button runs Lead_Conversion_Flow,
which calls the LeadConversionHandler Apex action. That handler defaults
createOpportunity = true when the flag is not supplied - and the flow does
not supply it - so every candidate conversion silently spawns an Opportunity
alongside the Person Account. This is worth knowing because these 600+ ghost
records inflate any naive "open pipeline" report and each carries the
candidate's name as the record Name.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Standard object: 24 fields visible in the metadata snapshot, 5 custom
  (4 org-local checklist fields + 1 from the PandaDoc package).
- Sharing: PRIVATE org-wide default (internal and external) - one of the few
  Private-OWD standard objects in this org; only the owner, users above them
  in the role hierarchy, and admins see a given opportunity. Owned records:
  owner defaults to whoever converted the lead or created the record.
- 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 7 list views (stock: All/My
  Opportunities, Closing This/Next Month, New This Week, Won, Default
  Opportunity Pipeline).
- Record pages: classic "Opportunity Layout" (stock sections; the four custom
  checklist fields ARE placed on it) and a plain three-column Lightning page
  (Opportunity_Record_Page_Three_Column) with no custom components or
  embedded flows. Compact layout "New Awesome Compact Layout" shows Name,
  Account, Close Date, Amount, Owner.
- Scale: 658 records in preprod, created 2024-08-06 through 2026-08-07.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All opportunities are one flavor; the org never invested in splitting
them (consistent with the object not really being used).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
THE REAL PROCESS (what actually happens today):
  STEP 1 - A recruiter converts a candidate Lead (Convert Lead button ->
    Lead_Conversion_Flow -> LeadConversionHandler Apex). Because the flow
    never sets the createOpportunity flag, the handler's default (true) makes
    the standard lead-convert also create an Opportunity on the new Person
    Account, named after the candidate.
  STEP 2 - Nothing. The record stays at stage "Qualification" (the org's
    first stage), Amount empty, Type empty, forever. 614 of 658 records
    (93%) are in exactly this state. LeadSource is carried over from the
    Lead - which is why "Customer Referral" (the dominant candidate lead
    source) covers 74% of opportunities.
  STEP 3 (rare/manual) - A handful of records were worked by hand, mostly on
    the business-account side: 18 Closed Won, 16 Closed Lost (each of the 16
    has a Loss Reason filled), 7 Negotiation, 3 Needs Analysis. Much of that
    is recognizable Salesforce sample data, not real Techsara deals.

WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN: no quotes are synced, no products/line items are used
in earnest (12 records have a price book - the sample data), no campaigns are
linked, no contracts, no PandaDoc documents. The global "New" opportunity
quick action exists on several page layouts' publishers (Job Submission,
Onboarding, Invoice, etc.) but users effectively never click it.

ROLE-HIERARCHY NOTE: because the OWD is Private, opportunity visibility
follows record ownership + role hierarchy. With 600+ conversion byproducts
owned by whichever recruiter converted each lead, any future cleanup or
ownership reshuffle (see the role-hierarchy redesign docs) touches this
object mainly as data hygiene, not as a business pipeline.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Account (AccountId): the account the deal belongs to. In practice: 608
  candidate Person Accounts (conversion byproducts) vs 50 business Accounts
  (sample/test data). This is the reverse of a normal sales org.
- User (OwnerId): the owning user - the converter/creator. Private sharing
  makes this the visibility key.
- Campaign (CampaignId, "Primary Campaign Source"): never populated (0).
- Contract (ContractId): never populated (0).
- Pricebook2 (Pricebook2Id) + OpportunityLineItem children: price book set on
  12 records (sample data); real product line items are not used.
- Quote (SyncedQuoteId): no quote has ever been synced (0). The Quote object
  exists in the org with a stock layout but is similarly idle.
- OpportunityContactRole / OpportunityCompetitor / OpportunityHistory:
  standard children present in the snapshot; nothing meaningful in them.
- Lead: not a lookup, but the origin - each converted lead points at its
  created opportunity via the standard ConvertedOpportunityId on Lead.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. No validation rules exist on Opportunity - nothing forces Amount,
Loss Reason, or stage discipline. (Consistent with nobody working the
records.)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- NO flows touch Opportunity (checked across all 135 flows), no Apex trigger
  exists for it, no scheduled job writes it.
- The ONLY code that creates Opportunity records is LeadConversionHandler
  (the @InvocableMethod behind Lead_Conversion_Flow's convert actions): its
  createOpportunity parameter defaults to true, and the flow does not pass
  it, so standard lead conversion auto-creates one opportunity per converted
  candidate. If the team ever wants to stop the ghost records, the fix is a
  one-line flow change (pass createOpportunity = false).
- Buttons: only generic quick actions (SendEmail, LogACall, NewTask,
  NewEvent, Chatter posts) on the layout; the global "New" opportunity create
  action appears in several other objects' publishers but is unused.
- Standard platform behavior still applies: StageName drives Probability and
  forecast category; ExpectedRevenue = Amount x Probability.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 24, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: CORE DEAL IDENTITY -----------------------------------------------

Name (Opportunity Name) [Text, required]
    The deal's title. On the 608 conversion byproducts this is simply THE
    CANDIDATE'S NAME (standard lead convert names the opportunity from the
    converted person when no name is supplied) - so beware: this field
    contains personal names, not deal descriptions. Sample-data records look
    like "Acme - 175 Widgets (Sample)".

AccountId (Account Name) [Lookup -> Account]
    The account the deal is on - 92% candidate Person Accounts (see part 5).
    Set automatically by lead conversion; manual on hand-made records.

OwnerId (Owner) [Lookup -> User]
    Owning user; with Private OWD this controls who can see the record.
    Defaults to the converting/creating user.

IsPrivate (Private) [Checkbox]
    Standard "extra private" flag hiding the deal even from the owner's
    reports-to chain. Never used (no reason to - the OWD is already
    Private).

Description (Description) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text notes about the deal. (Long text - population not queryable
    via aggregate; no evidence of use.)

--- GROUP B: STAGE, MONEY & FORECASTING ---------------------------------------

StageName (Stage) [Picklist, required]
    The pipeline stage. This org's configured stages (with probability and
    forecast category): Qualification 10% (Pipeline) | Needs Analysis 35%
    (Pipeline) | Proposal 75% (Best Case) | Negotiation 90% (Forecast) |
    Closed Won 100% (Closed) | Closed Lost 0% (Omitted). Note the stock
    "Prospecting" stage was removed - Qualification is the entry stage, and
    93% of all records still sit there. "Proposal" has never been used
    (0 records).

Probability (Probability (%)) [Percent]
    Auto-defaulted from the stage (see percentages above); editable per
    record but nobody overrides it here.

Amount (Amount) [Currency]
    Deal value. Populated on only 50 of 658 records (8%) - exactly the
    business-account sample/test records; every conversion byproduct has no
    amount. Org-wide SUM(Amount) = 1,167,500 (sample data money, not real
    revenue - real revenue lives in Invoice__c/Payment__c).

ExpectedRevenue (Expected Revenue) [Currency, system formula]
    Amount x Probability, computed by the platform for forecasting. Empty
    wherever Amount is empty.

CloseDate (Close Date) [Date, required]
    Expected/actual close date. 100% populated because it is required -
    lead conversion fills it automatically on the byproduct records.

NextStep (Next Step) [Text]
    Short "what happens next" note. Populated on 7 records only.

Type (Type) [Picklist]
    Deal flavor: Existing Business | New Business. Populated on just 50
    records (37 Existing / 13 New - the sample data); conversion byproducts
    leave it blank.

--- GROUP C: SOURCE & MARKETING LINKS -----------------------------------------

LeadSource (Lead Source) [Picklist]
    Where the deal ultimately came from, inherited from the converted Lead.
    Distribution mirrors the candidate-lead funnel, not a sales funnel:
    Customer Referral 484 (74%) | blank 40 | LinkedIn 27 | External Referral
    23 | Employee Referral 19 | Other 15 | Advertisement 9 | Website 8 |
    Customer Event 7 | Trade Show 6 | Partner 6 | Purchased List 5 | Google
    AdWords 4 | Webinar 4 | Instagram 1. (Global value set shared with Lead;
    "Facebook" exists as a value but has no records.)

CampaignId (Primary Campaign Source) [Lookup -> Campaign]
    Which campaign sourced this deal - never populated (0 records), matching
    the empty Campaign object.

--- GROUP D: SALES QUALIFICATION CHECKLIST (CUSTOM - ALL UNUSED) --------------
These four fields are the org's only own customization. They match the
starter "sales path guidance" fields Salesforce ships in new orgs, are placed
on the classic layout, and have NEVER been used - all three checkboxes are
false on all 658 records. (Whether anyone consciously created them or they
came with org setup: not fully documented - verify with team.)

Budget_Confirmed__c (Budget Confirmed) [Checkbox]
    Meant to be ticked once the buyer's budget is verified. 0 records true.

Discovery_Completed__c (Discovery Completed) [Checkbox]
    Meant to be ticked after the discovery call. 0 records true.

ROI_Analysis_Completed__c (ROI Analysis Completed) [Checkbox]
    Meant to be ticked once an ROI analysis was done. 0 records true.

Loss_Reason__c (Loss Reason) [Picklist]
    Why a deal was lost: Lost to Competitor | No Budget / Lost Funding |
    No Decision / Non-Responsive | Price | Other. The one checklist field
    with any data: filled on exactly the 16 Closed Lost records (Lost to
    Competitor 6, Price 3, No Decision 3, No Budget 2, Other 2) - i.e. the
    sample-data losses. Manual entry; no validation rule enforces it.

--- GROUP E: PRODUCTS, QUOTES & CONTRACTS (STANDARD - IDLE) -------------------

Pricebook2Id (Price Book) [Lookup -> Pricebook2]
    Which price book the deal's products come from. Set on 12 records
    (sample data with line items); irrelevant otherwise.

SyncedQuoteId (Synced Quote) [Lookup -> Quote]
    The quote currently syncing its totals to this deal. Never populated (0).

ContractId (Contract) [Lookup -> Contract]
    Related contract. Never populated (0).

TotalOpportunityQuantity (Quantity) [Number]
    Standard total-product-quantity field. NOT QUERYABLE via the API in this
    org (the field is not enabled/visible to the integration user); appears
    only in the metadata snapshot. Treat as unavailable.

--- GROUP F: PACKAGE & PLATFORM FIELDS ----------------------------------------

pandadoc__TrackingNumber__c (Tracking Number) [Text, PandaDoc package]
    Correlation id the installed PandaDoc e-signature package would stamp to
    link a generated document to this deal. Never populated (0) - PandaDoc
    is not used on opportunities here.

IqScore (-) [Einstein score, OIQ package]
    Einstein Opportunity Scoring field surfaced by the installed OIQ
    package. NOT QUERYABLE in this org (feature not provisioned) - it exists
    only as a metadata stub and can hold no usable data.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 658, created 2024-08-06 to 2026-08-07 (by year: 2024: 53,
  2025: 352, 2026: 253 - tracking the lead-conversion volume, not sales).
- Account split: 608 on candidate Person Accounts (92%, the lead-conversion
  byproducts) vs 50 on business Accounts (largely Salesforce "(Sample)"
  demo records).
- Stage: Qualification 614 (93%) | Closed Won 18 | Closed Lost 16 |
  Negotiation 7 | Needs Analysis 3 | Proposal 0.
- LeadSource: Customer Referral 484 (74%), then LinkedIn 27, External
  Referral 23, Employee Referral 19, blank 40, long tail under 16 each.
- Field population: CloseDate 100% (required); Amount 50 (8%, SUM =
  1,167,500 - sample money); Type 50; Loss_Reason__c 16 (= the Closed Lost
  records); Pricebook2Id 12; NextStep 7; CampaignId, ContractId,
  SyncedQuoteId, pandadoc__TrackingNumber__c all 0; Budget_Confirmed__c /
  Discovery_Completed__c / ROI_Analysis_Completed__c true on 0 records.
- Key takeaway for answering questions: Opportunity is NOT Techsara's sales
  pipeline. 92% of records are auto-created ghosts from candidate lead
  conversion (LeadConversionHandler defaults createOpportunity = true);
  the rest is sample data. Real deal/revenue questions route to
  Job_Requirement__c / Job_Submission__c and Invoice__c / Payment__c.

################################################################################
################################################################################
PART 4: INTERVIEWING (EXTERNAL / CLIENT INTERVIEWS)
################################################################################
################################################################################

================================================================================
================================================================================
OBJECT: Interview__c  (Label: "Interview")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Interview__c records ONE interview of a Techsara candidate with an OUTSIDE
company - either a Techsara B2B client (via a Job Requirement / Job Submission)
or an open-market employer the candidate applied to under a candidate-marketing
engagement. One record = one round of one interview process (Initial call,
First round, Second round ... Final round). If a candidate goes through 4
rounds with one company, that is 4 Interview__c records.

It is the single largest object in the org (217 custom fields) because it
carries five jobs at once:
  a) The interview logistics themselves (who, when, which company, what round,
     meeting links, timezone).
  b) The "interview support" workflow - the internal process where an employee
     raises a request for another employee (a support person) or a vendor
     ("proxy support") to help the candidate through the interview.
  c) The AI ("COMPASS") support-person assignment - an external AWS-hosted AI
     engine that automatically picks which employee should support each
     interview, plus the audit trail of reassignments.
  d) The employee incentive/credit system - completed interviews earn the
     support person credits and bonus/penalty amounts depending on the outcome.
  e) The COMPASS skill-scoring engine - after each supported interview, the
     external engine updates the support person's per-skill confidence ratings
     (Kalman-filter based) and writes a full audit of that math onto the
     interview record.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, part of the Interviewing domain.
- MASTER-DETAIL CHILD OF ACCOUNT via Candidate__c: every interview MUST belong
  to a candidate (Person Account). Sharing is "Controlled By Parent" - whoever
  can see the candidate can see the interview. The interview has no owner of
  its own.
- 217 custom fields, 3 record types, 7 validation rules, 28 list views.
- Auto-number Name in the format I-XXXXXX (e.g. I-031360).
- Scale: ~9,991 records in preprod (data from Jul 2024 to today; some future-
  dated because interviews are scheduled ahead).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES (3)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- "Interview" (developer name: Interview) - the default and by far the most
  common type (~97% of records). Used for candidate-marketing interviews:
  the candidate interviews with an open-market company (company_new__c ->
  Company__c master list).
- "Initial Call" (Initial_Call) - the first touch-point call in the marketing
  pipeline (~2.5% of records). Matches the Marketing__c status "Initial Call".
- "B2B Interviews" (B2B_Interviews) - interviews for a Techsara B2B client's
  Job Requirement, created from a Job Submission. Very new/rare in data (only
  9 records so far) but this is the strategic B2B path. These records must
  have Job_Requirement__c and Job_Submission__c filled (validation rule).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATION. Two main entry points:
  - B2B path: on a Job Submission record, a user clicks the "Create B2B
    Interview" button (screen flow B2B_Create_Interview_from_Submission -
    internally nicknamed "Flow 4 - Create Interview"). The flow copies
    everything it can from the Job Submission: candidate, Lead, Job
    Requirement, client account, account manager, recruiter, applicant email,
    and snapshots the money fields (candidate rate, submitted bill rate). It
    also marks the Job Submission "Interview Requested", bumps the Job
    Requirement's interview counter, and sends confirmation emails plus Slack
    messages.
  - Marketing path: the screen flow Interview_Creation_V2 creates the
    interview directly (recruiter picks the candidate, company - it can create
    a new Company__c on the fly - position, round, date/time, interviewer
    name/email, JD/resume links, etc.).
  NOTE: the "Create Interview" buttons on Candidate (Account) and Lead pages
  create INTERNAL_INTERVIEW__c records (internal screening), NOT Interview__c.

STEP 2 - AUTO-ENRICHMENT ON SAVE. Before the record saves, flows copy the
  candidate's Project Understanding Document onto it, link the matching
  Application__c, stamp candidate/recruiter names, and compute IST-converted
  start/end times (the team operates across US timezones and IST). After save,
  Apex creates a Google Calendar event for it, and a Slack reminder to the
  recruiter is scheduled near the interview time.

STEP 3 - SUPPORT REQUEST (OPTIONAL BUT CENTRAL). The scheduling employee can
  tick "Request Raised" to ask for interview support. That fires a Slack post
  to the support team AND auto-creates a Case linked to this interview so the
  request is tracked as a ticket. The request then moves through Approve_Stage
  (Ready -> Submitted -> Assigned -> Completed/Rejected). Assigning a Vendor
  ("Proxy Support") automatically sets Approve_Stage to "Assigned" (Apex
  trigger) and notifies Slack.

STEP 4 - AI SUPPORT-PERSON ASSIGNMENT (COMPASS). An external AI service on AWS
  (called via named-credential callouts) picks the best internal employee
  (Interview_Support_Person__c) for each interview based on skill confidence
  scores, availability, workload caps and constraints. It runs as a nightly
  batch and on demand. Humans can override it from buttons on the interview
  page: Reassignment, Reshuffle, Rollback, PSP (set preferred support person) -
  each of these calls the AWS service and writes an audit row to
  AI_Assignment_Logs__c. These buttons/panels are only visible to users with
  the Run_AI_Interview_Assignment custom permission. In practice ~73% of all
  interviews have been AI-assigned.

STEP 5 - THE INTERVIEW HAPPENS, STATUS IS UPDATED. Users drive
  Interview_Status__c through the Path on the record page: Scheduled ->
  Completed (or Rescheduled / Cancelled / No Show). Rescheduling or cancelling
  requires a Status Reason. The result is recorded in Interview_Outcome__c:
  Moved to Next Round, Rejected, Offer Received, or NA. "Ghosted" (the company
  never responded) can NOT be set manually - a daily scheduled flow
  automatically marks interviews Ghosted when 14 days pass after the interview
  date with no outcome (the per-record "Bypass Ghosted Validation" checkbox
  exempts a record from this sweep).

STEP 6 - DOWNSTREAM EFFECTS OF THE OUTCOME.
  - B2B: a flow syncs the outcome back to the Job Submission (status, offer
    received flag) and emails the candidate (next-round / offer / rejection
    templates).
  - Moving forward: "Offer Received" requires the Offer Letter Date; a
    successful placement leads to Background_Check__c and Onboarding__c
    records downstream.
  - Incentives: when the interview completes, the incentive framework stamps
    the round multiplier from metadata config; formulas then compute the
    weighted credit and a positive (+400 per outcome "Moved to Next Round" /
    "Offer Received") or negative (-100 for "Rejected"/"Ghosted") incentive for
    the support person.
  - Scoring: the external COMPASS engine updates the support person's
    per-skill ratings from the outcome and writes the full calculation audit
    (before/after scores, Kalman parameters) onto the interview.
  - Prep sessions: from the interview page a recruiter can click "Schedule
    Session" to book a training/prep Session__c linked back to the interview.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Account (via Candidate__c, MASTER-DETAIL, required, 100% populated). The
  candidate this interview is for. The interview inherits sharing from the
  candidate. Interviews feed candidate-level metrics (Total_Interviews__c,
  expected-interview pacing, Candidate_Status__c lifecycle).

LOOKUPS FROM INTERVIEW TO OTHER OBJECTS:
- Job_Submission__c (Job_Submission__c): the B2B submission this interview was
  created from. Source of the rate snapshots. B2B-only (8 records so far).
- Job_Requirement__c (Job_Requirement__c): the client's open job req (B2B).
  Auto-copied from the submission. The req counts its interviews.
- Application__c (Application__c): the marketing-side daily application batch
  that produced this interview ("this interview came from the applications we
  made for the candidate on that day").
- Marketing__c (Marketing__c): the candidate-marketing engagement this
  interview belongs to (marketing-sourced interviews).
- Lead (Lead__c): the original website lead, for interviews created before/
  without a converted candidate. Either Candidate or Lead must be present
  (validation rule).
- Account as client (Client_Account__c): the Techsara B2B client company
  (business Account) - reserved for the B2B path (currently always empty in
  data; the flow populates it going forward).
- Company__c (company_new__c, label "Company"): which outside company the
  candidate is interviewing with, from the company master list (98% populated -
  this is the normal "which company" field for marketing interviews).
- Recruiter__c / "Employee" - FOUR different roles:
    * Recruiter__c (field): the recruiter handling this candidate/interview.
    * Interview_Support_Person__c: the employee assigned (usually by the AI)
      to support the candidate through this interview.
    * Preferred_Support_Person__c / Previous_Support_Person__c: preferred pick
      and the pre-reassignment support person (AI reassignment history).
    * Interviewer_Assignment_Constraint__c: a pinned employee the AI engine
      must honor when assigning (e.g. "must interview with X").
- Vendor__c (Vendor__c, label "Proxy Support"): the third-party vendor or
  in-house proxy providing support services on the call.
- User (Account_Manager__c): the AM who owns the client relationship (B2B,
  auto-filled from the Job Requirement).
- User (User_Initiated_By__c, Reassignment_Initiated_By__c): audit of who
  triggered AI runs / reassignments.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT INTERVIEW (children / references):
- Interview_Participant__c (MASTER-DETAIL child): the attendee roster of the
  call - one row per person (candidate, client interviewer, internal support,
  observer...) with side, role, and join/leave attendance audit. (Object is
  deployed but has no data yet in preprod.)
- Session__c (lookup Session__c.Interview__c): a concrete scheduled Zoom/
  calendar meeting booked for or around this interview (e.g. a prep session
  booked via the "Schedule Session" button).
- Case (lookup Case.Interview__c): internal ops tickets raised about this
  interview - including the auto-created "interview support request" Case and
  one-off issues (proxy exception, recording request, scheduling problem).
- Background_Check__c (lookup): the post-offer verification/payment-agreement
  record tied back to the interview that won the offer.
- AI_Assignment_Logs__c (two lookups: Interview__c and legacy Interview_ID__c):
  audit rows for every AI assignment/reassignment/reshuffle/rollback run.
- Zoom_Recording_Access_Log__c (lookup): who accessed this interview's Zoom
  recording, when (compliance logging).

EXPLICIT NON-RELATIONSHIPS (common confusions):
- Interview_Evaluation__c has NO relationship to Interview__c. It is a child
  of Internal_Interview__c (internal screening evaluations).
- Internal_Interview__c has no direct link to Interview__c; they share only
  the candidate.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules, all active)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- B2B_Interview_Needs_Submission: B2B-Requirement interviews must have both
  Job Submission and Job Requirement filled.
- Interview_Candidate_OR_Lead_Required: either Candidate or Lead must be
  linked (B2B interviews can precede lead conversion).
- Offer_Requires_OfferLetterDate: cannot set status "Offer Received" without
  filling Offer Letter Date.
- Prevent_Manual_Ghosted: users cannot set the outcome to "Ghosted" manually -
  it is system-managed (set automatically 14 days after the interview date by
  the scheduled flow).
- Requires_Status_Reason: a Status Reason is required when status becomes
  Rescheduled, Cancelled, or No Show.
- Require_Comment_For_Other: Status Reason Comment is required when the Status
  Reason chosen is "Other".
- Edit_Interview_Support_Person: only authorized users (custom permission
  Edit_Interview_Support_Person) may change the Interview Support Person.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOWS (active):
- Copy_Project_Understanding_Document_from_Candidate (before save, create):
  copies the candidate's PU document link onto the interview.
- Interview_Record_Initial_Call_Flow (before save, create): finds the matching
  Application__c from candidate+recruiter, stamps Candidate_Name__c /
  Recruiter_Name__c and the record type; blocks the save if lookups fail.
- Interview_IST_Time_Population (before save, create+update): converts the
  schedule to IST (IST_Start_Time__c / IST_End_Time__c).
- Interview_Status_Change (before save): flips the Status_Change__c flag when
  the outcome is set.
- Interview_Incentive_Calculation_Framework (before save, update on status):
  reads Interview_Incentive_Configuration__mdt for the round and stamps
  Round_Multiplier_New__c + Incentive_Calculated_On__c.
- Slack_Notification_When_There_is_an_interview (after save + scheduled path):
  Slack interview reminder to the recruiter near interview time; stamps
  Final_Notification_Date_Time__c.
- Interview_Support_Request (after save, when Request_Raised = true): Slack
  post of the full support request (candidate, company, round, IST times,
  JD/resume links) to the support team.
- Interview_Request_Case_Flow (after save, when Request_Raised becomes true):
  creates the tracking Case (subject, deadline, owner, priority, tags).
- B2B_Interview_Outcome_Sync_With_Job_Submission_Flow (after save, on status/
  outcome change): updates the Job Submission, emails the candidate
  (next-round / offer / rejection), marks the Job Requirement filled when all
  openings are placed.

SCHEDULED FLOW:
- Auto_Update_Interview_records_to_Ghosted (daily): marks past interviews with
  no outcome as Ghosted after the 14-day cutoff, unless "Bypass Ghosted
  Validation" is checked.

APEX TRIGGER (InterviewTrigger -> InterviewTriggerHandler):
- After insert: creates the Google Calendar event (GoogleCalendarAPI), gated
  by a custom label switch.
- Before update: when Vendor (Proxy Support) is set, auto-sets Approve_Stage
  to "Assigned".
- After update: Slack notification when the support assignment happens
  (SlackCalloutHelper), gated by a custom label switch.

SCREEN FLOWS / BUTTONS ON THE PAGE:
- Create paths: B2B_Create_Interview_from_Submission (from Job Submission);
  Interview_Creation_V2 (marketing path).
- Reassignment / Reshuffle / Rollback / PSP buttons: human overrides of the AI
  assignment; each calls the AWS AI service and logs to AI_Assignment_Logs__c.
  Visible only with the Run_AI_Interview_Assignment custom permission.
- View Recording: opens the interview recording and logs the access.
- Schedule Session: books a prep/training Session__c linked to the interview.
- Approve Support Request: defined but not placed on any page (currently
  unreachable; its flow is still Draft).

EXTERNAL WRITERS (important!): the COMPASS AI engine on AWS writes back to
Interview__c through the API. ALL of the AI-suggestion fields, assignment
fields and the ~70 scoring/Kalman fields (section 8, groups J and L) are
written by that external service - no Apex class or flow in the org sets them.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 217, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: THE CANDIDATE ---------------------------------------------------

Candidate__c (Candidate) [Master-Detail -> Account]
    THE required parent link: which candidate (Person Account) this interview
    belongs to. 100% populated. Everything else about the interview hangs off
    this relationship, including record sharing.

Candidate_Name__c (Candidate Name) [Text]
    Denormalized copy of the candidate's name, stamped by the
    Interview_Record_Initial_Call_Flow at creation. Kept as text so lists/
    reports don't need the relationship.

Candidate_Name_For__c (Candidate Name) [Formula, Text]
    Live formula version of the candidate's name (FirstName + LastName from
    the linked Account). Always current even if the Account is renamed
    (unlike the stamped text field above).

Candidate_Phone_Number__c (Candidate Phone Number) [Formula, Text]
    Live formula pulling the candidate's phone from the Account.

Candidate_Status__c (Candidate Status) [Formula, Text]
    Live formula showing the candidate's overall lifecycle status from the
    Account (In Progress / Active / Hold / Placed / Terminate ...). Lets users
    see the candidate's state without leaving the interview.

Applicant_Email__c (Applicant Email) [Email]
    The candidate's email as it was on the Job Submission, auto-copied by the
    B2B Create Interview flow ("Flow 4"). Used in interview email templates.

Lead__c (Lead) [Lookup -> Lead]
    The original website Lead, for interviews scheduled before the lead was
    converted to a candidate. Auto-populated from the Job Submission by the
    B2B create flow. Validation: either Candidate or Lead must be present.

Is_Lead_Populated__c (Is Lead Populated) [Formula, Checkbox]
    TRUE when Lead__c is filled - a helper for reports/automation entry
    criteria.

--- GROUP B: THE COMPANY BEING INTERVIEWED WITH ------------------------------

company_new__c (Company) [Lookup -> Company__c]
    Which outside company the candidate is interviewing with, from the
    Company__c master list (market intelligence: tier, difficulty, typical
    rounds). This is the normal "company" field - 98% populated. Named
    "company_new" because it replaced the free-text Company__c field below.

Company__c (Company) [Text]
    LEGACY free-text company name, kept for old records and used inside
    dedupe keys. New records should use company_new__c instead.

Company_Name__c (Company Name) [Formula, Text]
    Displays the linked Company__c record's name (empty if no link).

Client_Account__c (Client Account) [Lookup -> Account]
    The Techsara B2B CLIENT company (a business Account) - only for B2B-
    requirement interviews, auto-copied from the Job Requirement by the create
    flow. Distinct from company_new__c: Client_Account__c = our paying client;
    company_new__c = any market employer. (Currently empty on all records -
    the B2B flavor is brand new.)

Position__c (Position) [Text]
    The job title / role the candidate is interviewing for (e.g. "Software
    Engineer", "Sr. Account Executive").

Salary_Compensation__c (Salary Compensation) [Text]
    The compensation discussed/offered for the position, entered by the
    recruiter at creation (marketing path).

Employment_Type__c (Employment Type) [Picklist]
    The engagement type of the target job: Full-Time | C2C | W2 Contract |
    B2B | Contract | Contract-to-Hire | Full Time. (Note: "Full-Time" and
    "Full Time" both exist - legacy duplicate values.)

--- GROUP C: PIPELINE LINKS (WHERE THIS INTERVIEW CAME FROM) ------------------

Interview_Source__c (Interview Source) [Picklist]
    Which pipeline produced this interview: B2B Requirement | Candidate
    Marketing | Other. Auto-set to "B2B Requirement" by the B2B create flow.
    Mostly empty on legacy data (the record type carries the same signal).

Job_Submission__c (Job Submission) [Lookup -> Job_Submission__c]
    The exact candidate-to-job-requirement submission this interview belongs
    to (B2B). Auto-populated by the B2B create flow. Required for B2B records.

Job_Requirement__c (Job Requirement) [Lookup -> Job_Requirement__c]
    The client's open job requirement (B2B). Auto-copied from the submission.
    Required for B2B records.

Application__c (Application) [Lookup -> Application__c]
    The marketing-side daily application log that led to this interview.
    Auto-linked at creation by matching candidate + recruiter.

Marketing__c (Marketing) [Lookup -> Marketing__c]
    The candidate-marketing engagement this interview belongss to (marketing-
    sourced interviews only).

Candidate_Rate__c (Candidate Rate) [Currency]
    SNAPSHOT of the candidate's pay rate copied from the Job Submission when
    the interview was created. Deliberately frozen: later edits to the
    submission don't change what was true at scheduling time.

Submission_Rate__c (Submission Rate) [Currency]
    SNAPSHOT of the bill rate submitted to the client (from Job Submission
    "Submitted Bill Rate") at interview creation. Same snapshot logic.

--- GROUP D: SCHEDULING (DATES & TIMES) --------------------------------------

Schedule_Date__c (Schedule Date) [Date]
    The date the interview was BOOKED/REQUESTED - i.e. when our employee
    raised/scheduled it. Compare with Date_of_Interview__c below.

Date_of_Interview__c (Date of Interview) [Date]
    The date the interview actually TAKES PLACE - the (usually future) date
    the candidate will appear in front of the company. Drives the ghosted
    sweep, the month rollups, and the 14-day cutoff. Example: an interview
    requested on Aug 7 for Aug 13 has Schedule_Date = Aug 7 and
    Date_of_Interview = Aug 13.

StartTime__c (Start Time) [Picklist, global value set "Times"]
    Interview start time, chosen from a shared list of time slots (e.g.
    "10:00 AM"). This is the CURRENT start-time field.

EndTime__c (End Time) [Picklist, global value set "Times"]
    Interview end time, from the same shared time-slot list. Current field.

Start_Time__c (Start Time(Do Not Use)) [Time]
    DEPRECATED old start-time field (native Time type). Label says "Do Not
    Use"; kept for historic data.

End_Time__c (End Time(Do Not Use)) [Time]
    DEPRECATED old end-time field. Do not use.

Start_Time_Text__c (Start Time Text) [Formula, Text]
    Formats the deprecated Start_Time__c into "h:mm AM/PM" text (legacy
    display helper).

End_Time_Text__c (End Time Text) [Formula, Text]
    Same formatting helper for the deprecated End_Time__c.

Interview_Time_Zone__c (Interview Time Zone) [Picklist]
    Timezone the interview times are quoted in: ET | CT | MT | PT | AT | HT |
    UTC. Candidates interview across US timezones while the support team is in
    India - hence the IST conversion fields below.

IST_Start_Time__c (IST Start Time) [Text]
IST_End_Time__c (IST End Time) [Text]
    The interview start/end converted to Indian Standard Time, auto-computed
    by the Interview_IST_Time_Population flow whenever the date/times/timezone
    change. This is what the India-based support team reads.

Scheduled_Minutes__c (Scheduled Minutes) [Formula, Number]
    Planned duration in minutes, computed from StartTime/EndTime picklists.
    Feeds Base_Credit__c (longer interviews earn more credit).

Cutoff_Date__c (Cutoff Date) [Formula, Date]
    Date_of_Interview + 14 days - the deadline after which an outcome-less
    interview is auto-marked "Ghosted" by the daily sweep.

Interview_Month__c (Interview Month) [Formula, Date]
    First day of the interview's month - a grouping key for monthly reports.

Is_Current_Month__c (Is_Current_Month) [Formula, Checkbox]
    TRUE when the interview date falls in the current calendar month - used
    for "this month" list views/reports.

--- GROUP E: ROUND & FORMAT CLASSIFICATION -----------------------------------

Round__c (Round) [Picklist]
    Which round of the company's process this record represents: Initial |
    First | Second | ... | Fifteenth | Final. Real data is mostly Initial/
    First/Second; the long tail exists because prep/mock rounds also get
    logged. The round drives the credit multiplier.

Round_Info__c (Round Info) [Picklist]
    WHAT KIND of round it is: Hiring Manager | Leet code style Coding |
    System Design | Coding Frontend | Backend Coding | AI/ML Coding | Offer
    Negotiation | Final Round | Introduction Call | Technical Discussion |
    Executive Round | Behavioral Round | Coding Round | Healthcare Round |
    Preparation Round | Team Matching Round | Other | None. This is the field
    the COMPASS engine uses to know which skill track the interview tests.

Round_Info_if_Other__c (Round Info if (Other)) [TextArea]
    Free-text description when Round_Info = "Other".

Round_Number__c (Round Number) [Number]
    Numeric round sequence (1, 2, 3...) used by code/reporting; historically
    backfilled by the InterviewRoundNumberBackfill Apex job.

Is_Loop_Round__c (Is Loop Round?) [Checkbox]
    Marks a "loop" interview - several back-to-back rounds compressed into
    one day (common at big tech companies).

Interview_Type__c (Interview Type) [Picklist]
    Screening Round | Technical Round | HR Round | Interview. Essentially
    unused in practice (populated on only 2 of ~10k records) - Round_Info__c
    is the field that actually carries this meaning.

Interview_Mode__c (Interview Mode) [Picklist]
    Audio | Onsite | Video. NEVER USED in practice (100% empty) - Call_Type__c
    below is the field the team actually fills.

Call_Type__c (Call Type) [Picklist]
    How the interview call happens: Zoom video call | Google meet video call |
    Microsoft Teams Video Call | Normal phone call | Other.

--- GROUP F: STATUS & OUTCOME ------------------------------------------------

Interview_Status__c (Interview Status) [Picklist]
    The lifecycle state, driven by users via the Path on the record page:
    Scheduled | Completed | Rescheduled | Cancelled | No Show | Ghosted |
    Loop Round | Moved to Next Round | Offer Received | Rejected.
    In practice ~68% of records end at "Completed"; the outcome field below
    carries the final result. Rescheduled/Cancelled/No Show require a Status
    Reason (validation rule).

Interview_Outcome__c (Interview Outcome) [Picklist]
    The RESULT of the interview: Moved to Next Round | Rejected | Ghosted |
    Offer Received | NA. "Ghosted" cannot be chosen manually - the daily flow
    sets it 14 days after the interview date if the company never responded.
    Outcome drives incentives (positive for Moved to Next Round / Offer
    Received; negative for Rejected / Ghosted) and the B2B submission sync.

Status_New_Reason__c (Status  Reason) [Picklist]
    WHY the status changed - required for Rescheduled / Cancelled / No Show.
    Long picklist covering who caused it and how: candidate requested change,
    interviewer requested change, scheduling conflict, time zone confusion,
    technical issue, candidate/interviewer no show, joined late beyond cutoff,
    wrong meeting link, candidate withdrew, company cancelled role, position
    filled, duplicate interview, etc.

Status_Reason__c (Outcome Reason) [Picklist]
    Categorizes WHY the outcome went the way it did: Candidate Issue |
    Support Issue | Network Issue | AI Issue | Company Issue | Work Auth/Visa
    Mismatch | NA. Despite the API name, its label is "Outcome Reason" -
    don't confuse it with Status_New_Reason__c above.

Status_Reason_Comment__c (Status Reason Comment) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text explanation; required when the reason chosen is "Other".

Status_Change__c (Status Change) [Checkbox]
    System flag flipped by the Interview_Status_Change flow when the outcome
    is set - used by downstream automation to detect "something changed".
    Not meant for manual use.

Offer_Letter_Date__c (Offer Letter Date) [Date]
    Date the offer letter was received. MUST be filled before status can be
    set to "Offer Received" (validation rule).

Advanced_to_Next_Round__c (Advanced to Next Round?) [Picklist: Yes | No]
    Did the candidate clear this round? Used in the vendor/support success
    tracking reports (was the supported interview successful?).

If_yes_why__c (If yes why?) [LongTextArea]
    Companion free-text to the Yes/No question above - why/how the round was
    cleared (e.g. what the support contributed). Used in vendor success
    tracking. (Exact on-screen pairing not fully documented - verify with
    team.)

IsValidated__c (Bypass Ghosted Validation) [Checkbox]
    Per-record escape hatch: when checked, the daily "auto-Ghosted" sweep
    skips this record. The API name is misleading - read it as
    "Bypass_Ghosted_Validation".

Rejected_Flag__c (Rejected Flag) [Formula, Number]
    1 when outcome = Rejected, else 0 - a summable flag for report math
    (rejection rates).

--- GROUP G: MEETING LOGISTICS & CALENDAR/ZOOM INTEGRATION -------------------

Interview_Meeting_Link__c (Interview Meeting Link) [Url]
    The meeting link the candidate must join (whatever platform the company
    uses). Entered by the scheduler; help text: "Please provide the interview
    meeting link here."

Zoom_Meeting_Id__c (Zoom Meeting Id) [Text]
Zoom_Join_URL__c (Zoom Join URL) [Url]
Zoom_Start_URL__c (Zoom Start URL) [Url]
Zoom_Passcode__c (Zoom Passcode) [Text]
    Zoom meeting details when the interview (or its support call) runs on
    Techsara's Zoom: the meeting id, the participant join link, the host
    start link, and the passcode. Populated by the Zoom integration (~60% of
    records have a Zoom meeting id).

Google_Calendar_Id__c (Google Calendar Id) [Text]
Calendar_Event_Id__c (Calendar Event Id) [Text]
Google_Event_Url__c (Google Event Url) [TextArea]
Calendar_Status__c (Calendar Status) [Text]
    Google Calendar wiring: the calendar/event ids, a link to the event, and
    the sync status. Created by the Apex GoogleCalendarAPI integration right
    after the interview is inserted (~68% of records have a calendar id).

Google_Docs_ID__c (Google Docs ID) [LongTextArea]
Google_Docs_URL__c (Google Docs URL) [Url]
    Google Doc attached to the interview (shared prep/notes document created
    for the session).

--- GROUP H: CONTENT, PREP MATERIAL & FEEDBACK -------------------------------

Job_Description__c (Job Description) [LongTextArea]
    The full JD text for the role being interviewed for.

JD_Link_url__c (JD Link) [LongTextArea]
    Link(s) to the job description posting. This is the CURRENT JD-link field.

JD_Link__c (JD Link(Do Not Use)) [Url]
    DEPRECATED single-URL version of the JD link. Do not use.

Resume_Link__c (Resume Link) [Url]
    Link to the resume version the candidate is using for this interview.

Interview_Questions__c (Interview Questions) [LongTextArea]
    Questions asked / expected in this interview (knowledge capture for
    later rounds and other candidates at the same company).

Interview_Notes__c (Interview Notes) [LongTextArea]
    Prep notes for the candidate: client instructions, interview format,
    topics to prepare (from the field's help text).

Description__c (Description) [LongTextArea]
    General free-form notes about the interview.

Project_Understanding_Document__c (Project Understanding Document) [LongTextArea]
    Link/content of the candidate's "project understanding" document -
    auto-copied from the candidate Account when the interview is created, so
    the support person has the candidate's project story at hand.

Candidate_Feedback__c (Candidate Feedback) [LongTextArea]
    What the candidate reported after the interview (how it went, what was
    asked).

Client_Feedback__c (Client Feedback) [LongTextArea]
    Feedback from the client/company side (B2B path - what the client said
    about the candidate).

Vendor_Feedback__c (Vendor Feedback) [LongTextArea]
    Feedback about/from the proxy-support vendor on this interview - part of
    vendor success tracking.

--- GROUP I: INTERVIEW SUPPORT REQUEST WORKFLOW ------------------------------

Request_Raised__c (Request Raised) [Checkbox]
    THE trigger of the support workflow: the scheduling employee checks this
    to request interview support. Firing it sends the Slack support-request
    post and auto-creates the tracking Case.

Approve_Stage__c (Approve Stage) [Picklist]
    Stage of the support request: Ready | Submitted | Assigned | Rejected |
    Completed. Auto-set to "Assigned" by the Apex trigger when a Vendor
    (Proxy Support) is placed on the record.

Vendor__c (Proxy Support) [Lookup -> Vendor__c]
    Which vendor (or in-house proxy) provides support services during this
    interview. Setting it advances the Approve Stage and notifies Slack.
    (Note the label: users see "Proxy Support", not "Vendor".)

Vendor_Name__c (Vendor Name) [Text]
    Denormalized/legacy text of the vendor's name.

Interview_Support_provided__c (Interview Support provided?) [Checkbox]
    Post-interview record of whether support was actually delivered.

Support_not_provided_reason__c (Support not provided reason) [LongTextArea]
    Why support was NOT delivered when it had been requested/assigned.

Support_Notes__c (Support Notes) [Html]
    Rich-text working notes for the support engagement (what to focus on,
    logistics). Included in the Slack support-request message.

Interviewer_s_Name__c (Interviewer Name) [Text]
Interviewer_s_Email__c (Interviewer Email) [Text]
    Name and email of the interviewer on the COMPANY side (the person who
    will interview the candidate), as told to us by the company/candidate.

Recruiter_s_Name__c (Recruiter's Name (Company)) [Text]
Recruiter_s_Email__c (Recruiter's Email (Company)) [Text]
    The OUTSIDE company's recruiter/coordinator contact for this interview
    (not a Techsara employee - contrast with Recruiter__c below).

--- GROUP J: AI SUPPORT-PERSON ASSIGNMENT (COMPASS) --------------------------
All fields in this group are owned by the external AWS "COMPASS" AI service
and its launcher flows - users don't type into them (except reason pickers in
the override flows). The engine decides which employee supports which
interview.

Interview_Support_Person__c (Interview Support Person) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c]
    The internal employee assigned to support the candidate through this
    interview - usually chosen by the AI engine, sometimes manually. Only
    users with a special permission may change it (validation rule). ~62%
    of interviews have one.

Preferred_Support_Person__c (Preferred Support Person) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c]
    A preferred employee requested via the PSP button - a soft constraint the
    engine tries to honor.

Previous_Support_Person__c (Previous Support Person) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c]
    Who was assigned before the last reassignment (history/rollback support).

Interviewer_Assignment_Constraint__c (Interviewer Assignment Constraint) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c]
    A pinned employee the engine MUST use/honor for this interview (hard
    constraint, e.g. "must-interview-with").

Assigned_By__c (Assigned By) [Picklist]
    How the current assignment happened: AI Nightly | AI Suggestion | Manual |
    Extended Reassign | Other. In data, "AI Suggestion" dominates (~73% of
    all interviews).

Assignment_Status__c (Assignment Status) [Picklist]
    State of the assignment process: Not Assigned | Assigned | No Bandwidth |
    Needs Manual Review | Assignment Failed | Reassigned Due To Extension.

Assignment_Priority__c (Assignment Priority) [Picklist]
    Low | Medium | High | Critical - how urgently this interview needs a
    support person (feeds the engine's ordering).

Assignment_Reason__c (Assignment Reason) [LongTextArea]
    The engine's explanation of why it picked this support person.

Assignment_Error_Message__c (Assignment Error Message) [LongTextArea]
    Error detail when an assignment run failed for this interview.

AI_Suggestion_Status__c (AI Suggestion Status) [Picklist]
    Lifecycle of the AI's suggestion for this interview: Not Requested |
    Requested | Available | Used | Expired | Error.

AI_Suggestion_JSON__c (AI Suggestion JSON) [LongTextArea]
    Raw JSON payload of the engine's suggestion(s) - candidates ranked,
    scores, constraints considered.

AI_Suggestions_Generated_On__c (AI Suggestions Generated On) [DateTime]
AI_Suggestions_Expiry__c (AI Suggestions Expiry) [DateTime]
    When the suggestion was produced and until when it is valid.

AI_Assignment_Confidence__c (AI Assignment Confidence) [Percent]
    The engine's confidence in its pick (0-100%). Populated on ~75% of
    interviews.

AI_Assignment_Reason__c (AI Assignment Reason) [LongTextArea]
    Human-readable explanation the engine gives for its pick.

AI_Assignment_Version__c (AI Assignment Version) [Text]
    Version tag of the engine/model that made the assignment (traceability).

Reassigned_Due_To_Extension__c (Reassigned Due To Extension) [Checkbox]
    TRUE when this interview had to be reassigned because the support
    person's previous interview ran over time.

Reassignment_Initiated_By__c (Reassignment Initiated By) [Lookup -> User]
Reassignment_Initiated_On__c (Reassignment Initiated On) [DateTime]
    Who clicked the Reassignment button and when (audit).

Reassignment_Reason__c (Reassignment Reason) [Picklist]
    Why the reassignment: Previous round extended for current Interview
    Support Person | Interview Support Person unavailable | Scheduling
    conflict | at capacity | Skill / domain mismatch | Candidate preference |
    Time zone mismatch | Escalation from team lead / manager | Other.

Reassignment_Reason_Comment__c (Reassignment Reason Comment) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text detail for the reassignment reason.

User_Initiated_By__c (User Initiated By) [Lookup -> User]
User_Initiated_On__c (User Initiated On) [DateTime]
    Audit of which internal user manually triggered the AI run/action on this
    interview and when (used by the launcher/override flows).

--- GROUP K: SUPPORT CREDIT & INCENTIVE SYSTEM -------------------------------
Completed supported interviews earn the SUPPORT PERSON credits; good outcomes
earn a positive incentive, bad outcomes a penalty. Rates come from the
Interview_Incentive_Configuration__mdt custom metadata.

Base_Credit__c (Base Credit) [Formula, Number]
    Credit from duration: <=30 min = 0.5, <=60 min = 1, then up to a cap of 3
    for longer interviews. Computed from Scheduled_Minutes__c.

Round_Multiplier__c (Round Multiplier) [Formula, Number]
    LEGACY hard-coded multiplier by round (Initial=0, First=1, Second=1.2,
    Third=1.5, Fourth=2, Fifth+=2.5...). Superseded by the field below.

Round_Multiplier_New__c (Round Multiplier New) [Number]
    The CURRENT round multiplier, stamped by the Interview_Incentive_
    Calculation_Framework flow from the metadata config (admins can change
    rates without editing formulas).

Weighted_Credit__c (Weighted Credit) [Formula, Number]
    Base_Credit x Round_Multiplier_New, but only when the interview status is
    "Completed" (otherwise blank). The credit the support person earns.

Weighted_Credit_New__c (Weighted Credit) [Number]
    Stored (non-formula) copy of the weighted credit, written by the engine/
    incentive process for records it has processed (~2% populated so far).

Incentive_Type__c (Incentive Type) [Picklist: Positive | Negative | None]
    Stored incentive category for this interview.

Incentive_Type_Formula__c (Incentive Type) [Formula, Text]
    Derives the category from the outcome: Moved to Next Round / Offer
    Received -> Positive; Rejected / Ghosted -> Negative; else None.

Incentive_Rate_Applied__c (Incentive Rate Applied) [Currency]
    Stored rate actually applied to this interview.

Incentive_Rate_Applied_Formula__c (Incentive Rate Applied) [Formula, Number]
    Rate from category: Positive = 400, Negative = -100, else 0.

Incentive_Amount__c (Incentive Amount) [Number]
    Stored final incentive amount for the support person on this interview
    (written by the incentive process; only ~3% of records so far).

Incentive_Amount_Formula__c (Incentive Amount) [Formula, Number]
    Weighted_Credit x Incentive_Rate_Applied - the live-computed amount.

Incentive_Calculated_On__c (Incentive Calculated On) [DateTime]
    When the incentive framework last stamped this record.

Incentive_eligiblle__c (Incentive eligiblle?) [Checkbox]
    Whether this interview counts for incentives at all (note the typo in
    the API name - it is really "eligible").

Why_not_eligible__c (Why not eligible?) [LongTextArea]
    Explanation when the interview is excluded from incentives.

--- GROUP L: COMPASS SKILL-SCORING ENGINE (KALMAN/MFRM AUDIT FIELDS) ---------
~70 numeric fields written ONLY by the external COMPASS engine on AWS. What
they are: after each supported interview completes, the engine updates the
SUPPORT PERSON'S per-skill confidence ratings (stored on the Recruiter__c /
"Employee" record: Leetcode, System Design, Backend Coding, Frontend Coding,
AI/ML Coding, Final Round + Overall). The Interview__c fields in this group
are the AUDIT TRAIL of that one update: the rating before, the rating after,
the change, and every internal parameter the math used. The math itself
(a Kalman filter with MFRM interviewer-severity adjustment, momentum and
volatility handling) lives in the external service - no Salesforce code
computes these. Treat them as read-only diagnostics; normal users never touch
them and most reports ignore them. Populated on roughly half of all records
(the ones the engine has processed).

Per-skill-track rating snapshots (7 tracks: AIML, Backend, Frontend, Leetcode,
SysDesign, FinalRnd, Overall):
  Score_Before_AIML__c / _Backend__c / _Frontend__c / _Leetcode__c /
  _SysDesign__c / _FinalRnd__c / _Overall__c [Number]
      The support person's rating in that skill track BEFORE this interview
      was factored in.
  Score_After_AIML__c / _Backend__c / _Frontend__c / _Leetcode__c /
  _SysDesign__c / _FinalRnd__c / _Overall__c [Number]
      The rating AFTER the update from this interview's outcome.
  Net_Delta_AIML__c / _Backend__c / _Frontend__c / _Leetcode__c /
  _SysDesign__c / _FinalRnd__c / _Overall__c [Number]
      The net change (after minus before) per track.
  Velocity_EMA_AIML__c / _Backend__c / _Frontend__c / _Leetcode__c /
  _SysDesign__c / _FinalRnd__c / _Overall__c [Number]
      Exponential moving average of the rating's rate of change per track
      (is this person's skill rating trending up or down?).

L10_Score_Before__c / L10_Score_After__c [Number]
    "Last 10 interviews" rolling score before/after this update.

Kalman filter internals for this update:
  Kalman_Gain_K__c [Number]         - how much weight this observation got.
  Kalman_P_Prior__c [Number]        - uncertainty before the update.
  Kalman_P_Posterior__c [Number]    - uncertainty after the update.
  Kalman_R_Adaptive__c [Number]     - adaptive observation-noise estimate.
  Kalman_P_JSON__c [LongTextArea]   - full covariance state as JSON.

Raw-to-final delta pipeline (how the observed outcome became the applied
rating change):
  Delta_L__c, Delta_NL__c           - linear / non-linear delta components.
  Delta_Combined__c                 - combined raw delta.
  Delta_Patterned__c                - delta after pattern adjustments.
  Delta_Post_MFRM__c                - delta after interviewer-severity (MFRM)
                                      correction.
  Delta_Accepted__c                 - the delta the engine accepted.
  Delta_Final__c                    - the final applied change.
  Combined_F__c                     - combined factor used in the blend.

Interviewer-severity (MFRM = many-facet Rasch model) correction:
  MFRM_Severity_Cj__c, Interviewer_Severity_Cj__c [Number]
      How harsh/lenient this interviewer is judged to be - outcomes from
      harsh interviewers are discounted differently.
  MFRM_Multiplier__c [Number]       - the resulting correction multiplier.

Engine parameters used for this update (tuning/diagnostic values; exact
semantics live in the external service's documentation):
  Alpha_Used__c                     - learning-rate applied.
  Gamma_R__c, Lambda_Trust__c       - trust/decay parameters.
  Experience_Mu__c                  - experience-based weighting.
  Plasticity_Pi__c                  - how movable the rating currently is.
  Protective_Dampening_Rho__c       - dampening protecting against big drops.
  Curvature_Kappa__c, Coherence_Phi__c, Coherence_Factor_Fc__c,
  G_Factor__c, Zeta_Applied__c, Resistance_R__c
                                    - additional shaping factors.
  Momentum_EMA__c, Momentum_Factor_Fm__c
                                    - momentum of recent outcomes.
  Velocity_Alignment__c, Velocity_Factor_Fvel__c
                                    - alignment of this outcome with trend.
  Volatility_Sigma__c, Volatility_Damp_Fv__c
                                    - outcome volatility and its dampening.
  Innovation_Epsilon__c, Innovation_Variance__c, Innovation_Window_N__c
                                    - "innovation" (surprise) of this
                                      observation vs prediction.
  Affinity_A__c, Base_Magnitude_B__c, Credit_Scale_C__c, Depth_Weight_W__c,
  Duration_Signal_D_rel__c, Duration_Weight_D_abs__c, Importance_Score_I__c
                                    - per-interview weighting inputs
                                      (importance, depth, duration signals).
  Cap_Limit__c [Number], Cap_Hit__c [Checkbox]
                                    - max allowed change this update and
                                      whether the cap was hit.

Round ranking (engine's view of how important this round was):
  Round_Rank__c [Number]            - the engine's rank/weight for the round.
  Round_ranking_reason__c [LongTextArea]
                                    - the engine's explanation of that rank.

    The Techsara recruiter handling this candidate/interview (97% populated).
    Receives the Slack reminders and confirmation emails.

Recruiter_Name__c (Recruiter Name) [Text]

    Live formula version of the recruiter's name.

Account_Manager__c (Account Manager) [Lookup -> User]
    The Account Manager owning the client relationship - auto-filled from the
    Job Requirement (B2B path).

--- GROUP N: RECORDING & ACCESS LINKS ----------------------------------------
