  Reassignment_Other_Reason__c, both totals, both Jenkins test fields.
- Key takeaway: treat this object as a young, append-only audit table. To
  find "the log rows for interview X", join on Interview_ID__c (not the
  empty Interview__c lookup). Contrast with Interview__c itself, where the
  AI has already assigned ~73% of ~10k interviews - the engine ran long
  before this log existed, so the log does NOT cover historical assignments.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Interview_Incentive_Configuration__mdt
(Label: "Interview Incentive Configuration")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Interview_Incentive_Configuration__mdt is the RATE CARD of the interview
support incentive framework - a small configuration table with exactly one
row per interview round (Initial, First, Second ... Fifteenth, Final) that
says, for that round: the round multiplier (how much a completed supported
interview of that round weighs), whether the round is incentivized at all,
and the positive/negative incentive rates.

It exists so admins can tune the incentive economics WITHOUT editing formula
fields or redeploying code: the incentive flow on Interview__c looks up the
row matching the interview's round and stamps the configured multiplier onto
the interview, replacing the older hard-coded Round_Multiplier__c formula.
See the Interview__c section, Group K, for how the multiplier flows into
Weighted Credit and the final incentive amount for the support person.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- CUSTOM METADATA TYPE (__mdt), not a data object: its 17 rows are
  configuration records that deploy with the metadata (they live as files
  under customMetadata/ in the repo), survive sandbox refreshes, and are
  edited in Setup > Custom Metadata Types - not through tabs, imports or
  normal record CRUD. There is no OwnerId, no sharing, no reports.
- 5 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 0 list views.
- Visibility: Public (any code/flow in the org can read it).
- Referenced by exactly one piece of automation (the incentive flow below);
  no Apex class reads it.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Custom metadata types do not use record types; each row is simply one
round's configuration.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CONFIGURATION. An admin maintains one row per round value of
  Interview__c.Round__c (17 rows: Initial through Fifteenth plus Final).
  Each row carries the multiplier and rates for that round. Changing a rate
  is a config edit (or a source-file change deployed via the pipeline) - no
  formula or flow edit needed.

STEP 2 - CONSUMPTION AT INTERVIEW COMPLETION. When an Interview__c record
  is updated to Interview_Status__c = "Completed", the record-triggered
  before-save flow Interview_Incentive_Calculation_Framework runs on the
  interview: it fetches the single mdt row where Interview_Round__c equals
  the interview's Round__c, then stamps that row's Round_Multiplier__c into
  Interview__c.Round_Multiplier_New__c and sets Incentive_Calculated_On__c
  to now. (If no row matches the round, the multiplier is left unchanged.)

STEP 3 - DOWNSTREAM MATH ON THE INTERVIEW. Formula fields on Interview__c
  take over: Weighted_Credit__c = Base_Credit (from duration) x the stamped
  multiplier; Incentive_Type_Formula__c classifies the outcome (Positive
  for Moved to Next Round / Offer Received, Negative for Rejected /
  Ghosted); Incentive_Amount_Formula__c = weighted credit x rate. So a
  higher-round interview earns proportionally more credit - and Initial
  calls earn nothing (multiplier 0).

IMPORTANT NUANCE - ONLY THE MULTIPLIER IS WIRED UP TODAY. The flow reads
  ONLY Round_Multiplier__c. The Positive/Negative rate fields and the
  Incentivized checkbox are defined and filled in, but no flow or Apex
  reads them yet: the live +400/-100 rates are still HARD-CODED in the
  Interview__c formula Incentive_Rate_Applied_Formula__c (the mdt rows
  mirror those same numbers), and "Initial is not incentivized" is
  effectively enforced by its multiplier of 0 rather than by the checkbox.
  Changing a rate in the mdt alone would therefore NOT change payouts today
  - the formula would need to be rewired first (verify with team before
  relying on rate edits).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None - the type has no relationship fields. Its only connection is BY VALUE:
Interview_Round__c holds the same values as the Interview__c.Round__c
picklist, and the incentive flow joins the two by simple equality at run
time. Its output lands on Interview__c (Round_Multiplier_New__c and
Incentive_Calculated_On__c).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Integrity (one row per round, rates in sensible ranges) is maintained
by admin discipline, not by validation.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Custom metadata cannot have triggers or record-triggered flows. This type is
only READ, by exactly one consumer:

- Interview_Incentive_Calculation_Framework (record-triggered flow on
  Interview__c, before save, on update, entry condition Interview_Status__c
  = "Completed", Active): gets the row matching the interview's round and
  stamps Round_Multiplier_New__c + Incentive_Calculated_On__c on the
  interview.

No Apex class, no other flow, and no report reads it. (The +400/-100 rate
fields are not yet consumed by anything - see part 4.)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 5)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: THE ROUND KEY ---------------------------------------------------

Interview_Round__c (Interview Round) [Picklist]
    The lookup key of the rate card: which interview round this row
    configures. Values match Interview__c.Round__c exactly: Initial | First
    | Second | Third | Fourth | Fifth | Sixth | Seventh | Eighth | Ninth |
    Tenth | Eleventh | Twelfth | Thirteenth | Fourteenth | Fifteenth |
    Final. The incentive flow matches on this field, so every Round value
    an interview can carry must have a row here (all 17 do). Set by the
    admin when creating the row; each row's label/developer name mirrors
    the same round name.

--- GROUP B: THE CONFIGURED RATES --------------------------------------------

Round_Multiplier__c (Round Multiplier) [Number(18,2)]
    THE FIELD THAT ACTUALLY DRIVES THE SYSTEM TODAY: the weight of a
    completed interview of this round. Stamped onto the interview
    (Round_Multiplier_New__c) by the incentive flow, then multiplied with
    the duration-based Base Credit to give the support person's Weighted
    Credit. Configured values: Initial 0 (initial calls earn nothing),
    First 1.0, Second 1.2, Third 1.5, Fourth 2.0, and Fifth through
    Fifteenth and Final all 2.5 (later rounds are worth 2.5x a first
    round). These replace the identical hard-coded ladder in the legacy
    Round_Multiplier__c formula on Interview__c.

Positive_Incentive_Rate__c (Positive Incentive Rate) [Number(18,2)]
    The bonus rate per weighted credit when the interview outcome is good
    (Moved to Next Round / Offer Received). Configured as 400.00 on every
    row. NOT yet read by any automation - the live rate is hard-coded (at
    the same 400) in the Interview__c formula Incentive_Rate_Applied_
    Formula__c; this field is the intended future source of that number.

Negative_Incentive_Rate__c (Negative Incentive Rate) [Number(18,2)]
    The penalty rate per weighted credit for bad outcomes (Rejected /
    Ghosted). Configured as -100.00 on every row. Same status as the
    positive rate: defined and populated, but not yet consumed - the -100
    is currently hard-coded in the Interview__c formula.

Incentivized__c (Incentivized) [Checkbox]
    Whether interviews of this round participate in the incentive program
    at all. TRUE on every row except Initial (initial calls are excluded).
    Not yet read by any flow or formula - today the exclusion of Initial
    rounds is achieved by its multiplier of 0, which zeroes the credit
    anyway. Intended as an explicit on/off switch per round.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
17 configuration rows - one per round, full coverage of the Round picklist.
Actual configured values:

    Round        Incentivized  Multiplier  Positive rate  Negative rate
    ----------   ------------  ----------  -------------  -------------
    Initial      no            0.0         400            -100
    First        yes           1.0         400            -100
    Second       yes           1.2         400            -100
    Third        yes           1.5         400            -100
    Fourth       yes           2.0         400            -100
    Fifth        yes           2.5         400            -100
    Sixth        yes           2.5         400            -100
    Seventh      yes           2.5         400            -100
    Eighth       yes           2.5         400            -100
    Ninth        yes           2.5         400            -100
    Tenth        yes           2.5         400            -100
    Eleventh     yes           2.5         400            -100
    Twelfth      yes           2.5         400            -100
    Thirteenth   yes           2.5         400            -100
    Fourteenth   yes           2.5         400            -100
    Fifteenth    yes           2.5         400            -100
    Final        yes           2.5         400            -100

- The rates are flat (400 / -100 everywhere); only the multiplier varies by
  round, so round depth is the only thing that changes an interview's
  incentive value today.
- In live use: the incentive flow has stamped multipliers on completed
  interviews since it went live (Incentive_Calculated_On__c on Interview__c
  records the stamp time); given real data is dominated by Initial/First/
  Second rounds, the 0 / 1.0 / 1.2 rows do almost all the work.

PART 5: INTERNAL INTERVIEWS & TEMPLATES

================================================================================
OBJECT: Internal_Interview__c  (Label: "Internal Interview")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Internal_Interview__c records ONE screening interview that TECHSARA ITSELF
conducts on a candidate or lead - the company assessing its own people, not a
candidate meeting an outside employer. This is the head object of the INTERNAL
SCREENING subsystem: an internal Employee (Recruiter__c) interviews the person
using a structured set of sections and questions pulled from the org's question
bank, scores each section, and records a Hire/NoHire/Pass/Fail style decision.

Two ways of building the question set exist ("Launch mode"):
  a) "Techsara's Magic" - the flow sends the person's RESUME to an AWS Lambda
     AI service which generates custom, resume-specific questions on the fly.
  b) "Template" - a pre-built Template__c (sections + fixed questions) drives
     the interview; standard sections can also draw random questions from the
     Question_Bank__c.

Everything that happens during the interview is audited into two master-detail
child logs (Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c and
Internal_Interview_Question_Log__c), and the verdict is stored both on this
record and in a child Interview_Evaluation__c (with per-section
Section_Evaluation__c breakdowns).

DO NOT confuse this object with Interview__c: Interview__c = the candidate
interviewing with an OUTSIDE company; Internal_Interview__c = Techsara
screening the candidate internally. They share only the candidate - there is
no direct link between the two objects.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, head of the internal-screening cluster.
- NOT a master-detail child: it links to the person via plain LOOKUPS
  (Candidate__c -> Account, Lead__c -> Lead), has its own owner, and org-wide
  sharing is Public Read/Write.
- 29 custom fields, 0 record types, 1 validation rule, 1 list view.
- Auto-number Name in the format INT-XXXXX (label "Internal Interview Id").
- Scale: 302 records in preprod, all created 2026-06-03 to today - this whole
  subsystem is brand new (about 10 weeks of live use).
- Metadata drift warning: three fields exist in the source snapshot but are
  NOT queryable in the live preprod org (Final_Decision_By__c,
  Selected_Time_Zone_Start_Time__c, Selected_Timezone_End_Time__c) - they
  appear to be source-only / not deployed. Flagged again in section 8.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Every internal interview is the same shape; the "flavor" comes from the
Interview_Type__c lookup (a small config object) and the Launch mode picklist,
not from record types.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATION FROM THE CANDIDATE OR LEAD PAGE. A recruiter clicks the
  "Create Interview" button on a Candidate (Account) or Lead record page -
  IMPORTANT: despite the generic button name, this creates an
  INTERNAL_INTERVIEW__c, not an Interview__c. The button runs the screen flow
  Interview_Create_Reschedule_Flow, which collects: interview type, the
  internal interviewer (an Employee), niche, timezone, date and start/end
  times, and optionally a resume file upload. It then creates:
    - the Internal_Interview__c record (Candidate OR Lead filled, never both),
    - a Session__c with Purpose = "Internal Interview" (the actual Zoom/
      calendar-backed meeting record, linked back via
      Session__c.Internal_Interview__c),
    - a Resume__c record (status "Uploaded") holding the resume, when one was
      provided, and makes the uploaded file link visible to all users.
  The button sits on the Candidate Record Page, B2B Client Account and Vendor
  Account pages, the classic Account/Person Account layouts, and the Lead page.

STEP 2 - SCHEDULING STATUS SYNC (AUTOMATIC). The interview's Status is NOT
  edited by hand (it is read-only on the layout). The record-triggered flow
  internal_interview_Status_Update watches Session__c: whenever a session with
  Purpose "Internal Interview" changes status, it mirrors the session's
  Status, Start Time IST and End Time IST onto the linked internal interview.
  So scheduling the session flips the interview Unscheduled -> Scheduled, etc.

STEP 3 - CONDUCTING THE INTERVIEW. On the interview page the interviewer
  clicks "Start Interview", which runs the large screen flow
  Internal_Interview_Conduct_Interview (17 screens). What it does:
    - Determines the launch mode. In "Techsara's Magic" mode it fetches the
      resume file, converts it to base64 (Apex GetResumeBase64 - PDF/DOC/DOCX
      only), and calls the AWS Lambda service (named credential
      "Internal Interview: Ai Resume Based Questions Lambda", an API Gateway
      endpoint in us-east-1, external service
      InternalInterviewGenerateAiQuestions, POST /dev/generate-questions with
      question_count, section_name, interview_type, niche and resume_base64)
      to generate resume-specific questions per section. In "Template" mode it
      walks Template__c -> Template_Section__c -> Template_Section_Question__c
      for the fixed question list. Standard sections draw active
      Question_Bank__c questions, randomized by Apex RandomizeQuestions
      (Crypto-based true randomness).
    - Steps the interviewer through each section and question on screen; the
      interviewer enters a score and comment per section.
    - Writes the audit trail: one Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c per
      section (score, comment, question source, any AI error) and one
      Internal_Interview_Question_Log__c per question asked (text, evaluation
      criteria, sequence, source).
    - Records the verdict: creates an Interview_Evaluation__c (Evaluation
      Type = "Human") with the decision and total score, plus
      Section_Evaluation__c rows for the per-section breakdown; stamps the
      interview itself (Comment_Summary__c, Human_Decision__c,
      Human_Total_Score__c, Hired_Niche__c, Launch_mode__c, Template__c).
    - Closes out the Session__c (actual start/end times, host feedback,
      status), which in turn syncs Status = Completed back onto the interview
      via the Step-2 flow.

STEP 4 - RESCHEDULING. The "Reschedule Interview" button re-runs
  Interview_Create_Reschedule_Flow in reschedule mode: it sets the old
  interview and session to "Rescheduled", creates a NEW internal interview
  (linked back through Previous_internal_interview__c) and a new session with
  the new date/times, and can delete-and-replace the resume. Once a record's
  status is Rescheduled it is LOCKED - the validation rule blocks any further
  edit - so the chain of Previous_internal_interview__c links is the reschedule
  history.

STEP 5 - REVIEWING. The "View logs of this interview" button runs
  View_Interview_Log_Flow - a read-only screen that pulls the interview's
  decision, scores, section logs, question logs and evaluations into one view.

STEP 6 - THE DECISION. In live data the human decisions used so far are
  Pass/Fail (15 Pass, 2 Fail). A "hire" outcome also records WHICH niche the
  person was hired into (Hired_Niche__c). The final-decision fields
  (Final Decision / Date / By) and the whole AI-EVALUATION half of the data
  model (AI Decision, AI Total score, Combined Score, Evaluation Type "AI")
  are built into the schema but NOT yet wired to any automation - nothing in
  the org writes them today and they are empty on all records.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHO IS BEING SCREENED (exactly one of the two is filled):
- Account (Candidate__c, lookup): the candidate Person Account. 233 of 302
  records (77%).
- Lead (Lead__c, lookup): the not-yet-converted lead being screened. 69 of
  302 records (23%). Candidate + Lead counts add up to exactly 302 - in
  practice every record has exactly one of the two.

CONFIG / SETUP LOOKUPS (the question-bank cluster):
- Interview_Type__c (Interview_Type__c): which kind of internal screening
  this is (a tiny config object - name + active flag). 100% populated.
- Niche__c (Niche__c): the skill niche (e.g. a tech domain) the person is
  being assessed for; drives which question-bank sections/questions apply.
- Niche__c (Hired_Niche__c): the niche the person was actually HIRED into,
  set by the conduct flow at decision time.
- Template__c (Template__c): the question template used when Launch mode =
  "Template" (stamped by the conduct flow).
- Recruiter__c / "Employee" (Interviewer__c): the internal employee conducting
  the interview. 301 of 302 populated.
- Internal_Interview__c (Previous_internal_interview__c, self-lookup): the
  earlier interview this one replaced (reschedule chain) - 20 records.
- Session__c (Session__c, lookup on this object): a session link that is
  NEVER populated in data (0 of 302). The real link runs the OTHER way -
  Session__c.Internal_Interview__c points at this object.

CHILDREN (all master-detail, sharing inherited from this record):
- Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c: per-section execution log (score,
  comment, question source, errors).
- Internal_Interview_Question_Log__c: per-question log (text, criteria,
  sequence, source).
- Interview_Evaluation__c: the evaluator's overall verdict. NOTE: despite its
  name, Interview_Evaluation__c belongs to INTERNAL_INTERVIEW__c, not to
  Interview__c.

OTHER OBJECTS POINTING HERE (lookups):
- Session__c.Internal_Interview__c: the scheduled meeting(s) for this
  interview (9 sessions currently link back; shown as a related list).
- Resume__c.Internal_Interview__c: the resume version uploaded for this
  interview (12 records; created/deleted by the create/reschedule flow).
- Account.Internal_Interview__c: a lookup on the candidate Account back to an
  internal interview - deployed but never populated (0 records).

EXPLICIT NON-RELATIONSHIP: no field connects Internal_Interview__c to
Interview__c (external interviews). They share only the candidate.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Lock_Rescheduled_Session (active): once a record's status is already
  "Rescheduled", EVERY further edit is blocked. Error shown on the Status
  field: "This record is locked because the session status is already
  Rescheduled." This freezes superseded interviews so history cannot be
  rewritten - the replacement record (created by the reschedule flow) is the
  editable one.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOW:
- internal_interview_Status_Update (on Session__c, after save, active): when a
  session with Purpose "Internal Interview" changes status, copies the
  session's Status__c, Start_Time_IST__c and End_Time_IST__c onto the linked
  internal interview. This is the ONLY thing that moves the interview Status.

SCREEN FLOWS / BUTTONS ON THE PAGE (record page "Internal Interview Record
Page" + classic layout carry all three):
- "Start Interview" -> Internal_Interview_Conduct_Interview: the whole
  conduct-and-score experience (see process step 3). Calls the AWS Lambda AI
  question generator, Apex GetResumeBase64 and Apex RandomizeQuestions;
  creates the section/question logs, the evaluation and section evaluations;
  updates this record and the session.
- "Reschedule Interview" -> Interview_Create_Reschedule_Flow: also the CREATE
  path - the same flow sits behind the "Create Interview" buttons on Account
  (Candidate) and Lead pages. Creates interview + session + resume records;
  in reschedule mode retires the old pair and links the new interview via
  Previous_internal_interview__c.
- "View logs of this interview" -> View_Interview_Log_Flow: read-only summary
  of decision, scores, logs and evaluations.

APEX (invocable helpers called from the conduct flow - no trigger exists on
this object):
- GetResumeBase64: returns the resume file's base64 content; rejects anything
  that is not PDF/DOC/DOCX with a user-facing error.
- RandomizeQuestions: picks N random questions from the question-bank pool
  using Crypto-grade randomness.

EXTERNAL INTEGRATION:
- InternalInterviewGenerateAiQuestions (external service) via named credential
  "Internal Interview: Ai Resume Based Questions Lambda" - an AWS API Gateway
  /Lambda endpoint (us-east-1, anonymous/no-auth protocol) that generates
  resume-based interview questions. This powers the "Techsara's Magic" launch
  mode. Unlike Interview__c's COMPASS engine, this service only RETURNS
  questions to the flow - it does not write back to Salesforce on its own.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 29, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHO IS BEING INTERVIEWED ----------------------------------------

Candidate__c (Candidate) [Lookup -> Account]
    The candidate (Person Account) being screened. Set by the create flow from
    whichever Account page the "Create Interview" button was clicked on.
    Filled on 77% of records; empty exactly when Lead__c is filled instead -
    every record has one or the other, never both, though no validation rule
    enforces it (the flow guarantees it).

Lead__c (Lead) [Lookup -> Lead]
    The not-yet-converted Lead being screened - internal screening often
    happens BEFORE lead conversion. Set by the create flow from the Lead page.
    23% of records.

Has_Resume__c (Has Resume) [Checkbox]
    TRUE when a resume file was uploaded during creation/reschedule (the flow
    sets it and creates the companion Resume__c record). A resume is required
    for the "Techsara's Magic" AI question mode - no resume, no AI questions.
    TRUE on 87 of 302 records (29%).

--- GROUP B: INTERVIEW SETUP (WHAT KIND OF SCREENING) ------------------------

Interview_Type__c (Interview Type) [Lookup -> Interview_Type__c]
    Which kind of internal screening this is, from the small Interview Type
    config object (essentially a named list with an active flag). Chosen in
    the create flow; 100% populated. Drives which sections apply via the
    Section_Interview_Type__c junction.

Niche__c (Niche) [Lookup -> Niche__c]
    The skill niche/domain the person is assessed for (Niche records carry a
    Tech / Non Tech domain type). Chosen at creation; used by the conduct flow
    to pick niche-specific questions and passed to the AI question generator.
    Populated on 86 records (28%) - many older records skipped it.

Template__c (Template) [Lookup -> Template__c]
    The pre-built question template used when Launch mode = "Template"
    (Template -> Template Sections -> Template Section Questions). Stamped by
    the conduct flow. Only 1 record so far - template mode is barely used.

Launch_mode__c (Launch mode) [Picklist]
    HOW the question set was built, stamped by the conduct flow when the
    interview is actually started:
      "Techsara's Magic" - AI generates resume-based questions via the AWS
        Lambda service (27 records);
      "Template" - a pre-built Template__c drives the questions (1 record).
    Empty on 274 records - i.e. on every interview that has not (yet) been
    conducted through the Start Interview flow.

Interviewer__c (Interviewer) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c ("Employee")]
    The internal Techsara employee who conducts the interview. Chosen in the
    create flow. 301 of 302 populated. Note this points at Recruiter__c (the
    Employee object), not at the Salesforce User.

--- GROUP C: SCHEDULING & LIFECYCLE ------------------------------------------

Status__c (Status) [Picklist]
    Lifecycle of the interview: Unscheduled | Scheduled | Rescheduled |
    Cancelled | Completed. Read-only on the page layout - users do not set it
    directly; the internal_interview_Status_Update flow mirrors it from the
    linked Session__c whenever the session status changes. "Rescheduled"
    additionally LOCKS the record (validation rule). Live data: Unscheduled
    115, blank 100 (records whose session never moved), Scheduled 43,
    Rescheduled 21, Completed 17, Cancelled 6.

Scheduled_Date__c (Date Of Interview) [Date]
    The date the internal interview is planned for. Entered in the create/
    reschedule flow. 100% populated. (API name says "Scheduled", label says
    "Date Of Interview".)

Time_Zone__c (Time Zone) [Picklist, global value set "Candidate_Time_Zone"]
    The candidate's timezone the start/end times are quoted in. Chosen at
    creation. In practice almost always "ET (Eastern Time)" (295 of 302).

Selected_Time_Zone_Start_Tim__c (Selected Time Zone Start Time) [Picklist,
global value set "Times"]
    Interview start time in the candidate's timezone, picked from the shared
    org-wide time-slot list (same value set the external Interview__c uses).
    Set by the create/reschedule flow. Populated on 88 records (29%) - the
    scheduled ones. Note the truncated API name ("...Tim__c").

Selected_Time_Zone_End_Time__c (Selected Time Zone End  Time) [Picklist,
global value set "Times"]
    Interview end time in the candidate's timezone, same slot list, same flow.
    88 records (29%).

Selected_Time_Zone_Start_Time__c (Selected Time Zone Start Time) [DateTime]
    DateTime twin of the start-time picklist. EXISTS ONLY IN SOURCE METADATA -
    the field is not queryable in the live preprod org (never deployed or
    since deleted). Treat as unused (not fully documented - verify with team).

Selected_Timezone_End_Time__c (Selected Timezone End Time) [DateTime]
    DateTime twin of the end-time picklist. Same situation: present in source,
    absent from the live org. Treat as unused (verify with team).

Start_Time_IST__c (Start Time IST) [Text]
End_Time_IST__c (End Time IST) [Text]
    The start/end times converted to Indian Standard Time for the India-based
    team - copied from the linked Session__c by the
    internal_interview_Status_Update flow whenever the session changes.
    Populated on 85 records (28%).

Session__c (Session) [Lookup -> Session__c]
    A lookup to the meeting session that is NEVER populated (0 of 302). The
    working link is the reverse one (Session__c.Internal_Interview__c, set by
    the create flow). Effectively dead - do not rely on it.

Previous_internal_interview__c (Previous internal interview) [Lookup ->
Internal_Interview__c]
    Self-lookup to the interview this one REPLACED after a reschedule - set by
    the Reschedule Interview flow on the new record. Walk the chain backwards
    to see the full reschedule history. 20 records (matching the ~21
    "Rescheduled" statuses).

--- GROUP D: SCORES, DECISIONS & FEEDBACK ------------------------------------

Human_Total_Score__c (Human Total Score) [Number(7,2)]
    The interviewer's total score for the whole interview, written by the
    conduct flow from the per-section scores. Populated on the 17 completed
    interviews only.

Human_Decision__c (Human Decision) [Picklist]
    The human interviewer's verdict, set in the conduct flow: Hire | NoHire |
    Retake | Pass | Fail | Needs Improvement. Live data uses only Pass (15)
    and Fail (2); the Hire/NoHire/Retake/Needs Improvement values exist but
    have not been used yet.

AI_Total_score__c (AI Total score) [Number(2,0)]
    Reserved for an AI-computed total score of the interview. NO automation
    writes it today - empty on all 302 records. The AI-evaluation half of this
    subsystem is modeled but not yet built.

AI_Decision__c (AI Decision) [Picklist]
    Reserved AI verdict: Hire | No Hire. Never populated (0 records); no flow
    or Apex writes it yet.

Combined_Score__c (Combined Score) [Number(7,2)]
    Reserved blend of the human and AI scores. Plain stored number (not a
    formula); never populated; nothing writes it yet.

Final_Descion__c (Final Decision) [Picklist]
    The overall final call on the person: Hire | NoHire. (Note the typo in
    the API name - "Descion".) Read by the View-logs flow but never populated
    so far (0 records); intended to be set manually by the decision maker
    after reviewing evaluations (not fully documented - verify with team).

Final_Decision_Date__c (Final Decision Date) [DateTime]
    When the final decision was made. Manual entry; never populated so far.

Final_Decision_By__c (Final Decision  By) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c ("Employee")]
    Which employee made the final decision. EXISTS ONLY IN SOURCE METADATA -
    not queryable in the live preprod org (not deployed). Verify with team
    before building anything on it.

Hired_Niche__c (Hired Niche) [Lookup -> Niche__c]
    The niche the person was actually HIRED INTO when the outcome is positive
    - can differ from the Niche__c they were assessed for. Written by the
    conduct flow at decision time. 12 records.

Comment_Summary__c (Comment Summary) [LongTextArea]
    The interviewer's overall written feedback for the interview, entered in
    the conduct flow's final screens and mirrored into the child
    Interview_Evaluation__c. Shown in the View-logs screen.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Internal_Interview_Question_Log__c  (Label: "Internal Interview
Question Log")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
One row per QUESTION actually asked (or queued to be asked) in an internal
screening interview. When the interviewer clicks "Start Interview", the
conduct flow assembles the question set - from the standard Question Bank,
from a Template, or freshly generated by the AI resume-based Lambda - and
writes every question here as a permanent audit record: its text, its
evaluation criteria, where it came from, and the order it was asked in.

This is the interview's question-level "black box recorder": even for AI-
generated questions (which exist nowhere else in Salesforce), this log is the
only place the exact wording is preserved. The "View logs of this interview"
button reads it back for review.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, MASTER-DETAIL CHILD OF Internal_Interview__c. Sharing is
  "Controlled By Parent" - whoever sees the interview sees its question log.
  No owner of its own.
- 8 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Auto-number Name in the format IIQL-XXXXX.
- Scale: 428 records in preprod (2026-06-03 to 2026-07-27).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Every question log row is the same shape; the Question Source Used
picklist distinguishes standard vs AI questions.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATED DURING THE INTERVIEW. The Internal_Interview_Conduct_
  Interview screen flow creates these rows as it builds each section's
  question list: standard sections get randomly-selected active Question Bank
  questions (Apex RandomizeQuestions), template sections get the template's
  fixed questions, and "Techsara's Magic" sections get brand-new questions
  returned by the AWS Lambda AI service. Each row is stamped with its parent
  interview, its section, its section-log row, its sequence position, the
  question text and (for bank questions) the evaluation criteria and the
  Question Bank source record.

STEP 2 - READ BACK FOR REVIEW. The View_Interview_Log_Flow (the "View logs of
  this interview" button) looks these rows up to display what was asked.
  Nothing updates or deletes them afterwards - they are write-once audit data.

Note: scores are NOT kept here - scoring happens at the SECTION level (see
Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c and Section_Evaluation__c).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Internal_Interview__c (Internal_Interview__c, MASTER-DETAIL, required,
  100% populated): the interview this question belongs to. Sharing parent.

LOOKUPS:
- Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c (Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c): the
  section-log row this question was asked under - questions are grouped into
  sections. 100% populated.
- Section__c (Section__c): the master Section definition (e.g. a topic block
  with estimated time and question count). 100% populated.
- Question_Bank__c (Question_Bank__c): the bank question this row came from -
  filled ONLY for "Standard" source rows (338 of 428). AI-generated questions
  have no bank record, which is exactly why the text is copied into this log.

No other object points at this one.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. This is flow-written audit data; integrity is guaranteed by the conduct
flow, not by validation rules.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Created by the Internal_Interview_Conduct_Interview screen flow (the only
  writer). Read by View_Interview_Log_Flow. No record-triggered flows, no
  Apex triggers, no external writers on this object itself.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 8, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHERE THIS QUESTION BELONGS -------------------------------------

Internal_Interview__c (Internal Interview) [Master-Detail ->
Internal_Interview__c]
    The parent interview. Required, set by the conduct flow, 100% populated.
    Controls sharing.

Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c (Internal Interview Section Log) [Lookup ->
Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c]
    The per-section log row this question sits under - links the question to
    the section score/comment it contributed to. Set by the conduct flow,
    100% populated.

Section__c (Section) [Lookup -> Section__c]
    The master Section definition the question was asked in (the reusable
    config record, as opposed to the per-interview section LOG above). Set by
    the conduct flow, 100% populated.

Question_Bank__c (Question Bank) [Lookup -> Question_Bank__c]
    The source bank question, when the question came from the standard
    Question Bank (difficulty level, evaluation criteria live there).
    Populated on 338 of 428 rows - exactly the "Standard" rows; the 90 AI
    rows have no bank source.

--- GROUP B: THE QUESTION ITSELF ---------------------------------------------

Question_Text__c (Question Text) [LongTextArea]
    The full question text as asked. For bank questions it is a copy of the
    bank text (frozen even if the bank is edited later); for AI questions it
    is the ONLY stored copy of what the Lambda generated.

Evalation_Criteria_log__c (Evalation Criteria log) [LongTextArea]
    Snapshot of the question's evaluation criteria (what a good answer looks
    like), copied from Question_Bank__c.Evaluation_Criteria__c so the
    interviewer can grade against it. (Note the typo in the API name -
    "Evalation".)

Question_Source_Used__c (Question Source Used) [Picklist]
    Where the question came from: "Standard" (question bank / template - 338
    rows, 79%) | "AI Resume Based" (generated by the Lambda from the resume -
    90 rows, 21%).

Sequence__c (Sequence) [Number(3,0)]
    The order the question was asked in within its section (1, 2, 3...).
    Set by the conduct flow, 100% populated.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 428, created 2026-06-03 to 2026-07-27.
- Source: Standard 338 (79%) | AI Resume Based 90 (21%).
- Question Bank link on exactly the 338 Standard rows; section, section log
  and sequence 100% populated.
- Roughly 4 questions logged per section (428 questions across 104 section
  logs) on the interviews conducted so far.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c  (Label: "Internal Interview
Section Log")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
One row per SECTION of an internal screening interview as it was actually run
- the section-level companion to the question log. An internal interview is
structured as a sequence of sections (topic blocks like coding, communication,
domain knowledge, defined in the Section__c config object); when the conduct
flow runs an interview, it writes one Section Log per section holding the
interviewer's SCORE and COMMENT for that section, where its questions came
from (standard bank vs AI resume-based), its position in the interview, and
any error the AI question generator threw for that section.

Section scores entered here are the raw material for the interview's Human
Total Score and for the per-section Section_Evaluation__c breakdown.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, MASTER-DETAIL CHILD OF Internal_Interview__c. Sharing
  "Controlled By Parent"; no owner of its own.
- 7 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Auto-number Name in the format IISL-XXXXX.
- Scale: 104 records in preprod (same June-July 2026 window as its parent).
- Has its own Lightning record page (Internal_Interview_Section_Log_Record_
  Page) so a section log can be opened and inspected directly.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All section logs are the same shape.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATED WHEN A SECTION STARTS. As the Internal_Interview_Conduct_
  Interview flow walks the interview's sections (from the template or from
  Section/Section-Interview-Type config), it creates a Section Log per
  section with its sequence and question source. If the AI question callout
  fails for a section, the error detail is captured in Error_Log__c (and the
  flow can fall back / continue).

STEP 2 - SCORED DURING THE INTERVIEW. After asking the section's questions
  (each logged in Internal_Interview_Question_Log__c pointing back at this
  row), the interviewer enters a section score and comment on the flow
  screens; the flow UPDATES this row with them.

STEP 3 - ROLLED UP. The section scores feed the interview's Human Total
  Score and the Interview_Evaluation__c / Section_Evaluation__c verdict
  records. The "View logs of this interview" button reads these rows back
  for review.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Internal_Interview__c (Internal_Interview__c, MASTER-DETAIL, required):
  the interview this section run belongs to. Sharing parent.

LOOKUPS:
- Section__c (Section__c): the reusable Section DEFINITION this log is an
  execution of (topic, estimated minutes, question source type, question
  count). 100% populated.

CHILDREN (pointing here):
- Internal_Interview_Question_Log__c.Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c
  (lookup): the individual questions asked in this section (~4 per section
  in practice).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Written and updated only by the conduct flow.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Created AND updated by the Internal_Interview_Conduct_Interview screen flow
  (create at section start, update with score/comment after scoring). Read by
  View_Interview_Log_Flow. No record-triggered flows, Apex triggers, or
  external writers.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 7, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHERE THIS SECTION RUN BELONGS ----------------------------------

Internal_Interview__c (Internal Interview) [Master-Detail ->
Internal_Interview__c]
    The parent interview. Required, flow-set, 100% populated. Controls
    sharing.

Section__c (Section) [Lookup -> Section__c]
    The Section config record being executed (what topic block this was).
    Flow-set, 100% populated.

Sequence__c (Sequence) [Number(3,0)]
    The section's position in the interview (1st, 2nd, 3rd block...).
    Flow-set, 100% populated.

--- GROUP B: HOW THE SECTION WENT --------------------------------------------

Section_Score__c (Section Score) [Number(3,1)]
    The interviewer's score for this section (one decimal, e.g. 7.5).
    Entered on the conduct-flow screen and written by the flow. Populated on
    all 104 rows; average in live data is about 5.5.

Section_Comment__c (Section Comment) [LongTextArea]
    The interviewer's free-text notes for this section (strengths, gaps,
    follow-ups) - entered in the conduct flow alongside the score.

Question_Source_Used__c (Question Source Used) [Picklist]
    Where this section's questions came from: "Standard" (bank/template - 72
    rows) | "AI Resume Based" (Lambda-generated - 30 rows); 2 legacy rows are
    blank.

Error_Log__c (Error Log) [LongTextArea]
    Technical error detail captured when something went wrong building this
    section - typically a failed AI question-generation callout (bad resume
    format, Lambda error). Empty on healthy runs; useful for debugging
    "Techsara's Magic" problems.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 104 (June-July 2026).
- Question source: Standard 72 | AI Resume Based 30 | blank 2.
- Section, score and sequence populated on 100% of rows; average section
  score 5.5 (scores are entered on a 0-10 style scale with one decimal).
- 428 question-log rows hang off these 104 sections (~4 questions/section).

================================================================================
OBJECT: Interview_Evaluation__c  (Label: "Interview Evaluation")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
One evaluator's OVERALL VERDICT on one INTERNAL screening interview: who (or
what) evaluated it, the decision (Hire / NoHire / Pass / Fail / Retake /
Needs Improvement), the total score, and a written summary. The data model
allows two parallel verdicts per interview - a HUMAN evaluation (the
interviewer's) and an AI evaluation - distinguished by Evaluation Type, so an
interview could eventually hold both and the two could be compared. Today
only the Human kind is ever created.

CRITICAL NAMING WARNING: despite its name, Interview_Evaluation__c is a
master-detail child of INTERNAL_INTERVIEW__c - it has NO relationship
whatsoever to Interview__c (external company interviews). When someone asks
"where is the evaluation of an interview", check WHICH interview object they
mean: external interviews (Interview__c) store outcomes in their own fields;
evaluations live only on the internal side.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, MASTER-DETAIL CHILD OF Internal_Interview__c. Sharing
  "Controlled By Parent"; no owner of its own.
- 6 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Auto-number Name in the format IEQ-XXXXX.
- Scale: 17 records in preprod (2026-06-03 to 2026-07-27) - exactly one per
  completed internal interview so far.
- Metadata drift warning: the Evaluator__c lookup exists in the source
  snapshot but is NOT queryable in the live preprod org (see section 8).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. The Human-vs-AI distinction is carried by the Evaluation Type picklist,
not by record types.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATED AT THE END OF THE INTERVIEW. When the interviewer finishes
  the Internal_Interview_Conduct_Interview flow, it creates ONE evaluation
  with Evaluation Type = "Human", the decision the interviewer chose, and the
  total score - and mirrors the same decision/score onto the parent
  interview's Human_Decision__c / Human_Total_Score__c fields.

STEP 2 - SECTION BREAKDOWN. The same flow can create child
  Section_Evaluation__c rows under the evaluation - one per section with its
  score and comment (in practice only a handful exist; see that object).

STEP 3 - REVIEW. The "View logs of this interview" flow lists the
  evaluations alongside the section/question logs.

FUTURE/PLANNED: the "AI" Evaluation Type (and the parent interview's AI
  Decision / AI Total score / Combined Score fields) are modeled for an AI
  evaluator that does not exist yet - nothing creates AI evaluations today.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Internal_Interview__c (Internal_Interview__c, MASTER-DETAIL, required,
  100% populated): the internal interview this verdict is about. NOT
  Interview__c - see the naming warning above.

LOOKUPS:
- Recruiter__c / "Employee" (Evaluator__c): who evaluated - present in
  source metadata only, not in the live org (see section 8).

CHILDREN:
- Section_Evaluation__c (MASTER-DETAIL child): the per-section score
  breakdown under this verdict.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Created only by the conduct flow.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Created by the Internal_Interview_Conduct_Interview screen flow (sets
  parent, Evaluation Type = "Human", Decision, Total Score). Read by
  View_Interview_Log_Flow. No record-triggered flows, Apex triggers, or
  external writers today.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 6, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHAT IS BEING EVALUATED, AND BY WHOM ----------------------------

Internal_Interview__c (Internal Interview) [Master-Detail ->
Internal_Interview__c]
    The internal interview this verdict belongs to. Required, flow-set, 100%
    populated, controls sharing. (Again: no link to Interview__c exists.)

Evaluation_Type__c (Evaluation Type) [Picklist]
    WHO kind of evaluator produced this verdict: "Human" (the interviewer -
    what the conduct flow always writes; 16 of 17 records) | "AI" (reserved
    for a future automated evaluator - 0 records). One legacy record has a
    blank type.

Evaluator__c (Evaluator) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c ("Employee")]
    The employee who evaluated. EXISTS ONLY IN SOURCE METADATA - the field is
    not queryable in the live preprod org and the conduct flow does not set
    it (the interviewer is instead found via the parent interview's
    Interviewer__c). Treat as not deployed (verify with team).

--- GROUP B: THE VERDICT ------------------------------------------------------

Decision__c (Decision) [Picklist]
    The evaluator's decision: Hire | NoHire | Retake | Pass | Fail | Needs
    Improvement (same value list as the parent's Human Decision field). Live
    data: Pass 16, Fail 1 - the Hire/NoHire-style values are unused so far.

Total_Score__c (Total Score) [Number(7,2)]
    The overall score given in this evaluation (sum/roll-up of the section
    scores entered in the conduct flow). 100% populated; average about 27.5
    in live data (an absolute total across sections, not a percentage).

Comment_Summary__c (Comment Summary) [LongTextArea]
    The evaluator's overall written summary - same content the flow puts on
    the parent interview's Comment Summary.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 17, created 2026-06-03 to 2026-07-27 - one per completed
  internal interview (the parent object shows 17 "Completed").
- Type x Decision: Human/Pass 15 | Human/Fail 1 | blank-type/Pass 1.
  No "AI" evaluations exist.
- Total Score populated on all 17; average about 27.5.
- Six Section_Evaluation__c breakdown rows hang off these evaluations.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Section_Evaluation__c  (Label: "Section Evaluation")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The PER-SECTION line items of an internal-interview evaluation: under one
Interview_Evaluation__c verdict, one Section Evaluation per interview section
holds that section's score and comment. Together the rows explain HOW the
evaluation's total score was arrived at (e.g. "Coding 7.0, Communication
6.0..."). It is the evaluation-side twin of Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c:
the section LOG records what happened while running the section; the section
EVALUATION records the judged result under the final verdict.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, MASTER-DETAIL CHILD OF Interview_Evaluation__c - which makes
  it a GRANDCHILD of Internal_Interview__c. Sharing "Controlled By Parent";
  no owner of its own.
- 4 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Auto-number Name in the format ES-XXXX.
- Scale: only 6 records in preprod - the smallest object in the internal-
  screening cluster.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All section-evaluation rows are the same shape.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATED WITH THE VERDICT. At the end of the Internal_Interview_
  Conduct_Interview flow, after the Interview_Evaluation__c is created, the
  flow creates one Section Evaluation per section carrying the section's
  score and comment (the same numbers the interviewer typed into the section
  screens).

STEP 2 - READ FOR REVIEW/REPORTING. The rows give reviewers the section-level
  picture behind a Pass/Fail without opening the raw section logs.

REALITY CHECK: only 6 rows exist against 17 evaluations and 104 section logs
  - the section-evaluation step has clearly only fired for a small subset of
  conducted interviews (likely only certain flow paths create them). Expect
  most historical evaluations to have NO section breakdown; the raw
  Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c rows are the reliable per-section source.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Interview_Evaluation__c (Evaluation__c, MASTER-DETAIL, required, 100%
  populated): the overall verdict this line item belongs to. Sharing flows
  down from the internal interview through the evaluation to here.

LOOKUPS:
- Section__c (Section__c): which section definition this score is for
  (the same config object the section logs point at). 100% populated.

No other object points at Section_Evaluation__c.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Created only by the conduct flow.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Created by the Internal_Interview_Conduct_Interview screen flow (the only
  writer in the org). No record-triggered flows, Apex triggers, quick
  actions, or external writers touch this object.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 4)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHERE THIS LINE ITEM BELONGS ------------------------------------

Evaluation__c (Evaluation) [Master-Detail -> Interview_Evaluation__c]
    The parent evaluation (verdict) this section score belongs to. Required,
    flow-set, 100% populated. Controls sharing.

Section__c (Section) [Lookup -> Section__c]
    The section definition being scored (coding, communication, etc. - the
    reusable config record). Flow-set, 100% populated.

--- GROUP B: THE SECTION'S RESULT --------------------------------------------

Score__c (Score) [Number(3,1)]
    The score this section earned within the evaluation (one decimal).
    Flow-written from the interviewer's input; 100% populated; average 6.5
    across the 6 live rows.

Comment__c (Comment) [LongTextArea]
    The evaluator's free-text comment for this section - why it scored the
    way it did.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 6 - versus 17 evaluations and 104 section logs, so the
  per-section evaluation breakdown exists for only one or two conducted
  interviews. For section-level analysis today, use
  Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c instead.
- All 6 rows have Section and Score populated; average score 6.5.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Template__c  (Label: "Template")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Template__c is the top of the reusable INTERVIEW-TEMPLATE hierarchy that
feeds the internal-interview subsystem. A template defines a ready-made
question structure for internally screening candidates of a given skill
niche and interview type: Template -> Template_Section__c (ordered sections)
-> Template_Section_Question__c (ordered questions per section, pulled from
the Question_Bank__c master). When an employee launches an
Internal_Interview__c in "Template" mode (instead of "Techsara's Magic" AI
question generation), they pick one of these templates and the interview is
conducted section by section, question by question, from this structure.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object; parent of the 3-level template hierarchy. Org-wide sharing
  ReadWrite; its children are master-detail (ControlledByParent), so access
  to sections/questions follows the template.
- 3 custom fields, no record types, no validation rules, 1 list view.
- Scale: 1 template in preprod (with 5 sections, 4 questions) - the template
  library is embryonic; most internal interviews use the AI ("Techsara's
  Magic") mode instead.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
An admin/senior employee builds a template with the Template_Creation_Flow
screen flow (creates the Template record) and structures it with the
Template_Structure_Flow (reads the hierarchy). The template is tagged with
the Niche (skill track) and Interview_Type it serves and flagged active.
When an internal screening is launched in Template mode, the conduct-
interview flow walks this structure: for each active Template_Section (in
Sequence order) it presents the active Template_Section_Questions (in their
Sequence order, each pointing at a Question_Bank__c entry), and the
interviewer scores answers into the Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c /
Internal_Interview_Question_Log__c records of that interview.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Interview_Type__c (Interview_Type__c, Lookup): which kind of internal
  interview this template is for (the small interview-type master object).
- Niche__c (Niche__c, Lookup): the skill niche/track the template screens
  for (same niche master used by resumes and internal interviews).
- Template_Section__c (child, MASTER-DETAIL): the ordered sections of the
  template.
- Internal_Interview__c (incoming lookup Internal_Interview__c.Template__c):
  each internal interview run in Template mode records which template it
  used.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None on any of the three template objects.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Template_Creation_Flow (screen flow): guided creation of a template.
- Template_Structure_Flow (screen flow): reads/presents a template's
  structure (lookup only).
- Consumed by the internal-interview flows (Internal_Interview_Conduct_
  Interview) when Launch_mode = Template.
- No record-triggered flows or triggers.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 3)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Interview_Type__c (Interview Type) [Lookup -> Interview_Type__c]
    The interview type this template is designed for - lets the conduct flow
    offer only templates matching the screening being run.

Niche__c (Niche) [Lookup -> Niche__c]
    The skill niche the template's questions target (e.g. a technology
    track). Combined with Interview_Type, this is how the right template is
    found for a candidate.

Is_Active__c (Is Active) [Checkbox]
    Whether the template is currently offered for use. Retiring a template =
    unchecking this (children also carry their own Is_Active flags for
    finer-grained retirement).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-15)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- 1 Template record, 5 Template_Sections, 4 Template_Section_Questions.
- The template library is minimal; the AI question-generation mode
  ("Techsara's Magic") is the mainstream path for internal interviews.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Template_Section__c  (Label: "Template Section")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
One ordered SECTION inside an interview template - e.g. "Introduction",
"Core coding", "System design", "Wrap-up". It ties the template to a
Section__c master record (the reusable section definition shared with the
rest of the interview-evaluation model) and gives it a position (Sequence)
within this particular template.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, MASTER-DETAIL CHILD of Template__c (sharing Controlled By
  Parent - it lives and dies with its template).
- 4 custom fields, no record types, no validation rules, 1 list view.
- Scale: 5 records in preprod (all under the single existing template).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Created when a template is being structured (Template_Creation_Flow /
manual). At interview time, the conduct flow iterates the template's active
sections in Sequence order; each section groups the questions asked and maps
to an Internal_Interview_Section_Log__c row where the interviewer's per-
section score lands.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Template__c (Template__c, MASTER-DETAIL parent): the template this section
  belongs to.
- Section__c (Section__c, Lookup): the reusable section definition (name,
  meaning) from the section master - the template only positions it.
- Template_Section_Question__c (child, MASTER-DETAIL): the ordered questions
  inside this section.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None of its own; created/read by the template flows listed on Template__c.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 4)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Template__c (Template) [Master-Detail -> Template__c]
    The parent template. Required; deleting the template deletes its
    sections.

Section__c (Section) [Lookup -> Section__c]
    Which reusable section definition this slot represents. The section
    master carries the name/meaning; this record just places it in the
    template.

Sequence__c (Sequence) [Number(2,0)]
    The section's position in the template (1, 2, 3...). The conduct flow
    presents sections in this order.

Is_Active__c (Is Active) [Checkbox]
    Whether this section is currently part of the template - unchecking
    retires the section without deleting its history.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-15)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- 5 records, all sections of the one existing template.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Template_Section_Question__c  (Label: "Template Section Question")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
One ordered QUESTION inside a template section. It does not hold the
question text itself - it points at a Question_Bank__c entry (the org's
question master) and gives it a position within the section. This makes
questions reusable across templates while each template controls its own
ordering and selection.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, MASTER-DETAIL CHILD of Template_Section__c (sharing
  Controlled By Parent; grandchild of Template__c).
- 4 custom fields, no record types, no validation rules, 1 list view.
- Scale: 4 records in preprod.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Created when the template is structured. At interview time the conduct flow
presents the section's active questions in Sequence order, pulling the
actual question text/answer guidance from the linked Question_Bank__c entry;
the interviewer's per-question result is logged to
Internal_Interview_Question_Log__c on the interview.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Template_Section__c (Template_Section__c, MASTER-DETAIL parent): the
  section this question slot belongs to.
- Question_Bank__c (Question__c, Lookup): the actual question (text, niche,
  difficulty) from the question master.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None of its own; created/read by the template flows listed on Template__c.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 4)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Template_Section__c (Template Section) [Master-Detail -> Template_Section__c]
    The parent section slot. Required; cascades delete with the section/
    template.

Question__c (Question) [Lookup -> Question_Bank__c]
    The question-bank entry to ask at this position. The bank record owns
    the question text; this record only selects and orders it.

Sequence__c (Sequence) [Number(3,0)]
    The question's position within the section (1, 2, 3...).

Is_Active__c (Is Active) [Checkbox]
    Whether this question is currently asked - unchecking removes it from
    future interviews without losing history.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-15)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- 4 records. Together with 1 template and 5 sections this confirms the
  template library is a skeleton; the AI-generated question mode is the
  operational default for internal interviews.
