################################################################################
PART 6: TRAINING / LMS
################################################################################
################################################################################

================================================================================
OBJECT: Program__c  (Label: "Program")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Program__c is the CATALOG ENTRY for one training offering in Techsara's
training/LMS layer - e.g. "Interview Readiness Training", "Technical 1-1
Training", "Advanced AI/ML Training". It is the top of the curriculum
BLUEPRINT chain: Program -> Program_Version__c (the versioned configuration)
-> StepTemplate__c (the ordered steps) -> Step_Deliverable_Definition__c (the
work products each step requires).

A Program is NOT an enrollment. When a candidate actually takes the program,
a Candidate_Training__c record is created that points at the Program and at
one specific Program Version. Keeping the Program deliberately thin (only 4
fields) and pushing all real configuration down to Program_Version__c lets
the team re-version a curriculum without touching in-flight enrollments.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, Training/LMS domain; a tab in the "Training Module" app.
- Standalone top-level object: no parents, OWD sharing ReadWrite (internal
  and external) - anyone who can use the app can see and edit programs.
- 4 custom fields + a plain Text Name ("Program Name"). Field history
  tracking is enabled on the object. 0 record types, 0 validation rules,
  2 list views.
- Record ID prefix a0q. Scale: tiny reference data - 11 records in preprod.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Every Program record has the same shape; the Single-vs-Group flavor is
carried by the Session_Type__c picklist instead of record types.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATE THE PROGRAM. A trainer/admin clicks the "Create Program"
  button on the Programs list view, which launches the Program_Creation
  screen flow (a multi-screen wizard). In one pass the wizard creates the
  Program, its first Program_Version__c, the ordered StepTemplate__c rows and
  their Step_Deliverable_Definition__c rows, then navigates to the new
  Program page. Programs start in Lifecycle Status "Draft".

STEP 2 - PUBLISH / RE-VERSION. When the curriculum is ready the status is
  moved to "Published" (and eventually "Archived" when retired). The "Update
  Program" button on the Program page launches the Update_Program_Version
  screen flow, which clones the current version's steps into a NEW
  Program_Version__c so history is preserved (see that object's section).

STEP 3 - ENROLLMENT READS THE PROGRAM. The Candidate_Training_Creation
  screen flow (run when enrolling a candidate) looks up the chosen Program
  and branches on Auto_Create_Sessions__c + Session_Type__c: when
  Auto-Create Sessions is on and the program is Group Session, the flow
  skips the per-session detail screens and generates Session records
  automatically; when off, sessions are booked later by hand or by the
  candidate/trainer through session windows.

STEP 4 - RUNTIME DISPLAY. The candidate portal dashboard (DashboardService
  Apex) and trainer views show the Program name on every training tile,
  deliverable and session ("which course is this work for").

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Program__c has NO lookups pointing out - it is a pure parent.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT PROGRAM:
- Program_Version__c.Program__c (Lookup, required): the versioned
  configurations of this program. In practice exactly one "V1" version per
  program so far.
- Candidate_Training__c.Program__c (Lookup): every enrollment of a candidate
  in this program (421 of 423 enrollments carry the link). This is the main
  consumer of the object.
- StepTemplate__c.Program__c (Lookup): a convenience back-link from step
  blueprints to the program (their controlling parent is the Program
  Version, via master-detail).

NOT CONNECTED (common confusions):
- Course__c is a completely separate object used by the ONBOARDING/education
  intake, not by training - a "Program" is what Techsara teaches, a "Course"
  is what the candidate studied at university.
- Cohort__c does not reference Program; batches are tied to a Program
  VERSION through Session_Window__c and to enrollments directly.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Data quality is enforced by the creation wizard (required screens) and
by the restricted picklists, not by validation rules.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- No record-triggered flows, no Apex trigger, no scheduled jobs on Program.
- SCREEN FLOWS / BUTTONS:
  * "Create Program" (list-view button) -> Program_Creation flow: builds
    Program + first Version + StepTemplates + Deliverable Definitions.
  * "Update Program" (detail-page button) -> Update_Program_Version flow:
    creates a new version of this program's curriculum.
- READ BY OTHER AUTOMATION: Candidate_Training_Creation (enrollment wizard -
  reads Auto_Create_Sessions__c / Session_Type__c to decide session
  generation) and Extension_Requested_Notify_Trainer (deliverable-extension
  notification - looks up program context) reference Program records.
- APEX READERS: DashboardService (candidate portal dashboard) and
  SessionSchedulerController display Program names on trainings/sessions.
- UI: Lightning record page Program_Record_Page (the View override installed
  by the Training Module app).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 4 + Name)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: IDENTITY & LIFECYCLE --------------------------------------------

Name (Program Name) [Text]
    The human name of the training offering (e.g. "Interview Readiness
    Training"). Entered in the Program_Creation wizard. Displayed everywhere
    downstream: on enrollments, on the candidate portal dashboard tiles, on
    deliverables ("which course is this for").

Description__c (Description) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text description of what the program covers, entered in the
    creation wizard. Purely informational (long text - population not
    queryable via SOQL aggregates).

Lifecycle_Status__c (Lifecycle Status) [Picklist, required, restricted]
    Where the program is in its catalog life: Draft (default - being built,
    not yet offered) | Published (live, can be enrolled into) | Archived
    (retired). Set manually / by the creation wizard. Real data: 10 of 11
    programs are still "Draft" and 1 is "Published" - yet Draft programs ARE
    being enrolled into (257 enrollments on "Interview Readiness Training",
    which is Draft), so the status is not currently enforced as a gate.

--- GROUP B: SESSION-GENERATION DEFAULTS -------------------------------------

Auto_Create_Sessions__c (Auto-Create Sessions) [Checkbox, default false]
    Master switch for automatic session generation. When TRUE, the
    Candidate_Training_Creation enrollment flow auto-creates the training
    Session__c records (per the Program Version's duration/sessions-per-day
    settings) instead of asking the enroller for session details. Set in the
    Program_Creation wizard. Real data: true on 8 of 11 programs.

Session_Type__c (Session Type) [Picklist]
    Whether this program's sessions are one-on-one ("Single Session") or
    batch-based ("Group Session"). Per the field's own description it is
    left blank when Auto-Create Sessions is off. Copied down onto each
    Program_Version__c at version creation (where it can be overridden).
    Group Session + Candidate Books is the combination that activates the
    cohort/session-window booking machinery. Real data: Group Session 2,
    Single Session 1, blank 8.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 11, created 2026-05-07 to 2026-07-08 (the whole training
  module is new - built in mid-2026).
- Lifecycle Status: Draft 10 | Published 1 (the only Published one is
  "Advance Training Demo 1" - a demo).
- Auto-Create Sessions: true 8 | false 3. Session Type: blank 8 |
  Group Session 2 | Single Session 1.
- Enrollment usage (Candidate_Training__c per program): Interview Readiness
  Training 257 | Technical 1-1 Training 69 | Retraining Program 34 |
  Advanced AI/ML Training 24 | Resume Based Training 20 | Non-Technical 1-1
  Training 11 | Interview Rejection Training 4 | others 1-2 each.
- Key takeaway: a handful of hand-built catalog rows carrying ~420 real
  enrollments; "Interview Readiness Training" is the flagship program.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Program_Version__c  (Label: "Program Version")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Program_Version__c is the VERSIONED CONFIGURATION of a Program - the record
that actually says how the training runs: how long sessions are, who books
them (trainer or candidate), whether the schedule is fixed or free, how many
sessions per day, and the full mock-interview policy. The step-by-step
curriculum (StepTemplate__c) and the recurring booking slots
(Session_Window__c) are master-detail CHILDREN of the version, not of the
Program.

The versioning idea: when the curriculum changes, a NEW version is created
(via the "Update Program" button) and the old one is marked Superseded, so
candidates already enrolled against the old version are untouched. Every
enrollment (Candidate_Training__c) points at exactly one version - it is the
version, not the program, that drives the candidate's runtime experience.
This object carries the auto-create-session settings the enrollment flow and
the scheduling Apex read.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, Training/LMS domain; a tab in the "Training Module" app.
- OWD sharing ReadWrite (internal and external). Looks up (not master-
  detail) to Program__c, but the Program lookup is required.
- Master (parent) of two master-detail children: StepTemplate__c and
  Session_Window__c. Also referenced by Candidate_Training__c and
  Session__c lookups.
- 18 custom fields + a Text Name ("Program Version Name"). Field history
  tracking enabled. 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Record ID prefix a11. Scale: 11 records in preprod (1 per Program).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All versions have the same shape; Single-vs-Group behavior comes from
the Session_Type__c picklist.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATED WITH THE PROGRAM. The Program_Creation wizard creates the
  first version (named "<Program> - V1", Version Number 1) together with its
  StepTemplates and Step Deliverable Definitions, copying Session_Type__c
  down from the Program.

STEP 2 - RE-VERSIONING. The "Update Program" button on the Program page runs
  the Update_Program_Version screen flow: it reads the current version's
  steps and deliverable definitions, lets the user edit them, and creates a
  NEW Program_Version__c (with new Version_Number__c / Effective_From__c)
  plus fresh child steps. The Status__c picklist includes "Superseded" for
  the replaced version. (In practice versioning has not been exercised yet -
  all 11 versions are still V1.)

STEP 3 - SESSION WINDOWS ARE HUNG OFF THE VERSION. For Fixed Schedule /
  Group Session programs, admins generate recurring daily booking slots
  (Session_Window__c) under the version using the "New Session Window" LWC,
  backed by SessionWindowCreationController + SessionWindowService Apex
  (the invocable takes a "Program Version Id"). Sessions_Per_Day__c tells
  the wizard how many slot rows per day to generate.

STEP 4 - ENROLLMENT SNAPSHOTS THE VERSION. Candidate_Training_Creation
  requires a Program Version on every enrollment (100% populated) and, when
  the parent Program has Auto-Create Sessions on, validates that the version
  has the required generation settings (duration, type, booking fields)
  before auto-creating Session__c records; it also sends the training setup
  to AWS (AWSTrainingIntegration).

STEP 5 - RUNTIME READS. The candidate portal (CandidatePortalController,
  DashboardService) reads the version's Session_Type__c / Booking_Owner__c
  to decide whether the candidate must self-book a slot ("needs booking"
  tile when Group Session + Candidate Books and no Cohort yet); the session
  scheduler (SessionSchedulerController, AdminSessionAssignmentController)
  matches candidates to Session_Window__c slots of THEIR version only, and
  stamps Program_Version__c onto created Session__c records. The mock-
  interview policy fields are enforced by the candidate portal runtime.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Program__c (via Program__c lookup, required, 100% populated): the catalog
  entry this version configures.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT PROGRAM VERSION:
- StepTemplate__c (MASTER-DETAIL child): the ordered step blueprint of this
  version (52 step rows exist across the 11 versions). Their
  Expected_Duration_Min__c rolls up into Total_Expected_Duration__c.
- Session_Window__c (MASTER-DETAIL child): recurring daily time-slot
  templates for candidate self-booking (capacity, trainer, cohort). Only 2
  exist so far - the fixed-schedule machinery is barely used yet.
- Candidate_Training__c.Program_Version__c (Lookup, required on enrollment):
  every enrollment pins the exact version the candidate follows (423 of
  423 populated).
- Session__c.Program_Version__c (Lookup): concrete scheduled sessions carry
  the version they belong to (38 of 47 sessions).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None on the object itself. The Candidate_Training_Creation flow performs the
real guarding: it blocks auto-session enrollment when a version is missing
required generation settings (duration, session type, booking owner etc.).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- No record-triggered flows, no Apex trigger, no scheduled jobs.
- CREATED/UPDATED BY: Program_Creation (first version) and
  Update_Program_Version (subsequent versions) screen flows.
- READ BY FLOWS: Candidate_Training_Creation (enrollment - lookup +
  generation-settings validation).
- APEX: SessionWindowService / SessionWindowCreationController create
  Session_Window__c children under a version (invocable action "Program
  Version Id"); SessionSchedulerController, AdminSessionAssignmentController,
  CandidatePortalController and DashboardService all query version config
  (Session_Type__c, Booking_Owner__c) to drive booking behavior;
  AWSTrainingIntegration ships enrollment/training data to the AWS AI
  engine at enrollment time.
- UI: Lightning record page Program_Version_Record_Page (Training Module
  app).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 18 + Name)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: IDENTITY & LIFECYCLE --------------------------------------------

Name (Program Version Name) [Text]
    Version display name, written by the creation wizard as
    "<Program name> - V<number>" (e.g. "Retraining Program - V1"). One stray
    row named just "Coding" (no version number) looks like a test record.

Program__c (Program) [Lookup -> Program__c, required]
    The catalog Program this version configures. Set by the wizard; 100%
    populated. Child relationship name: Program_Versions.

Version_Number__c (Version Number) [Number(4,1)]
    Sequential version number (1, 2, ...; one decimal place allows sub-
    versions like 1.5). Written by the creation/update wizards. All existing
    rows are 1 (except the stray "Coding" row, which is blank) - versioning
    has not been exercised yet.

Status__c (Status) [Picklist, required, restricted]
    Version lifecycle: Draft (being built) | Published (the live version
    candidates should be enrolled against) | Superseded (replaced by a newer
    version). Set by the wizards / manually. Real data: Draft 10,
    Published 1, Superseded 0 - like Program.Lifecycle_Status__c, Draft
    versions are being enrolled into today, so the status is informational
    for now.

Effective_From__c (Effective From) [DateTime]
    When this version takes effect - the from-date of the version's
    validity. Written by the creation wizard (10 of 11 populated). Becomes
    meaningful once multiple versions of one program exist.

Notes__c (Notes) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text change notes for the version (what changed vs the previous
    one). Entered in the wizards; informational only.

--- GROUP B: SESSION GENERATION & BOOKING CONFIG -----------------------------

Session_Type__c (Session Type) [Picklist]
    "Single Session" (one-on-one with a trainer) or "Group Session" (batch/
    cohort-based). Copied from Program.Session_Type__c at version creation
    and overridable per version (per the field description). Group Session
    is what activates the cohort + session-window booking model; the portal
    dashboard flags "needs booking" only for Group Session versions.
    Real data: Group 2, Single 2, blank 7.

Booking_Mode__c (Booking Mode) [Picklist]
    How candidate-side booking works (field description): "Anytime" = the
    candidate picks any time within trainer availability; "Fixed Schedule" =
    the candidate must pick one of the pre-defined Session_Window__c slots.
    Set in the wizard. Real data: Fixed Schedule 3, blank 8 - "Anytime" has
    never been used.

Booking_Owner__c (Booking Owner) [Picklist]
    Who books each session: "Trainer Books" (manual scheduling by staff) |
    "Candidate Books" (self-service through the candidate portal). Read by
    DashboardService: Group Session + Candidate Books + no Cohort yet =
    the candidate is prompted to book a slot. Real data: Candidate Books 2,
    Trainer Books 2, blank 7.

Session_Duration__c (Session Duration) [Picklist, restricted]
    Duration of each session window in MINUTES, as a restricted picklist of
    15-minute steps: 15 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 75 | 90 | 105 | 120 | 135 | 150 |
    165 | 180. The value is the numeric minute count stored as a string
    (e.g. "60") so Apex/JS can Number() it directly (per the field
    description). This is the CURRENT duration field. Real data: 120 on 2
    rows, 150 and 60 on one each, blank 7.

Session_Duration_Min__c (Session Duration (Min) [Deprecated]) [Number(3,0)]
    DEPRECATED - replaced by the Session_Duration__c picklist above. Kept
    only because obsolete flow versions still reference it (per the field
    description). Do not use in new automation. Empty on all records.

Sessions_Per_Day__c (Sessions Per Day) [Number(2,0)]
    Number of session windows per day when Booking Mode is Fixed Schedule.
    Used by the Program Creation wizard to generate the correct number of
    Session_Window__c template rows (per the field description). Populated
    on 2 of 11 rows (both = 3).

Duration_Days__c (Duration (Days)) [Number(3,0)]
    Total number of days the program runs; drives per-day session generation
    for Group Session programs (per the field description). NEVER populated
    in current data (0 of 11) - the generation logic runs off the windows
    instead so far.

Total_Expected_Duration__c (Total Expected Duration) [Rollup Summary, SUM]
    System-computed SUM of the child StepTemplate__c.Expected_Duration_Min__c
    values - the total planned curriculum minutes for this version. Nobody
    types this; Salesforce maintains it. Real values: 1200 ("Technical 1-1"),
    630, 600 (x3), 300, and 0 on the 5 versions whose steps carry no
    durations.

--- GROUP C: MOCK-INTERVIEW POLICY -------------------------------------------
These five fields define whether and how the program includes mock
interviews. Enforcement of the policy happens in the candidate portal
runtime, not in Salesforce automation.

Has_Mock__c (Include Mock Interview) [Checkbox]
    TRUE when this program version includes a mock interview; unlocks the
    other Mock_* configuration fields (per the field description). Set in
    the wizard. Real data: true on 2 of 11 versions.

Mock_Frequency__c (Mock Frequency) [Picklist]
    How often the mock interview recurs during the program: Weekly | Once |
    End of Program. Both mock-enabled versions use "Weekly".

Mock_Booking_Owner__c (Mock Booking Owner) [Picklist]
    Who schedules the mock-interview session: "Trainer Books" (manual) |
    "Candidate Books" (self-service) - the mock counterpart of
    Booking_Owner__c. One mock-enabled version uses each value.

Mock_Blocks_Progress__c (Mock Blocks Progress) [Checkbox]
    When TRUE, a candidate cannot proceed to the next mock cycle (e.g. next
    week) until the current mock is booked and attended; runtime enforcement
    lives in the candidate portal (per the field description). TRUE on both
    mock-enabled versions.

Mock_Failure_Requires_Retake__c (Mock Failure Requires Retake) [Checkbox]
    When TRUE, a candidate who fails a mock interview must retake the
    corresponding training cycle - falling back to earlier weeks if the
    current week has no capacity (per the field description). TRUE on both
    mock-enabled versions.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 11 (one "V1" per Program), created 2026-05-07 to
  2026-07-08. Status: Draft 10 | Published 1 ("Advance Training Demo 1 -
  V1") | Superseded 0.
- Fully configured versions are the minority: 4 rows carry booking/session
  config (Fixed Schedule; 60/120/150-minute sessions; 2 with Sessions Per
  Day = 3); 7 rows have the whole Group-B block blank.
- Mock interviews configured on 2 versions, both Weekly + Blocks Progress +
  Failure Requires Retake (one Trainer Books, one Candidate Books).
- Never used: Duration_Days__c (0), Session_Duration_Min__c (deprecated, 0).
  Effective_From__c on 10/11; Version_Number__c on 10/11 (all = 1).
- Total Expected Duration rollup: 1200 / 630 / 600x3 / 300 minutes on 6
  versions, 0 on the rest (52 StepTemplate rows exist org-wide).
- Downstream: 423/423 enrollments reference a version; 38/47 sessions do;
  only 2 Session_Window__c slots exist.
- Key takeaway: the versioning and fixed-schedule/mock machinery is fully
  built but young - most live enrollments run on minimally-configured V1
  Draft versions.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Cohort__c  (Label: "Cohort")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Cohort__c is a BATCH of candidates going through group training together -
"the batch that starts May 11 with trainer X". It is a tiny grouping object
(3 fields: start date, end date, lead trainer) that group-session
enrollments and session-window booking slots hang off, so that all
candidates of one batch share the same recurring session slots and one
Session__c per slot serves the whole batch (extra batch members ride along
as Session_Attendee__c records).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, Training/LMS domain; a tab in the "Training Module" app.
- Standalone object: no required parents. OWD sharing ReadWrite internally,
  Read for external (portal) users - candidates can see but not change
  their batch.
- 3 custom fields + a Text Name ("Cohort Name"). Field history tracking
  enabled. 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Scale: 18 records in preprod.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All cohorts are the same flavor.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATE THE COHORT. Cohorts are created MANUALLY (standard New
  button) - no flow or Apex creates them. The trainer/admin names the batch
  and sets its start/end dates.

STEP 2 - ATTACH SESSION WINDOWS. Session_Window__c booking slots created
  under a Program Version can be tied to a Cohort (window -> cohort
  lookup). A before-save flow on Session Window
  (Session_Window_Enforce_Unique_Cohort) blocks creating a second batch of
  windows for the same cohort - one cohort, one set of slots. The window-
  creation Apex (SessionWindowCreationController.getCohortStartDate) reads
  the cohort's Start Date to anchor the recurring slot dates.

STEP 3 - CANDIDATES JOIN THE COHORT BY BOOKING. When a candidate (or an
  admin on their behalf) books a session-window slot, the scheduler Apex
  (SessionSchedulerController / AdminSessionAssignmentController) copies the
  window's Cohort onto the candidate's Candidate_Training__c - booking a
  slot IS joining the batch. The same Apex then finds all trainings of that
  cohort to fill group sessions with attendees.

STEP 4 - PORTAL BEHAVIOR. The candidate dashboard (DashboardService) flags
  a training as "needs booking" when it is Group Session + Candidate Books
  and has NO cohort yet - i.e. the empty Cohort lookup is the signal that
  the candidate still has to pick a slot.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOKUPS FROM COHORT:
- User (Lead_Trainer__c): the internal user leading the batch. NOTE: this
  points to the standard User object, NOT to Recruiter__c/"Employee" like
  most staff lookups in the org.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT COHORT:
- Candidate_Training__c.Cohort__c (Lookup): which batch this enrollment
  belongs to - stamped by the booking Apex when a slot is booked (157 of
  423 enrollments have one).
- Session_Window__c.Cohort__c (Lookup): the recurring booking slots reserved
  for this batch (both existing windows are cohort-linked; uniqueness
  enforced by flow).

NOT CONNECTED: Cohort has no link to Program__c/Program_Version__c directly;
the program association comes indirectly through the windows and the
enrollments that reference it.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None on Cohort itself. The related rule lives on Session_Window__c: the
Session_Window_Enforce_Unique_Cohort flow raises a custom error when a
second set of session windows is created for the same cohort.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Nothing runs ON Cohort: no record-triggered flows, no triggers, no
  scheduled jobs, no quick actions (records are made and edited by hand).
- AUTOMATION THAT READS/WRITES THE COHORT LINK ELSEWHERE:
  * SessionWindowCreationController / SessionWindowService (Apex): read
    cohort Start_Date__c when generating windows; check a cohort has no
    windows yet.
  * SessionSchedulerController / AdminSessionAssignmentController (Apex):
    copy Cohort from the booked window onto Candidate_Training__c and
    roster group sessions by cohort.
  * DashboardService (Apex): empty cohort on a group/candidate-books
    training = "needs booking" prompt in the portal.
- UI: Lightning record page Cohort_Record_Page (Training Module app).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 3 + Name)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: THE BATCH -------------------------------------------------------

Name (Cohort Name) [Text]
    The batch's display name, entered manually (e.g. a batch/date label).
    Shown on the candidate's training tile and on session rosters.

Start_Date__c (Start Date) [Date]
    First day of the batch. Entered manually; 100% populated. Read by the
    session-window generator to anchor the recurring slot dates.

End_Date__c (End Date) [Date]
    Last day of the batch. Entered manually; 100% populated. Existing
    cohorts span 2026-05-11 through 2026-08-28.

Lead_Trainer__c (Lead_Trainer) [Lookup -> User]
    The trainer responsible for the batch. Points at the standard User
    object (unusual for this org, where staff lookups normally target
    Recruiter__c). Manually set and mostly SKIPPED in practice - only 3 of
    18 cohorts have one; the operative trainer assignment lives on
    Session_Window__c.Trainer and Candidate_Training__c.Assigned_Trainer
    instead.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 18, created 2026-05-07 to 2026-08-06.
- Start/End dates: 100% populated; batches run 2026-05-11 to 2026-08-28.
- Lead Trainer: only 3 of 18 populated - effectively optional.
- Usage: 157 of 423 Candidate_Training records carry a Cohort (the group-
  session share of enrollments); both existing Session_Window__c slots are
  cohort-linked.
- Key takeaway: a light, hand-maintained batching object; its main job is
  being the join key between group enrollments and shared session slots.

OBJECT: Course__c  (Label: "Course")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Course__c is a REFERENCE/MASTER-LIST object for academic courses (fields of
study - what a candidate studied at university), used by the ONBOARDING and
pre-enrolment intake forms, NOT by the training/LMS layer. When a candidate
fills in their education history, the course they name is meant to be picked
from this list. Do not confuse it with Program__c: a Program is a training
product Techsara sells/delivers; a Course is a line on the candidate's
resume/education record.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, Onboarding/intake domain (not in the Training Module app).
- Standalone reference object: no parents. OWD sharing ReadWrite internally,
  Private for external users. Field history tracking enabled.
- Only 1 custom field (Active__c) + a Text Name ("Course Name"). 0 record
  types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Scale: 0 records in preprod - the master list has never been loaded.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. A course row is just a name plus an active flag.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
INTENDED USE (as designed): during candidate intake, two guest/candidate-
facing screen flows offer course choices filtered to Active__c = true:
- Guest_Pre_Enrolment ("Lead : Guest Pre-Enrolment") - the public pre-
  enrolment form a lead fills before becoming a candidate; it records
  education history rows that reference Course and Institute.
- Onboarding_Candidate_Intake_1 ("Onboarding:Candidate Intake-1") - the
  token-authenticated onboarding intake form; Education_History__c rows and
  the Onboarding__c record can reference the course.

CURRENT REALITY: the object is EMPTY (0 rows), Education_History__c has 0
records, and Onboarding__c.Course_Name__c is populated on 0 of 771
onboardings - so the course pick-lists in those intake flows currently have
nothing to offer and the feature is dormant until the master list is loaded.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Course__c has no lookups out.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT COURSE:
- Education_History__c.Course__c (Lookup): one education entry of a
  candidate ("BSc Computer Science at X university") referencing the course
  studied. (Education_History__c itself has 0 records so far.)
- Onboarding__c.Course_Name__c (Lookup, child relationship "Onboardings"):
  the course captured on the onboarding record. 0 of 771 onboardings use it.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Nothing runs on Course__c itself - no flows, triggers, scheduled jobs or
  quick actions target it.
- READ-ONLY CONSUMERS: the Guest_Pre_Enrolment and
  Onboarding_Candidate_Intake_1 screen flows look up Course rows (filtered
  by Active__c) to populate their course-choice screens.
- No Apex class references Course__c.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 1 + Name)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: THE MASTER-LIST ENTRY -------------------------------------------

Name (Course Name) [Text]
    The course/degree name a candidate could pick on the intake forms
    (e.g. "Computer Science"). Would be loaded by an admin as reference
    data; no records exist yet.

Active__c (Active) [Checkbox]
    Whether this course appears in the intake-form choice lists - both
    consuming flows filter on Active__c = true, so unchecking retires a
    course without deleting it. No records exist to flag yet.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 0. The object is deployed and wired into two active intake
  flows but its master list has never been seeded.
- Downstream usage is also zero: Education_History__c 0 records;
  Onboarding__c.Course_Name__c empty on all 771 onboardings.
- Key takeaway: dormant reference object - answers about "courses" in this
  org almost certainly mean Program__c (training) instead, unless the
  question is specifically about the education-history intake forms.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Candidate_Training__c  (Label: "Candidate Training")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Candidate_Training__c is the ENROLLMENT record of the training/LMS layer: one
record = one candidate enrolled into one training program version. It is the
runtime anchor of the whole training subsystem - the per-candidate steps
(CandidateTrainingStep__c), the work products (Deliverable__c), and the
scheduled meetings (Session__c) all hang off it. Where StepTemplate__c and
Step_Deliverable_Definition__c are the course BLUEPRINT, Candidate_Training__c
is where that blueprint becomes a live, per-candidate copy with its own status,
trainer, cohort, dates and time-zone handling.

Two usage styles coexist in the data:
  a) STEP-BASED 1-1 TRAINING (Technical 1-1, Advanced AI/ML, Retraining,
     Resume Based...): enrollment instantiates the version's step templates
     into per-candidate steps and deliverables, and the training is tracked
     step by step.
  b) COHORT/GROUP TRAINING ("Interview Readiness Training" - 61% of all
     enrollments): the enrollment is a lightweight membership record with no
     steps (the program version has no step templates); scheduling happens
     through Session Windows / Cohorts instead.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, heart of the Training / LMS domain (Training Module app).
- Standalone object with its own owner; org-wide default is Public Read/Write
  (the redesign project may tighten this - see the role-hierarchy docs).
- LOOKUP (not master-detail) to Account via Candidate__c, but the field is
  required, so every training always belongs to a candidate (Person Account).
- 21 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Name is plain Text (the creation flow writes a descriptive name).
- Scale: 423 records in preprod, all created 2026-05-08 to 2026-08-06 - the
  training subsystem is only a few months old.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Every Candidate Training uses the single default layout/page; the
program (and whether its version has step templates) is what differentiates
the step-based and cohort flavors, not a record type.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - ENROLLMENT. A user runs the Candidate_Training_Creation screen flow,
  reachable from the "Create Training" list button (opens the flow directly)
  or the "Create Training AIC" button (opens the create-training page inside
  the AIC Portal - the normal path for portal employees). The user picks the
  candidate, program, program version, niche, assigned trainer, times and
  time zone. The flow then:
  - creates the Candidate_Training__c record (stamping Candidate_Email__c
    from the candidate's Person Account email and Candidate_Owner__c from the
    candidate's Account owner);
  - loops the version's StepTemplate__c records and creates one
    CandidateTrainingStep__c per template (status "Not Started");
  - loops the Step_Deliverable_Definition__c records of those templates and
    creates one Deliverable__c per definition per step;
  - optionally creates Session__c records ("Should Create Sessions" branch,
    driven by the program's auto-create-sessions setting);
  - moves the candidate's resume file onto the training record
    (ReparentContentDocLink Apex action);
  - sends the whole training + steps + deliverables package to the external
    AWS AI engine (AWSTrainingIntegration Apex, queueable callout to AWS API
    Gateway) so the AI can later evaluate deliverable submissions;
  - navigates the user to the new record.

STEP 2 - BOOKING A SLOT (cohort path). The candidate (from the candidate
  portal, CandidatePortalController.bookSessionWindow) or an admin (via the
  "Book Session Slot" quick action -> assignSessionWindowToTraining LWC ->
  AdminSessionAssignmentController) books the training into a Session_Window.
  Booking: sets Cohort__c and Start_Date__c from the window, fills
  Time_Zone__c if blank, converts the window's slot times into the
  candidate's time zone (Candidate_Time_Zone_Start/End_Time__c), schedules
  each step on consecutive business days (stamping the step's Started_At__c),
  sets End_Date__c to the last step's date, creates/attaches the Session__c
  and Session_Attendee__c records, recomputes every Deliverable due date
  (step date + Days_To_Complete), and increments the window's booked count.
  The admin path bypasses the portal's status/capacity filters but still
  requires a matching program version and an un-booked training.

STEP 3 - RUNNING THE TRAINING. Status__c moves Planned -> Active ->
  Completed (or Paused / Dropped). Trainers work through the child steps and
  review deliverable submissions; the candidate sees everything through the
  candidate portal Overview tab, which DashboardService builds entirely from
  the candidate's ACTIVE training, its steps and its deliverables. One-off
  extra meetings can be booked with the "Schedule Session" quick action
  (Schedule_Session_From_Training flow, sessionScheduler LWC).

STEP 4 - DROPPING OUT. To drop a candidate the user sets Drop_Date__c (blank
  = today; a before-save flow defaults it) and flips Status__c to "Dropped".
  The Candidate_Training_Dropped_Cascade flow then cascades: unfinished steps,
  open deliverables and future sessions from the drop date onward are all
  marked Dropped/cancelled so nothing keeps chasing the candidate.

STEP 5 - DOWNSTREAM USES. The nightly LockOverdueDeliverables Apex job reads
  the training's Time_Zone__c + Candidate_Time_Zone_End_Time__c to know when
  "end of day" happens in the candidate's local time before locking overdue
  deliverables. TrainerEmailService emails the Assigned Trainer when the
  candidate requests a deliverable extension. Trainer/candidate feedback is
  captured in the two long-text feedback fields at the end.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOKUPS FROM CANDIDATE TRAINING:
- Account (Candidate__c, required, 100%): the candidate (Person Account)
  being trained. Required even though it is a lookup, so sharing does NOT
  flow from the Account (unlike Interview__c).
- Program__c (Program__c, ~100%): the course being taken (denormalized
  convenience copy - the version below is the operative link).
- Program_Version__c (Program_Version__c, required, 100%): WHICH version of
  the course this enrollment follows. Its StepTemplates define the steps.
- Cohort__c (Cohort__c, 37%): the batch/group the training was booked into
  (set by the session-window booking logic, not at enrollment).
- Recruiter__c (Assigned_Trainer__c, 62%): the internal trainer (an
  "Employee" record) responsible for this candidate's training.
- User (Assigned_Trainer_User__c, ~0%): the trainer's Salesforce User -
  effectively unused (2 records).
- User (Candidate_Owner__c, ~100%): the owner of the candidate Account,
  stamped at creation for reporting/routing.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT CANDIDATE TRAINING:
- CandidateTrainingStep__c (MASTER-DETAIL child): the per-candidate steps
  instantiated from the version's step templates.
- Deliverable__c (lookup): the candidate work products. (Deliverable's
  master-detail parent is the STEP; this direct lookup is a denormalized
  shortcut used by the cascade flow, portal queries and the lock job.)
- Session__c (lookup): scheduled Zoom/calendar meetings for this training.
- Session_Attendee__c (lookup): extra candidates sharing a cohort session
  slot (the junction also points back at the training).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Data quality is enforced by required fields (Candidate, Program
Version, Status, Time Zone) and by the creation flow/booking Apex, which
validate cohort/version matching and capacity in code instead.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOWS (all active):
- Candidate_Training_Auto_Set_Drop_Date (before save, update): when Status
  changes to "Dropped" with Drop_Date__c blank, defaults it to today.
- Candidate_Training_Dropped_Cascade (after save, update): on Status =
  "Dropped", marks unfinished child steps, open deliverables and future
  sessions (from Drop_Date__c onward) as Dropped/cancelled.
- Candidate_Training_IST_Time_Population (before save, create+update): when
  the candidate-time-zone slot times or time zone change, computes the
  IST-converted Start_Tme_IST__c / End_Time_IST__c text fields for the
  India-based training team.

SCREEN FLOWS / BUTTONS:
- Candidate_Training_Creation (screen flow): THE creation wizard (see part
  4) - creates the training, steps, deliverables, optional sessions, calls
  ReparentContentDocLink + AWSTrainingIntegration. Launched from the
  "Create Training" list button or the AIC Portal create-training page
  ("Create Training AIC" button).
- Schedule Session (quick action -> Schedule_Session_From_Training flow):
  books an ad-hoc Session__c linked to this training via the
  sessionScheduler LWC.
- Book Session Slot (quick action -> assignSessionWindowToTraining LWC ->
  AdminSessionAssignmentController Apex): admin-side booking of the training
  into any Session Window, bypassing portal filters.

APEX (no trigger on the object itself):
- CandidatePortalController.bookSessionWindow: candidate-side slot booking
  (writes Cohort, Start/End dates, TZ slot times; schedules steps; updates
  deliverable due dates; increments the window's booked count).
- AdminSessionAssignmentController: the admin equivalent (same writes).
- DashboardService (without sharing): builds the candidate portal Overview
  from the candidate's active training + steps + deliverables (read-only).
- AWSTrainingIntegration (queueable, invocable "Send Training to AWS"):
  pushes the full training package to AWS API Gateway at enrollment; the
  external AI later returns deliverable scores through the
  DeliverableResultRest endpoint.
- LockOverdueDeliverables (scheduled): reads Time_Zone__c +
  Candidate_Time_Zone_End_Time__c to lock overdue deliverables at the
  candidate's local end of day.
- TrainerEmailService: emails Assigned_Trainer__r.Email__c on deliverable
  extension requests (used by Extension_Requested_Notify_Trainer /
  Review_Extension_Request, which look up the training to find the trainer).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 21, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: THE CANDIDATE BEING ENROLLED ------------------------------------

Candidate__c (Candidate) [Lookup -> Account, required]
    The candidate (Person Account) this training belongs to. 100% populated.
    Set once in the creation flow's candidate picker and never changed. All
    portal queries filter by it - a candidate can only ever see their own
    trainings.

Candidate_Email__c (Candidate Email) [Email]
    The candidate's email, auto-copied from the Person Account's PersonEmail
    by the creation flow (99% populated). Used for session/training emails
    without having to traverse the Account relationship.

Whatsapp_No__c (Whatsapp No) [Text]
    The candidate's WhatsApp number for training coordination. Manual entry;
    barely used in practice (3 of 423 records).

Candidate_Owner__c (Candidate Owner) [Lookup -> User]
    The OWNER of the candidate Account at enrollment time, stamped by the
    creation flow (~100% populated). Lets training reports slice by the
    owning employee without joining through Account.

--- GROUP B: WHAT THEY ARE ENROLLED INTO -------------------------------------

Program__c (Program) [Lookup -> Program__c]
    The course itself (e.g. "Interview Readiness Training", "Technical 1-1
    Training"). Set by the creation flow; ~100% populated. Mostly a
    convenience copy - the version below is what drives behavior. Real data:
    Interview Readiness Training 257 (61%), Technical 1-1 Training 69,
    Retraining Program 34, Advanced AI/ML Training 24, Resume Based
    Training 20, Non-Technical 1-1 Training 11, others in single digits.

Program_Version__c (Program Version) [Lookup -> Program_Version__c, required]
    WHICH versioned configuration of the program this enrollment follows
    (100% populated). The creation flow reads this version's StepTemplates
    to build the candidate's steps, and slot booking only accepts Session
    Windows of the same version (enforced in Apex).

Cohort__c (Cohort) [Lookup -> Cohort__c]
    The batch/group this training was booked into. NOT set at enrollment -
    written by the slot-booking logic (portal bookSessionWindow or the admin
    "Book Session Slot" action) from the chosen Session Window's cohort.
    37% populated (booked trainings only). A non-blank Cohort also acts as
    the "already booked" flag - booking code refuses a second booking.

Niche__c (Niche) [Picklist]
    The candidate's target job niche, picked at enrollment: AI ML Engineer |
    Python Developer/Engineer | Java Fullstack Developer/Engineer |
    Product/Project Manager | Marketing Manager | Finance Analyst | Other.
    Real data: AI ML Engineer dominates (205 of 423 = 48%); blank on 24%.

--- GROUP C: THE TRAINER ------------------------------------------------------

Assigned_Trainer__c (Assigned Trainer) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c ("Employee")]
    The internal trainer responsible for this candidate (62% populated).
    Picked in the creation flow's trainer lookup; copied onto every child
    step at creation. TrainerEmailService sends extension-request emails to
    this employee's Email__c, and cohort booking uses the Session Window's
    trainer for the sessions it creates.

Assigned_Trainer_User__c (Assigned Trainer User) [Lookup -> User]
    The trainer's Salesforce User record. Effectively unused (2 of 423) -
    the org's convention is Recruiter__c ("Employee") lookups, not User.

--- GROUP D: LIFECYCLE STATUS & DATES ----------------------------------------

Status__c (Status) [Picklist, required]
    The enrollment lifecycle: Planned | Active | Paused | Completed |
    Dropped. Users drive it manually; "Dropped" triggers the cascade flow
    (see part 7). Real data: Active 300 (71%), Planned 89 (21%), Completed
    29 (7%), Dropped 3, Paused 2 - the subsystem is young, so most
    enrollments are still in flight.

Start_Date__c (Start Date) [Date]
    The date training starts. Written by the slot-booking logic from the
    Session Window's start date (38% populated - matches the booked
    subset). Can also be entered manually for non-cohort trainings.

End_Date__c (End Date) [Date]
    The planned end of training. The booking logic sets it to the date of
    the LAST scheduled step (each step lands on the next business day).
    Only 6% populated so far.

Drop_Date__c (Drop Date) [Date]
    Help text: "Set before changing Status to Dropped. Drives the cutoff
    date for cascading updates on the training's deliverables, steps, and
    sessions. Blank = today." Auto-defaulted to today by the
    Candidate_Training_Auto_Set_Drop_Date flow when Status flips to Dropped.
    3 records populated (the 3 Dropped trainings).

--- GROUP E: TIME ZONE & DAILY SLOT TIMES ------------------------------------

Time_Zone__c (Time Zone) [Picklist, required, global value set
Candidate_Time_Zone]
    The candidate's home time zone: ET | PT | CT | MT | HT | UTC | AT | IST
    (each labeled with its full name, e.g. "ET (Eastern Time)"). Chosen at
    enrollment or defaulted from the Session Window at booking. Drives the
    IST conversion flow and the overdue-deliverable lock job's "end of the
    candidate's day" math. Despite being required now, 61% of records are
    blank - the requirement was added after most rows existed. Of the
    filled ones, ET dominates (149).

Candidate_Time_Zone_Start_Time__c (Candidate Time Zone Start Time)
[Picklist, global value set "Times"]
Candidate_Time_Zone_End_Time__c (Candidate Time Zone End Time)
[Picklist, global value set "Times"]
    The daily training slot's start/end in the CANDIDATE'S own time zone,
    picked from the shared org-wide time-slot list (e.g. "10:00 AM").
    Entered in the creation flow or computed by the booking logic, which
    converts the Session Window's slot times into the candidate's zone
    (with DST handling in Apex). 38% populated (the booked subset). The
    end time is what the deliverable lock job treats as the daily deadline.

Start_Tme_IST__c (Start Tme IST) [Text]
End_Time_IST__c (End Time IST) [Text]
    The same slot times converted to Indian Standard Time for the
    India-based training team, auto-computed by the
    Candidate_Training_IST_Time_Population flow whenever the times or time
    zone change. 100% populated (the flow writes a value - possibly empty
    formatting text - on every save that meets its entry conditions). Note
    the typo in the first API name ("Tme"), it is intentional/live.

--- GROUP F: FEEDBACK ---------------------------------------------------------

Candidate_Feedback__c (Candidate Feedback) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text feedback FROM the candidate about the training (collected at
    or after completion). Manual entry; population not measurable via SOQL
    (long text), but the object is young and Completed count is low.

Trainer_Feedback__c (Trainer Feedback) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text assessment BY the trainer about the candidate's performance
    during the training. Manual entry by the trainer.

================================================================================
OBJECT: CandidateTrainingStep__c  (Label: "Candidate Training Step")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CandidateTrainingStep__c is one candidate's progress through ONE step of
their training - the runtime copy of a StepTemplate__c. When a candidate is
enrolled (Candidate_Training_Creation flow), each step template of the chosen
program version is instantiated into one of these records with the content
copied over (title, sequence, learning goal, notes, expected duration) and
status "Not Started". Trainers then drive each step's status as the training
progresses; deliverables (the candidate's actual work products) are
master-detail children of the step; training sessions link back to the step
they cover.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, Training / LMS domain (Training Module app).
- MASTER-DETAIL CHILD of Candidate_Training__c: sharing is Controlled By
  Parent - whoever sees the training sees its steps. No owner of its own.
- 16 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Name is plain Text - the creation flow writes the step template's Title
  into it, so the record reads like "Resume Deep-Dive" rather than a number.
- Scale: 1,372 records (May 8 - Aug 6, 2026); they belong to the 160
  step-based trainings (~8.6 steps per stepped training on average).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All steps share one layout ("Candidate Training Step Layout") and one
Lightning record page (Candidate_Training_Step_Record_Page).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - INSTANTIATION. Steps are created ONLY by the
  Candidate_Training_Creation flow at enrollment: one record per
  StepTemplate__c of the chosen program version, copying Name (= template
  Title), Sequence, Learning Goal, Training Notes, Training Step content and
  Expected Duration, linking Step_Template__c, inheriting the training's
  Assigned Trainer, and setting Status = "Not Started". Users never create
  steps by hand in the normal process.

STEP 2 - SCHEDULING. When the training is booked into a Session Window
  (candidate portal or admin "Book Session Slot"), the booking Apex walks
  the steps in Sequence order and stamps each one's Started_At__c on
  consecutive BUSINESS days starting at the window's start date/time (in
  the window's time zone). It also creates/attaches a Session__c per step
  (Session__c.Candidate_Training_Step__c) and, for candidates sharing a
  cohort slot, Session_Attendee__c rows pointing at the step.

STEP 3 - EXECUTION. The trainer runs the session for the step and updates
  Status__c. The field's help text encodes the team's conventions: candidate
  did not show up -> "Absent"; trainer was not available -> "Skipped";
  candidate removed from the training -> "Blocked". Completing the linked
  Session (Session_Complete_Activate_Deliverables flow, plus the
  SessionCompletionAttendeeTrigger for cohort attendees) activates the
  step's deliverables so the candidate can submit work.

STEP 4 - COMPLETION / DROP. The trainer marks the step "Completed" as the
  candidate progresses (in practice only the status is set - the
  Completed__c timestamp is never filled, see part 8). If the whole
  training is dropped, the Candidate_Training_Dropped_Cascade flow marks
  the unfinished steps "Dropped". The candidate portal Overview
  (DashboardService + PortalHelpers) buckets the steps by status to show a
  progress tracker.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Candidate_Training__c (Candidate_Training__c, MASTER-DETAIL, 100%): the
  enrollment this step belongs to. Sharing and cascade-delete flow from it.

LOOKUPS FROM THE STEP:
- StepTemplate__c (Step_Template__c, 100%): the blueprint this step was
  instantiated from - the link back to the curriculum definition.
- Recruiter__c (Assigned_Trainer__c, 71%): the trainer running this step,
  inherited from the training at creation.
- User (Assigned_Trainer_User__c, 0%): unused User-flavored twin of the
  trainer lookup.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT THE STEP:
- Deliverable__c (MASTER-DETAIL child via Candidate_Training_Step__c): the
  work products the candidate must submit for this step.
- Session__c (lookup Session__c.Candidate_Training_Step__c): the scheduled
  meeting(s) covering this step.
- Session_Attendee__c (lookup): cohort co-attendees mapped to their own
  step for a shared session slot.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Steps are system-generated and conventions (Absent vs Skipped vs
Blocked) are documented in help text rather than enforced.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
No record-triggered flow or Apex trigger runs ON this object. It is written
by automation living elsewhere:
- Candidate_Training_Creation flow: creates the steps at enrollment (the
  only creation path).
- CandidatePortalController.bookSessionWindow /
  AdminSessionAssignmentController: stamp Started_At__c per business day
  and wire sessions/attendees to the steps at slot booking.
- Candidate_Training_Dropped_Cascade flow: sets Status = "Dropped" on
  unfinished steps when the parent training is dropped.
- Session_Complete_Activate_Deliverables flow (on Session__c) and
  SessionCompletionAttendeeTrigger (on Session_Attendee__c): when the
  step's session completes, activate the step's deliverables.
- Extension_Requested_Notify_Trainer / Review_Extension_Request flows and
  DashboardService/PortalHelpers (candidate portal) READ the step for
  context, trainer routing and portal progress buckets.
Layout quick actions are only the standard New Task / New Event / Log a
Call / Send Email plus global creates - no custom buttons.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 16, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: PARENT & BLUEPRINT LINKS ----------------------------------------

Candidate_Training__c (Candidate Training) [Master-Detail ->
Candidate_Training__c]
    THE required parent: which enrollment this step belongs to. 100%
    populated; sharing and deletes cascade from it.

Step_Template__c (Step Template) [Lookup -> StepTemplate__c]
    The blueprint this step was instantiated from, linked by the creation
    flow. 100% populated with zero orphans - every step still resolves to a
    live template.

--- GROUP B: STEP CONTENT (COPIED FROM THE TEMPLATE) -------------------------

Sequence__c (Sequence) [Number]
    The step's order within the training (copied from the template; 100%
    populated). Booking walks steps in this order when assigning one
    business day per step; the portal shows steps sorted by it.

Learning_Goal__c (Learning Goal) [LongTextArea]
    What the candidate should achieve in this step - copied from the
    template at creation so later template edits don't rewrite history.

Training_Step__c (Training Step) [LongTextArea]
    The step's instructional content/outline, copied from the template.

Training_Method__c (Training Notes) [LongTextArea]
    How the step is delivered (method/notes), copied from the template.
    Note the label mismatch: API "Training_Method__c", label "Training
    Notes" - same situation as on the template object.

Expected_Duration__c (Expected Duration) [Number]
    Planned minutes for this step, copied from the template's
    Expected_Duration_Min__c (75% populated - blank where the template had
    no duration).

Duration__c (Duration) [Number]
    Intended to hold the ACTUAL minutes spent on the step. Never populated
    in practice (0 of 1,372) - actual-time tracking is not used.

--- GROUP C: STATUS & PROGRESS TIMESTAMPS ------------------------------------

Status__c (Status) [Picklist]
    The step's progress state: Not Started | In Progress | Blocked |
    Skipped | Completed | Absent | Dropped. Set to "Not Started" at
    creation, then updated manually by the trainer. Help text conventions:
    candidate did not come -> Absent; trainer not there -> Skipped;
    candidate removed from training -> Blocked ("Dropped" is what the
    cascade flow sets when the whole training is dropped). Real data:
    Not Started 867 (63%) | Completed 481 (35%) | Dropped 10 | Absent 8 |
    In Progress 4 | Skipped 2. The portal maps these into
    active/completed buckets for the candidate's progress bar.

Started_At__c (Started At) [DateTime]
    When this step is SCHEDULED to run - stamped by the slot-booking Apex,
    which places step 1 on the window's start date and each further step on
    the next business day, at the window's slot time. 64% populated (steps
    of booked trainings). Deliverable due dates are computed from this
    date + the definition's Days_To_Complete.

Completed__c (Completed) [DateTime]
    Intended completion timestamp. NEVER populated in practice (0 records,
    even though 481 steps have Status "Completed") - teams only flip the
    status. Treat status, not this field, as the source of truth.

Due_At__c (Due At) [DateTime]
    Intended per-step deadline. Never populated (0 records) - deadlines
    actually live on the child Deliverable__c due-date fields.

--- GROUP D: TRAINER & WORKING NOTES -----------------------------------------

Assigned_Trainer__c (Assigned Trainer) [Lookup -> Recruiter__c ("Employee")]
    The trainer running this step, inherited from the parent training at
    creation (71% populated). Can be reassigned per step if a different
    trainer covers it.

Assigned_Trainer_User__c (Assigned Trainer User) [Lookup -> User]
    User-flavored trainer link. Never populated (0 records).

Assigned_Trainer_Name__c (Assigned Trainer Name) [Formula, Text]
    Formula concatenating Assigned_Trainer_User__r First/Middle/Last name.
    Because Assigned_Trainer_User__c is never filled, this formula is
    always blank in practice - a dead display helper.

Notes__c (Notes) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text working notes the trainer keeps on this step (what was
    covered, how the candidate did). Manual entry.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 1,372, created 2026-05-08 through 2026-08-06, belonging to
  the 160 step-based trainings (the 263 cohort-style trainings have none).
- Status: Not Started 867 (63%) | Completed 481 (35%) | Dropped 10 |

================================================================================
OBJECT: StepTemplate__c  (Label: "Step Template")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
StepTemplate__c is the curriculum BLUEPRINT: one ordered step of a training
program version (e.g. "Day 1 - Resume Deep-Dive", "System Design Basics").
It defines what the step covers (title, description, learning goal,
training content), how long it should take, and in what order it comes.
It holds NO candidate data - when a candidate enrolls, each template is
copied into a CandidateTrainingStep__c, and the template's
Step_Deliverable_Definition__c children define which work products that
step demands. Editing a template changes future enrollments only; existing
candidate steps keep their copied content.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, blueprint tier of the Training / LMS domain.
- MASTER-DETAIL CHILD of Program_Version__c: sharing Controlled By Parent;
  deleting a version deletes its templates.
- 13 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 1 list view.
- Auto-number Name in the format ST-{0000} (the human-readable name lives
  in Title__c).
- Scale: tiny and admin-curated - 52 records across 8 program versions,
  created 2026-05-07 to 2026-07-09.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. One layout ("Step Template Layout") and one Lightning page
(Step_Template_Record_Page) serve all templates.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - AUTHORING. An admin/training designer runs the Program_Creation
  screen flow, which builds the Program, its first Program_Version, and the
  ordered StepTemplates with their Step_Deliverable_Definitions in one
  wizard. Later edits go through the Update_Program_Version screen flow,
  which reads the current version's templates (and their deliverable
  definitions) and clones/adjusts them into a NEW version - versions are
  treated as immutable once candidates are enrolled.

STEP 2 - CONSUMPTION AT ENROLLMENT. The Candidate_Training_Creation flow
  queries the chosen version's templates and instantiates one
  CandidateTrainingStep__c per template, copying Title -> step Name,
  Sequence, Learning Goal, Training Notes, Training Step content and
  Expected Duration Min -> Expected Duration.

STEP 3 - ROLLUP. Expected_Duration_Min__c feeds the version's
  Total_Expected_Duration rollup, giving each program version a total
  planned length.

NOTE ON REAL USAGE: the org's highest-volume program ("Interview Readiness
Training", 61% of enrollments) has NO step templates - it runs as
cohort/session-window group training. Templates are really the backbone of
the 1-1 technical programs (Technical 1-1: 10 steps, Advanced AI/ML: 14
steps, etc.).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Program_Version__c (Program_Version__c, MASTER-DETAIL, required): the
  versioned course configuration this step belongs to. Sharing and deletes
  cascade from it; the step count/duration roll up to it.

LOOKUPS FROM THE TEMPLATE:
- Program__c (Program__c, 100%): denormalized link to the top-level
  program, so templates can be reported per program without joining
  through the version.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT THE TEMPLATE:
- CandidateTrainingStep__c (lookup Step_Template__c): every runtime step
  instantiated from this blueprint (the "which candidates ran this step"
  view).
- Step_Deliverable_Definition__c (lookup Step_Template__c): the work
  products this step requires from the candidate.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Templates are only created/edited through the two admin wizard flows,
which control the data shape themselves.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
No record-triggered flows, no Apex triggers, no quick actions. All activity
comes from screen flows that write or read it:
- Program_Creation (screen flow): creates templates (with their deliverable
  definitions) while building a new program + version.
- Update_Program_Version (screen flow): reads the old version's templates,
  lets the admin adjust them, and creates the copies under the new version
  (Lookup_Key__c is used to match steps and their definitions across the
  clone).
- Candidate_Training_Creation (screen flow): reads the templates of the
  selected version to instantiate the candidate's steps at enrollment.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 13, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHERE THE TEMPLATE BELONGS --------------------------------------

Program_Version__c (Program Version) [Master-Detail -> Program_Version__c]
    THE required parent: which course version this step is part of. 100%
    populated; the version's step list IS the curriculum.

Program__c (Program) [Lookup -> Program__c]
    Denormalized link to the top-level program (100% populated), set by the
    authoring flows for easier reporting/filtering.

--- GROUP B: STEP DEFINITION (ORDER, LENGTH, REQUIREDNESS) -------------------

Title__c (Title) [Text, required]
    The step's human-readable name (e.g. "Mock Interview - Round 1"). The
    only required field besides the parent; copied into the runtime step's
    Name at enrollment.

Sequence__c (Sequence) [Number]
    The step's position in the curriculum (1, 2, 3...). 100% populated;
    copied to the runtime step and used by booking to lay steps onto
    consecutive business days in order.

Expected_Duration_Min__c (Expected Duration Min) [Number]
    Planned length of the step in minutes. 69% populated (36 of 52).
    Copied to the runtime step's Expected_Duration__c and rolled up into
    the version's Total_Expected_Duration.

Is_Required__c (Is Required) [Checkbox]
    Whether the step is mandatory for the program. In practice ALL 52
    templates are checked TRUE - optional steps are not used yet, so
    nothing downstream branches on it today.

--- GROUP C: STEP CONTENT ----------------------------------------------------

Description__c (Description) [LongTextArea]
    Plain-text description of the step for admins/trainers.

Step_Description__c (Step Description) [Html]
    Rich-text (formatted) version of the step description - the prettier
    of the two description fields, used for display.

Learning_Goal__c (Learning Goal) [LongTextArea]
    What the candidate should be able to do after this step. Copied
    verbatim onto every runtime step at enrollment.

Training_Step__c (Training Step) [LongTextArea]
    The instructional content/outline of the step itself. Copied to the
    runtime step at enrollment.

Training_Method__c (Training Notes) [LongTextArea]
    Delivery method / trainer notes for the step. Copied to the runtime
    step. Same API-name-vs-label mismatch as on the runtime object
    (API says "Method", label says "Notes").

--- GROUP D: HOUSEKEEPING KEYS -----------------------------------------------

Lookup_Key__c (Lookup Key) [Text]
    A technical matching key written by the authoring wizards so that
    Update_Program_Version can pair each step with its deliverable
    definitions (and with its clone in the new version) while looping in
    the flow. 50 of 52 populated. Not meant for human use.

Tags__c (Tags) [Text]
    Free-text tags for categorizing steps. Never used (0 of 52 populated).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 52, created 2026-05-07 to 2026-07-09, spread over 8
  program versions: Advanced AI/ML Training V1 14 | "Techinal 1-1 Training
  - V1" (typo is in the real version name) 10 | Non-Technical 1-1 V1 6 |

  Demo 1 V1 2.
