    its Start Date at booking; training steps are then laid out on
    consecutive business days from here. 100% populated.

Activate_From__c (Activate From) [Date]
    From when the slot becomes VISIBLE in the candidate portal - a "go on
    sale" date. The portal only offers windows whose Activate_From is today
    or earlier (or blank). 100% populated.

--- GROUP C: CAPACITY & LIFECYCLE --------------------------------------------

Candidate_Capacity__c (Candidate Capacity) [Number]
    Maximum number of candidates the slot can hold. Both current records
    hold 5. The portal computes seats remaining from this minus the booked
    count and shows "full" when none remain.

Booked_Count__c (Booked Count) [Number]
    How many candidates have booked the slot so far - incremented by +1 by
    the portal and admin booking Apex under a row lock (FOR UPDATE) to
    prevent double-booking races. Both current records show 1.

Status__c (Status) [Picklist]
    Lifecycle of the slot: Upcoming (bookable - the ONLY status the portal
    offers) | Active (cohort is running) | Completed (cohort finished).
    Data note: the 2 records in preprod are 1 Active + 1 Completed, so
    nothing is portal-bookable at this snapshot. No automation moves the
    status - it is maintained manually (verify with team).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 2, created 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-06.
- Status: Active 1 | Completed 1 (none "Upcoming" - no slot is currently
  bookable in the portal).
- Every field populated on both records: Cohort, Trainer, Start Date,
  Activate From, Time Zone, capacity and booked count.
- Capacity 5 on both; Booked Count 1 on both - the group-booking model has
  been exercised by a single candidate per cohort so far.
- Key takeaway: the object is a just-launched booking template; expect
  "Upcoming" windows to appear as new cohorts are opened.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Session_Attendee__c  (Label: "Session Attendee")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Session_Attendee__c is the JUNCTION that lets several candidates share one
group training session. When the FIRST candidate of a cohort books a
Session_Window slot, real Session__c records are created for their training
steps (those sessions own the Zoom meeting). When a SECOND or later candidate
books the same cohort, no new meetings are created - instead one
Session_Attendee__c row per training step links that candidate's training/
step to the existing "master" session. The row is how the extra candidate's
portal surfaces the shared meeting (topic, link, date, times) and how the
system knows to complete THEIR steps and activate THEIR deliverables when
the shared session finishes. Almost every non-lookup field is a formula
mirroring either the master session or the candidate's own training times.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object in the Training/LMS layer.
- MASTER-DETAIL CHILD OF Session__c: an attendee row cannot exist without
  its session; sharing is "Controlled By Parent" and deleting the session
  deletes its attendee rows. No owner of its own.
- 11 custom fields (4 lookups incl. the master-detail + 7 formulas),
  0 record types, 0 validation rules, 0 list views.
- Auto-number Name in the format SA-XXXX.
- Scale: 0 records in preprod - the object is deployed and fully wired into
  code, but no second candidate has booked a shared cohort slot yet.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All attendee rows are the same flavor.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATION (CODE ONLY, NEVER MANUAL). Two Apex paths create rows,
  both inside the Session Window booking logic:
  - CandidatePortalController.bookSessionWindow: after the capacity check,
    if the cohort already has master sessions, the code matches the new
    candidate's training steps to the master sessions BY STEP SEQUENCE
    NUMBER and inserts one attendee row per matched step (session +
    candidate + training + step).
  - AdminSessionAssignmentController: the internal "Book Session Slot"
    action performs the same match-and-insert on behalf of a candidate.

STEP 2 - PORTAL DISPLAY. The candidate portal's dashboard/Sessions tab
  (DashboardService.queryLiveSessions) collects the candidate's attendee
  rows, pulls in the linked master sessions alongside the candidate's own
  sessions, and re-points each shared session at THIS candidate's training
  and step so the portal shows it as theirs - with the shared meeting link,
  topic and times coming through the formula fields.

STEP 3 - COMPLETION FAN-OUT. When the master session is marked Completed,
  the flow on Session__c only activates deliverables for the first (owner)
  candidate's step. The Apex SessionCompletionAttendeeTrigger then reads all
  Session_Attendee__c rows of the completed session and activates each
  attendee's own "Not Active" deliverables, so every candidate in the group
  progresses, not just the first booker.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARENT:
- Session__c (via Session__c, MASTER-DETAIL, relationship "Attendees"): the
  shared master session being attended. Sharing/deletion cascade from it;
  five of the formula fields read through this relationship.

LOOKUPS:
- Account (Candidate__c, required): the attending candidate (Person
  Account) - the extra participant, not the session's own candidate.
- Candidate_Training__c (Candidate_Training__c, required): the attending
  candidate's OWN training enrollment - so their progress is tracked on
  their record even though the meeting belongs to another training.
- CandidateTrainingStep__c (Candidate_Training_Step__c, required): the
  attending candidate's OWN step that this shared session fulfills - the
  step whose deliverables are activated when the session completes.

NOTHING points at Session_Attendee__c - it is a pure leaf junction.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Integrity is guaranteed by the creating Apex (all three lookups are
required at the field level and are always set together by code).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
No flows, no triggers, and no quick actions run ON this object. It is purely
written and read by Apex:
- WRITERS: CandidatePortalController.createOrAttachSessions (portal booking)
  and AdminSessionAssignmentController (admin booking) - insert only.
- READERS: SessionCompletionAttendeeTrigger (on Session__c - fans session
  completion out to attendee deliverables) and DashboardService (builds the
  candidate portal's session list from attendee rows).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 11, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: THE LINKS (WHO ATTENDS WHAT) ------------------------------------

Session__c (Session) [Master-Detail -> Session__c]
    THE required parent: the shared master session being attended. Set by
    the booking Apex after matching the candidate's step sequence to the
    master session's step sequence.

Candidate__c (Candidate) [Lookup -> Account, required]
    The attending candidate (Person Account). DashboardService filters on
    this to find "sessions I attend but do not own".

Candidate_Training__c (Candidate Training) [Lookup -> Candidate_Training__c,
required]
    The attending candidate's own training enrollment - the record whose
    progress this shared session advances.

Candidate_Training_Step__c (Candidate Training Step) [Lookup ->
CandidateTrainingStep__c, required]
    The attending candidate's own curriculum step covered by the shared
    session. The completion trigger activates the deliverables that belong
    to this step.

--- GROUP B: MIRRORS OF THE MASTER SESSION (FORMULAS) ------------------------
These read-only formulas exist so the portal (and reports) can show the
shared meeting's details on the attendee row without extra queries.

Meeting_Link__c (Meeting Link) [Formula, Text]
    The master session's join URL (Session__r.Meeting_Link__c) - the link
    the attending candidate actually clicks.

Meeting_Topic__c (Meeting Topic) [Formula, Text]
    The master session's computed topic (Session__r.MeetingTopic__c), e.g.
    "Program - Step name".

Scheduled_Date__c (Scheduled Date) [Formula, Date]
    The master session's date (Session__r.Scheduled_Date__c).

Session_Status__c (Session Status) [Formula, Text]
    The master session's current status as text
    (TEXT(Session__r.Status__c)) - lets the portal show Scheduled/Completed
    on the attendee's card.

--- GROUP C: THE ATTENDEE'S OWN TIMES (FORMULAS) -----------------------------
The shared meeting happens at one absolute moment, but each candidate sees
it in their own timezone - these mirror the candidate's training-level
converted times rather than the session's.

Candidate_TZ_Start_Time__c (Candidate TZ Start Time) [Formula, Text]
    The daily start time in the attending candidate's own timezone
    (TEXT(Candidate_Training__r.Candidate_Time_Zone_Start_Time__c)).

Candidate_TZ_End_Time__c (Candidate TZ End Time) [Formula, Text]
    The daily end time in the attending candidate's own timezone
    (TEXT(Candidate_Training__r.Candidate_Time_Zone_End_Time__c)).

Time_Zone__c (Time Zone) [Formula, Text]
    The attending candidate's timezone label
    (TEXT(Candidate_Training__r.Time_Zone__c)) that the two times above are
    quoted in.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 0. The object is fully built and wired (portal + admin
  booking write it, the completion trigger and portal dashboard read it),
  but no cohort has had a SECOND candidate book the same slot yet - both
  existing Session Windows show exactly 1 booking each.
- Key takeaway for answering questions: treat this object as live
  infrastructure with no data - the group-training model it enables has not
  been exercised in preprod beyond single-candidate cohorts.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Pre_Enrolment_Request__c  (Label: "Pre Enrolment Request")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Pre_Enrolment_Request__c tracks ONE "pre-enrolment form" sent to a prospective
candidate (a Lead) BEFORE they are enrolled into Techsara's training program.
It is the intake questionnaire of the training funnel: an employee clicks a
button on the Lead, the system generates a secure single-use link and emails it
to the candidate, and the candidate fills the form on a PUBLIC page of the
Techsara Candidate Hub Experience site - no login needed. The record is both
the delivery envelope (token, link, sent/opened/submitted timestamps, expiry)
and the container for everything the candidate typed: name, contact numbers,
home address, visa status, tech niche, relocation readiness, preferred
training time slot, position-type preferences, criminal-record declaration and
acknowledgement. When the form is submitted, a flow copies all the answers
onto the Lead, so the Lead record (and later the converted candidate Person
Account, via the Lead Conversion Flow) carries the same profile data. The
form's education step also creates Education_History__c records for the lead
(see that object's section).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, part of the training/enrolment intake domain.
- Standalone object with LOOKUPS to Lead (the usual parent in practice - 97%
  populated) and to Account (Candidate__c - intended post-conversion link;
  NOTE: this field exists in the source metadata but is NOT yet deployed to
  the preprod org, so it cannot be queried there).
- Sharing model Public Read/Write internally, Private for external users.
- 30 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 0 list views.
- Auto-number Name in the format PRENR-XXXX.
- Field history tracking is enabled; has its own Lightning record page
  (Pre_Enrolment_Request_Record_Page).
- Access is granted through the Sales, Sales User, Bench Marketing and
  Customer Success permission sets; the public form itself runs as the guest
  user in system mode.
- Scale: 333 records in preprod (Apr 2026 - Aug 2026) - a recent feature.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Every pre-enrolment request is the same flavor; the Status__c picklist
carries the lifecycle instead.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - SEND. On a Lead record page, an employee clicks the "Send Pre
  Enrolment Request" quick action (present on the Lead record page and on the
  B2B Website Candidate / Lead layouts). This launches the screen flow
  send_pre_enrollment_form, which:
  - refuses to run if the Lead has no email (error screen);
  - EXPIRES any still-active request for the same Lead (status Draft, Sent or
    Opened is flipped to Expired) so only one link is live per lead;
  - calls the Apex action CreateToken (invocable "Generate Pre Enrollment
    Token") to mint a 12-character single-use token: 6 hex chars of an
    HMAC-SHA256 signature (secret from the Token_Secret__mdt custom metadata
    row "Pre_Enrollment_Flow_Secret") + 6 random hex chars;
  - creates the Pre_Enrolment_Request__c record with Status "Sent", the
    token, a 2-day expiry (NOW() + 2), Sent_On, the lead link, and name/email
    snapshots taken from the Lead at that moment;
  - builds the public link from the Candidate_Hub_URL custom label +
    "/s/pre-enrolment-form?flowtoken=<token>" and emails it to the candidate
    from noreply@techsarasolutions.com using an email template.

STEP 2 - CANDIDATE OPENS THE LINK. The link lands on the public
  "pre-enrolment-form" page of the Techsara Candidate Hub Experience site,
  which runs the screen flow Guest_Pre_Enrolment ("Lead : Guest
  Pre-Enrolment") as the site guest user in system mode without sharing. The
  flow looks the request up BY TOKEN, stamps Opened_On, then validates:
  - no matching token          -> "Invalid" page;
  - Expiration_Datetime passed -> "Expired link" page;
  - Status already Opened, Submitted, Expired or Cancelled -> "Link used"
    page. The link is genuinely SINGLE-USE: even a candidate who opened the
    form once without submitting cannot open it again - staff must send a
    fresh form (which is why 27 records sit at "Opened" forever).
  - otherwise Status flips Sent -> Opened and the form is shown.

STEP 3 - CANDIDATE FILLS AND SUBMITS. The form collects personal details
  (first/middle/last name, calling + WhatsApp numbers, email, home address),
  profile preferences (niche, visa status, relocation readiness, preferred
  EST training slot, position types), the criminal-record declaration and the
  acknowledgement checkbox. An education step then loops "Add another?" to
  capture one or more education entries (degree type, institute country,
  institute, course, dates, CGPA) which are inserted as Education_History__c
  records linked to the same Lead. On submit the flow writes all answers back
  to this request, sets Status "Submitted", stamps Submitted_On and shows a
  thank-you page. KNOWN GAP: the form shows an "Additional Comments" box but
  the flow never saves it to Additional_Comments_or_Questions__c - whatever
  the candidate types there is discarded.

STEP 4 - SYNC TO LEAD. The record-triggered flow Pre_Enrolment_Requests fires
  when Status becomes "Submitted" and copies everything onto the parent Lead:
  standard fields (First/Last Name, Email, Phone, street/city/state/postal/
  country) and the Lead's mirror custom fields (Niche, Niche Other, Visa
  Status, Relocation Readiness/Other, Training Schedule, WhatsApp number,
  Criminal Record Declaration, Position Type checkboxes, Additional
  Comments), plus the Lead's "Latest Pre Enrolment" tracking fields (Status,
  Form Link, Sent/Opened/Submitted On) and Lead.Pre_Enrolment_Request__c
  pointing back at this record. From then on the Lead is the working copy.

STEP 5 - LEAD CONVERSION. When the Lead is converted via Lead_Conversion_Flow,
  the flow fetches this request ("Pre Enrollment data Fetch") to show the
  profile information during conversion, carries the same answers onto the
  new candidate Person Account, and re-parents the lead's
  Education_History__c records to the new Account. The request's own
  Candidate__c field is INTENDED to hold that converted candidate (per its
  field description) but no active automation sets it and the field is not
  yet deployed to preprod - verify with team.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOKUPS FROM THIS OBJECT:
- Lead (Lead__c): the prospective candidate this form was sent to - the real
  parent in practice (324 of 333 records). Created by the send flow from the
  Lead the button was clicked on.
- Account (Candidate__c): the candidate Person Account after lead conversion
  (field description: "Linked candidate record after lead conversion").
  Exists in source metadata only - NOT deployed to preprod yet, and no flow
  currently populates it.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT THIS OBJECT:
- Lead (Lead.Pre_Enrolment_Request__c): reverse pointer stamped by the
  Pre_Enrolment_Requests flow on submission - "the latest submitted form for
  this lead" (163 leads carry it; fewer than the 204 submitted forms because
  some leads submitted more than once and the pointer keeps the latest).

RELATED BY PROCESS (no direct field on this object):
- Education_History__c: the guest form's education step creates these against
  the same Lead; they travel to the Account at conversion.
- Lead "Latest Pre Enrolment" fields (Latest_Pre_Enrolment_Status__c /
  _Form_Link__c / _Sent_On__c / _Opened_On__c / _Submitted_On__c): mirror of
  this record's lifecycle on the Lead for list views and reports.
- Token_Secret__mdt: custom metadata holding the HMAC secret used to mint
  Public_Token__c (row "Pre_Enrollment_Flow_Secret").

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Integrity is enforced by the flows instead (email required before
sending, token validation, single-active-request-per-lead, link expiry).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOW (active):
- Pre_Enrolment_Requests (after save, update, when Status__c becomes
  "Submitted"): copies all form answers to the parent Lead (standard fields +
  the Lead's mirror custom fields + the Latest Pre Enrolment tracking fields)
  and stamps Lead.Pre_Enrolment_Request__c with this record's Id.

SCREEN FLOWS:
- send_pre_enrollment_form (launched by the "Send Pre Enrolment Request"
  quick action on Lead): expires older active requests, CREATES this record
  (Status "Sent", token, 2-day expiry, snapshots, public link) and emails the
  link to the candidate. Calls the Apex invocable CreateToken.
- Guest_Pre_Enrolment ("Lead : Guest Pre-Enrolment", public, system mode
  without sharing, hosted on the Techsara Candidate Hub site page
  /pre-enrolment-form): validates the token, flips Status Sent -> Opened ->
  Submitted, stamps Opened_On / Submitted_On, saves the candidate's answers
  onto this record and creates the Education_History__c records.

APEX:
- CreateToken.cls (invocable, called from the send flow): generates the
  12-char tamper-evident public token from Token_Secret__mdt + a random AES
  key. No trigger exists on this object.

QUICK ACTIONS / BUTTONS:
- Lead.Send_Pre_Enrolment_Request ("Send Pre Enrolment Request") - the only
  button; lives on the Lead record page (Lead_Record_Page_Three_Column) and
  three Lead layouts, launches send_pre_enrollment_form.

NOTHING marks links Expired on a schedule: "Expired" is set either by the
send flow superseding an old request, or the guest flow simply refuses entry
after Expiration_Datetime - the stored status can stay "Sent"/"Opened" until
a new form is sent. "Cancelled" has no automation; it is set manually.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 30, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHO THE REQUEST IS FOR (LINKS & SNAPSHOTS) ----------------------

Lead__c (Lead) [Lookup -> Lead]
    The prospective candidate the form was sent to. Set by the send flow from
    the Lead the quick action was clicked on. Populated on 324 of 333 records
    (97%); the handful without a lead are anomalies/tests. Everything the
    candidate submits is copied onto this Lead.

Candidate__c (Candidate) [Lookup -> Account]
    Intended link to the candidate Person Account after lead conversion
    (field description: "Linked candidate record after lead conversion").
    NOT YET DEPLOYED to the preprod org (exists only in source metadata) and
    no active flow populates it - verify with team before relying on it.

Candidate_Name_Snapshot__c (Candidate Name Snapshot) [Text]
    The lead's name frozen at the moment the form was sent, stamped by the
    send flow. Kept as text so the request still reads correctly if the Lead
    is renamed, converted or deleted. 100% populated.

Candidate_Email_Snapshot__c (Candidate Email Snapshot) [Email]
    The lead's email frozen at send time by the send flow - the address the
    form link was actually mailed to. 100% populated. Compare with
    Email_Address__c below, which is what the candidate typed on the form.

--- GROUP B: FORM LIFECYCLE & TOKEN PLUMBING ---------------------------------

Status__c (Status) [Picklist]
    The lifecycle of the form link. Values:
      Draft     - defined in the picklist but never used in practice (the
                  send flow creates records directly as "Sent"; 0 in data).
      Sent      - link emailed, candidate has not opened it yet (2 records).
      Opened    - candidate opened the link but never submitted; the link is
                  now burned and cannot be reopened (27 records).
      Submitted - candidate completed the form; fires the sync-to-Lead flow
                  (204 records, 61% - the normal end state).
      Expired   - the 2-day window passed, or the request was superseded when
                  staff sent a fresh form (99 records, 30%).
      Cancelled - manually cancelled by staff; no automation sets it
                  (1 record).
    Set by: send flow ("Sent", "Expired"), guest flow ("Opened",
    "Submitted"), manual ("Cancelled").

Public_Token__c (Public Token) [TextArea]
    The 12-character single-use access token embedded in the form URL,
    generated by the CreateToken Apex invocable (6 HMAC-SHA256 hex chars
    signed with the Token_Secret__mdt secret + 6 random hex chars). The guest
    flow finds the request BY this token - it is effectively the password to
    this one form. 100% populated. Not shown to internal users as anything
    meaningful.

Public_Form_Link__c (Public Form Link) [Url]
    The full public URL emailed to the candidate: Candidate_Hub_URL custom
    label + "/s/pre-enrolment-form?flowtoken=<token>". Built and stored by
    the send flow; also copied to Lead.Latest_Pre_Enrolment_Form_Link__c so
    staff can resend it manually. 100% populated.

Expiration_Datetime__c (Expiration Datetime) [DateTime]
    When the link stops working - always send time + 2 days (formula NOW()+2
    in the send flow). The guest flow shows the "Expired" page after this
    moment; the send flow also stamps it when force-expiring an old request.
    100% populated.

Sent_On__c (Sent On) [DateTime]
    When the form email went out (stamped by the send flow at creation).
    100% populated. Mirrored to Lead.Latest_Pre_Enrolment_Sent_On__c.

Opened_On__c (Opened On) [DateTime]
    When the candidate opened the link - the guest flow stamps it (by token)
    every time the link is visited, before validation. Populated on 186
    records (56%): the sent-but-never-opened and force-expired requests stay
    empty. Mirrored to Lead.Latest_Pre_Enrolment_Opened_On__c.

Submitted_On__c (Submitted On) [DateTime]
    When the candidate clicked the final submit (stamped by the guest flow
    just before the thank-you page). Populated on 127 records - fewer than
    the 204 Submitted records, so the timestamp element appears to have been
    added after the earliest submissions (data note, verify with team).
    Mirrored to Lead.Latest_Pre_Enrolment_Submitted_On__c.

--- GROUP C: IDENTITY & CONTACT DETAILS (FILLED BY THE CANDIDATE) ------------
All fields in this group (and groups D/E) are written by the Guest_Pre_
Enrolment flow when the candidate submits the public form; internal users
normally only read them. They are populated on exactly the 204 submitted
records (61%) unless noted - blank on forms never submitted.

First_Name__c (First Name) [Text]
    Candidate's first name as typed on the form. Copied to Lead.FirstName by
    the sync flow on submission.

Middle_Name__c (Middle Name) [Text]
    Candidate's middle name - optional on the form (only 10 records have
    one). NOT copied to the Lead (the Lead has no middle-name field).

Last_Name__c (Last Name) [Text]
    Candidate's last name as typed. Copied to Lead.LastName.

Email_Address__c (Email Address) [Email]
    The email the candidate confirmed/typed on the form (pre-filled from the
    lead's email). Copied to Lead.Email - so a candidate can correct their
    email here and the Lead gets the corrected one.

screen_calling__c (Contact Number Calling) [Phone]
    The candidate's calling number. Note the odd API name ("screen_calling")
    versus its label - do not confuse it with the WhatsApp number. Copied to
    Lead.Phone.

Contact_Number_Whatsapp__c (Contact Number Whatsapp) [Phone]
    The candidate's WhatsApp number - Techsara coordinates training and
    marketing with candidates over WhatsApp, hence a separate field. Copied
    to Lead.Contact_Number_WhatsApp__c.

Home_Address__c (Home Address) [Address]
    Compound address field (street, city, state code, postal code, country
    code) captured with the address screen component. The sync flow copies
    the parts onto the Lead's standard address. Populated on submitted
    records (city/state present on all 204).

Current_State_in_USA__c (Current State in USA) [Picklist, global set "State"]
    Which US state the candidate currently lives in (51 values). EFFECTIVELY
    UNUSED: the guest form does not show it and no flow writes it - 0 of 333
    records have a value. The state inside Home_Address__c is what actually
    gets captured. (Probably an early design leftover - verify with team.)

--- GROUP D: PROFILE & TRAINING PREFERENCES (FILLED BY THE CANDIDATE) --------

Niche__c (Niche) [Picklist, global value set "Niche"]
    The technology/career track the candidate wants to train and be marketed
    in: AI ML Engineer | Python Developer/Engineer | Java Fullstack
    Developer/Engineer | Product/Project Manager | Marketing Manager |
    Finance Analyst | Other. Copied to the Lead (and on to the candidate
    Account at conversion) - this drives which training program fits. Data:
    AI ML Engineer dominates (130 of the 204 submitted, 64%).

Niche_Other__c (Niche Other) [TextArea]
    Free-text niche when the candidate picks "Other" (21 records). Copied to
    Lead.Niche_Other__c.

Current_Visa_Status__c (Current Visa Status) [Picklist, global set
"Visa_Status"]
    The candidate's US work-authorization status: CPT | OPT | STEM OPT
    Extension | H1B | B2 | Green Card EAD | Green Card / Permanent Resident |
    US Citizen. Critical for placement eligibility. Copied to
    Lead.Visa_Status__c. Data: OPT 142, STEM OPT Extension 36, H1B 13 - the
    audience is overwhelmingly students on OPT.

Relocation_Readiness__c (Relocation Readiness) [Picklist]
    Whether the candidate will move for a job: "Yes, I am willing to relocate
    anywhere in the USA" (151 - the dominant answer) | "Yes, but only within
    specific states (mention in comments)" (5) | "No, I prefer remote / local
    positions only" (7) | Other (3). Copied to the Lead; recruiters use it
    when matching jobs.

Relocation_Other__c (Relocation Other) [TextArea]
    Free-text detail when relocation readiness is "Other" (2 records).
    Copied to Lead.Relocation_Other__c.

Preferred_Training_Schedule_EST__c (Preferred Training Schedule EST)
[Picklist, global set "Training_Schedule"]
    Which daily EST time slot the candidate prefers for training sessions:
    9:30 AM - 11:30 AM EST | 11:30 AM - 1:30 PM EST | 2:30 PM - 4:30 PM EST |
    4:30 PM - 6:30 PM EST. Optional on the form (158 filled). Copied to
    Lead.Training_Schedule__c and used when placing the candidate into a
    training cohort.

Position_Type_Full_Time_CTH__c (Position Type Full Time CTH) [Checkbox]
    Candidate is open to Full-Time / Contract-to-Hire positions. One of two
    position-type checkboxes on the form (both may be true). True on 196
    records - nearly every submitter ticks it. Copied to the Lead.

Position_Type_C2C__c (Position Type C2C) [Checkbox]
    Candidate is open to Corp-to-Corp (C2C) contract positions. True on 56
    records. Copied to the Lead.

--- GROUP E: DECLARATIONS & COMMENTS -----------------------------------------

Criminal_Record_Declaration__c (Criminal Record Declaration) [Picklist]
    Self-declaration required on the form: "I do Not have any criminal
    record" | "I have a criminal record". Matters for background checks and
    client placements later. In data all 127 answered records say "no
    record"; nobody has declared a record so far. Copied to
    Lead.Criminal_Record_Declaration__c.

Acknowledgement_Declaration__c (Acknowledgement Declaration) [Checkbox]
    The "I confirm the information is accurate / I agree" tick at the end of
    the form - the candidate cannot submit without it, so it is true on
    exactly the 204 submitted records. Set by the guest flow.

Additional_Comments_or_Questions__c (Additional Comments or Questions)
[LongTextArea]
    Free-text box for anything else the candidate wants to say. KNOWN GAP:
    the public form displays an "Additional Comments" box but the guest flow
    never saves it into this field, so via the normal path it stays empty
    (the sync flow would copy it to the Lead if it ever had a value). Only
    manual entry by staff fills it today. (Population not queryable via
    SOQL - long text.)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 333, created 2026-04-05 to 2026-08-04 - the feature is only
  about four months old and actively used.
- Status: Submitted 204 (61%) | Expired 99 (30%) | Opened 27 (8%) | Sent 2 |
  Cancelled 1 | Draft 0 (never used).
- Funnel: 333 sent -> 186 opened (56%) -> 204 submitted (61% - some old
  records show Submitted without an Opened_On stamp).
- Lead__c on 324 (97%); 163 Leads carry the reverse Pre_Enrolment_Request__c
  pointer (some leads were sent/submitted more than one form).
- Answers on the 204 submitted forms: Niche - AI ML Engineer 130, Other 30,
  Python 16, Java Fullstack 15, Product/PM 10, Finance 3. Visa - OPT 142,
  STEM OPT 36, H1B 13, CPT 8, US Citizen 3, GC EAD 1, GC/PR 1. Relocation -
  "anywhere in USA" 151 of 166 answered. Position type - Full Time/CTH 196,
  C2C 56. Criminal record - all 127 answered say "no record".
- Training schedule filled on 158; middle name on only 10.
- Effectively unused fields: Current_State_in_USA__c (0), Status "Draft" (0),
  Relocation_Other__c (2), Additional_Comments_or_Questions__c (not saved by
  the form - see Group E).
- Candidate__c does NOT exist in the preprod org yet (source-only field).
- Key takeaway: this is a healthy, live intake funnel feeding the Lead ->
  candidate pipeline; the audience is almost entirely AI/ML-focused OPT
  students willing to relocate.

================================================================================
OBJECT: Education_History__c  (Label: "Education History")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Education_History__c records ONE education entry of a candidate - one degree
at one institute (e.g. "Master's, ABC University, USA, 2023-2025, CGPA 3.6").
A candidate with a bachelor's from India and a master's from the USA has two
records. The records are captured from the candidate themselves on the public
pre-enrolment form (see Pre_Enrolment_Request__c): the form's education step
loops "Add another?" so the candidate can enter any number of entries, each
picking a degree type, institute country, institute and course from curated
master lists plus dates and CGPA. The data exists to (a) profile the
candidate for training/marketing and (b) feed onboarding and background
verification later - the Onboarding__c object points back at these records to
say which institute is being verified.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, part of the candidate-profile / onboarding domain.
- Standalone object (no master-detail); lookups to Lead, Account (candidate),
  Institute__c, Course__c and Onboarding__c. Records start life attached to a
  Lead and are re-parented to the candidate Person Account at conversion.
- Sharing model Public Read/Write internally, Private for external users.
- 12 custom fields, 0 record types, 0 validation rules, 0 list views.
- Auto-number Name in the format EDU-XXXX.
- Field history tracking enabled; two Lightning record pages exist
  (Education_History_Record_Page and Education_History_Record_Page5 - the
  "5" version is the active view override).
- Access via the Sales, Bench Marketing and Customer Success permission sets;
  the guest form writes records in system mode.
- Scale: 0 records in preprod as of this snapshot (see part 9).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. All education entries are the same shape; Degree_Type__c distinguishes
the level of study.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - CREATION FROM THE PRE-ENROLMENT FORM. On the public Guest_Pre_
  Enrolment screen flow (Techsara Candidate Hub site, guest user, system
  mode), after the personal-details page the candidate reaches "Enter
  Education Details". For each entry they pick Degree Type and Institute
  Country; the flow then offers only ACTIVE Institute__c records of that
  country and ACTIVE Course__c records; the candidate adds start/end dates
  and CGPA/score. An "Add Another?" decision loops back for more entries.
  On final submit the flow bulk-creates all entries with Lead__c set to the
  lead behind the pre-enrolment request. The candidate never logs in - this
  is the same tokenized single-use link as the pre-enrolment form.

STEP 2 - RE-PARENTING AT LEAD CONVERSION. When the lead becomes a candidate,
  Lead_Conversion_Flow's "Update Education History" element finds every
  Education_History__c with Lead__c = the converting lead and stamps
  Candidate__c with the new Person Account Id. From then on the education
  records hang off the candidate and appear on the candidate's record page
  related lists.

STEP 3 - ONBOARDING / BACKGROUND VERIFICATION. The onboarding intake flow
  (Onboarding_Candidate_Intake_1, the candidate-facing onboarding form) looks
  up the candidate's existing education records, and the Onboarding__c object
  carries two lookups BACK to this object - Institute__c ("Onboardings
  (Institute)") and Institute_Country__c - so an onboarding record can point
  at the specific education entry whose institute is being used/verified
  (e.g. for the background check / I-20 / degree verification). In preprod
  data neither lookup is populated yet (0 of 771 onboardings) - the wiring
  exists but is not yet in live use.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOKUPS FROM THIS OBJECT:
- Lead (Lead__c): the pre-conversion prospect who submitted the education
  entry on the public form. Set at creation by the guest flow.
- Account (Candidate__c): the candidate Person Account - stamped by
  Lead_Conversion_Flow at conversion (re-parenting from Lead to Account).
- Institute__c (Institute__c): which school/university, from the org's
  curated institute master list (institutes carry a Country and an Active
  flag; the form only offers active ones matching the chosen country).
- Course__c (Course__c): the course/program studied, chosen from the org's
  Course__c master list (only Active__c = true courses are offered). NOTE:
  Course__c is the same object the training/LMS layer uses for Techsara's
  own courses - it does double duty as the education-course master here.
- Onboarding__c (Onboarding__c): optional link tying this education entry to
  a specific onboarding case. No active flow populates it (the onboarding
  intake only reads education records) - manual/future use, verify with
  team.

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT THIS OBJECT:
- Onboarding__c.Institute__c (lookup, relationship "Onboardings (Institute)"):
  the onboarding's chosen institute-of-record - points at ONE education
  entry, not at Institute__c directly.
- Onboarding__c.Institute_Country__c (lookup, relationship "Onboardings"):
  second onboarding pointer, named after the country but actually a lookup
  to an education entry. Both are 0% populated in preprod so far.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
None. Data quality relies on the guest form's required inputs and its
filtered picklists (active institutes of the chosen country, active courses).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
No record-triggered flows, no Apex triggers, no quick actions and no
scheduled jobs run ON this object. It is written by two screen flows that
belong to other processes:
- Guest_Pre_Enrolment (public pre-enrolment form): CREATES the records - one
  per education entry the candidate adds - with Lead__c, Degree_Type__c,
  Institute_Country__c, Institute__c, Course__c, Start/End dates and CGPA.
- Lead_Conversion_Flow (the Lead "Convert" path): UPDATES Candidate__c on all
  of a lead's education records when the lead is converted.
- Onboarding_Candidate_Intake_1 (candidate onboarding form): READS the
  candidate's education records (lookup only; creates/updates nothing here).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 12, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: WHOSE EDUCATION (LINKS) -----------------------------------------

Candidate__c (Candidate) [Lookup -> Account]
    The candidate (Person Account) this education entry belongs to - empty at
    creation and stamped by Lead_Conversion_Flow when the lead converts. The
    field reports use once the candidate exists.

Lead__c (Lead) [Lookup -> Lead]
    The original Lead who submitted the entry on the public pre-enrolment
    form - set at creation by the Guest_Pre_Enrolment flow, and the key the
    conversion flow uses to find records to re-parent. Stays filled after
    conversion (both links coexist).

Onboarding__c (Onboarding) [Lookup -> Onboarding__c]
    Optional link to the onboarding case this education entry supports (e.g.
    the degree being verified during background check). No automation sets
    it today (not fully documented - verify with team).

--- GROUP B: WHAT WAS STUDIED & WHERE ----------------------------------------

Institute__c (Institute) [Lookup -> Institute__c]
    The school/university, chosen on the form from the Institute__c master
    list - the form only offers institutes that are Active and match the
    chosen Institute Country. Using a master list (instead of free text)
    keeps institute names deduplicated for verification work.

Institute_Name__c (Institute Name) [Formula, Text]
    Convenience formula showing the linked institute's name (blank when no
    institute is linked): IF(ISBLANK(Institute__c), "", Institute__r.Name).
    NOTE: this field is NOT yet deployed to the preprod org - it exists in
    source metadata only.

Institute_Country__c (Institute Country) [Picklist, global set "Country"]
    Which country the institute is in: India | USA (the global value set has
    only these two - the business cares mainly about "US degree vs Indian
    degree"). Chosen by the candidate first; it filters the institute list.

Course__c (Course) [Lookup -> Course__c]
    The course/program studied, picked from the active rows of the Course__c
    master list. (Course__c is shared with the training/LMS domain, so the
    same object holds both Techsara training courses and academic courses.)

Degree_Type__c (Degree Type) [Picklist, global set "Degree_Type"]
    The level of study: Diploma | Bachelor's | Master's | PhD. This is the
    field the guest form actually asks for and is the CURRENT degree-level
    field.

Degree__c (Degree) [Picklist, global set "Degree"]
    An older/parallel degree-level picklist: Bachelors | Masters | Diploma |
    PhD | Undergraduates | Graduates. NOT used by the guest form and not
    referenced by any flow - appears to be a legacy duplicate of
    Degree_Type__c (not fully documented - verify with team).

--- GROUP C: WHEN & HOW WELL -------------------------------------------------

Start_Date__c (Start Date) [Date]
    When the candidate started this program - entered on the guest form.

End_Date__c (End Date) [Date]
    When the program ended / graduation date - entered on the guest form.
    For US degrees this matters for OPT timing.

CGPA_Score__c (CGPA / Score) [Number(6,2)]
    The grade the candidate reported for this program (CGPA, GPA or
    percentage - the field accepts up to 9999.99 so any scale fits).
    Self-reported on the guest form; verified later during background
    checks.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. REAL DATA SNAPSHOT (preprod, queried 2026-08-12)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Total records: 0. The object is fully deployed (minus the Institute_Name__c
  formula field, which is source-only) and wired into three active flows,
  but no education entries exist in preprod yet.
- This is notable because 204 pre-enrolment forms HAVE been submitted in
  preprod: either the education step was added to the guest form after the
  last submission (2026-08-04), or submissions with education data have not
  happened in this sandbox - verify with team which it is.
- Consequently every distribution (degree type, country, institute) is empty,
  and the two Onboarding__c lookups back to this object are also unused
  (0 of 771 onboarding records point at an education entry).
- Key takeaway for answering questions: treat this object as "built and
  ready, no live data yet" - describe its intended flow (public form ->
  lead -> conversion re-parenting -> onboarding verification) rather than
  citing real records.

PART 7: ONBOARDING & HR
################################################################################
################################################################################

================================================================================
OBJECT: Onboarding__c  (Label: "Onboarding")
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. WHAT THIS OBJECT IS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Onboarding__c is the checklist-and-data-capture record for bringing a NEWLY
ENROLLED CANDIDATE into Techsara's career service. One record = one candidate's
onboarding journey: welcome call -> service agreement signed -> full personal /
immigration / education / work-history data collected (via an emailed,
token-secured web form) -> ATS-optimized resume created and approved -> hand-off
to the candidate-marketing (bench marketing) team.

Important nuance: despite the word "onboarding", this is NOT onboarding into an
employer after a job offer - it is onboarding into TECHSARA'S OWN SERVICE, and
it happens at the very START of the candidate lifecycle. A record is created
automatically the moment a candidate Person Account is created. The record
doubles as the candidate's master intake questionnaire, which is why it is so
wide (155 fields): it stores everything the candidate tells us about
themselves, including up to five education entries and five past jobs used as
raw material for resume creation. The Customer Success / onboarding team works
these records (see the "Customer Success Onboarding" list view).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. KIND OF OBJECT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Custom object, part of the candidate-intake / training domain.
- Standalone object with its own Owner. Lookup (NOT master-detail) to Account
  via Account__c "Candidate Name" - 99% populated but technically optional.
- Sharing model: Public Read/Write (everyone can see and edit onboardings).
- Field history tracking is enabled on the object.
- 155 custom fields, 2 record types, 5 validation rules (4 active), 4 list
  views (All, Customer Success Onboarding, Initial Stage, Onboarding Not
  Completed).
- Auto-number Name "OnBoarding Name" in the format OB-XXXX (e.g. OB-1032).
- Scale: 771 records in preprod (Aug 2024 to today); roughly one per enrolled
  candidate.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. RECORD TYPES (2)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- "Active" (developer name: Active) - the working type for candidates currently
  in or through onboarding; 658 records (85%). Sets picklist defaults (e.g.
  Candidate Time Zone defaults to UTC) and restricts some of the education
  Degree picklists to Bachelors/Masters. No description in metadata.
- "Inactive" (Inactive) - candidates whose onboarding was paused / who went
  inactive; only 12 records. The "Change Record Type" button is on the layout,
  and the Pause Onboarding flow drives the inactive path.
- NOTE: 101 older records (13%) have NO record type at all - they were created
  before record types were added to the object. Treat "no record type" as
  legacy-Active when reporting.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW IT IS USED - THE BUSINESS PROCESS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 - AUTO-CREATION AT ENROLLMENT. When a candidate Person Account is
  created (usually by Lead conversion), the record-triggered flow
  Create_Onboarding_from_Account_1 automatically creates the Onboarding record.
  It copies ~20 enrollment fields from the Account onto it (plan, upfront
  amount, salary percentage, offer letter amount, work authorization + expiry,
  passport number, phone/email/secondary contacts, WhatsApp, LinkedIn URL,
  niche, industry, billing address, years of experience, degree info), sets the
  initial Status, emails a "new candidate" welcome message and posts a Slack
  notification. Users almost never create Onboarding records by hand.

STEP 2 - WELCOME CALL. The onboarding owner runs the welcome call (the
  Welcome_Script__c field holds the script/notes). Sessions booked for the
  candidate can link back via Session__c.Onboarding__c.

STEP 3 - SERVICE AGREEMENT. On creation, the flow Onboarding_Service_Agreement_
  Email_Slack_Notification emails the service agreement to the candidate and
  notifies Slack. The "Send Services Agreement" button on the record page runs
  a DocuSign envelope send (dfsle managed package); a PandaDoc panel is also
  embedded on the record page for document generation/e-sign. When
  Service_Agreement_Signed__c is checked, the flow Onboarding_Alert_after_
  Service_Agreement_signed posts a Slack alert. A validation rule blocks moving
  the Status to "Resume Creation" until the agreement is signed.

STEP 4 - CANDIDATE DATA COLLECTION (THE ONBOARDING FORM). The "Send Onboarding
  Form" button runs Onboarding_Send_Candidate_Onboarding_form: the generic
  CreateToken Apex action generates a secure token, an Onboarding_Token__c
  record is created (link, recipient email, expiry, form status - see the
  Onboarding_Token__c section), and the candidate is emailed the link. The
  candidate opens the token link and fills the guest-facing screen flow
  Onboarding:Candidate Intake-1 (Onboarding_Candidate_Intake_1) - a ~10-screen
  form capturing personal details, immigration/work-authorization data, EEO
  self-identification, education history (also written to Education_History__c
  child records), and past work experience. The form updates the token's
  status and the record's Latest_Onboarding_Status__c. Whenever key candidate
  fields change on the Onboarding record, the flow Update_Candidate_
  Information_from_Onboarding syncs them back to the candidate Account (every
  mapped field except the two password fields, which are encrypted).

STEP 5 - RESUME CREATION. The resume team builds an ATS-optimized resume from
  the collected education/work-history data. Supporting fields: Technology_For_
  Resume__c, Resume_Creation_Notes__c, ATS_Score__c (a now-DEACTIVATED rule
  used to require a score of at least 75 before completion). The "Create
  Resume Request" button emails the resume request to the team. Both
  Internal_Approval__c and Candidate_Approval__c must be obtained - candidate
  approval is enforced by an active validation rule. LinkedIn profile
  optimization is tracked with LinkedIn_Optimization__c.

STEP 6 - COMPLETION AND HAND-OFF TO MARKETING. Status cannot be typed to
  "Onboarding Completed" directly - a validation rule forces users through the
  "Complete Onboarding" button (screen flow Onboarding_Complete_Onboarding).
  The flow checks/creates the candidate's Marketing__c engagement record (the
  hand-off to the bench-marketing team), flips the hidden Flow_Only_Field__c
  to satisfy the validation rule, and posts a Slack notification. 90% of all
  records have reached "Onboarding Completed".

PAUSE PATH: the "Pause Onboarding" button (flow Onboarding_record_Inactive)
  marks the record Inactive with a reason and simultaneously puts the
  candidate Account on hold (Candidate_Status__c + Reason_for_Hold__c).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. CONNECTED OBJECTS (what each relationship means)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOOKUPS FROM ONBOARDING TO OTHER OBJECTS:
- Account (Account__c, label "Candidate Name"): the candidate (Person Account)
  being onboarded. 99% populated. Data flows BOTH ways: the creation flow
  copies Account fields onto the onboarding, and the update-sync flow pushes
  onboarding edits back to the Account.
- Course__c (Course_Name__c): which training course the candidate is tied to.
  Referenced by the intake form flow but NEVER populated in data (0 records).
- Institute__c (Institutes__c, label "Institute"): the institute master record
  for the candidate's school. Never populated (0 records).
- Education_History__c (Institute__c, label "Institute" AND
  Institute_Country__c, label "Institute Country"): two confusingly named
  lookups to the education-history object. Both never populated (0 records) -
  the real education link runs the OTHER way (see below).

OBJECTS THAT POINT AT ONBOARDING (children / references):
- Education_History__c (lookup Education_History__c.Onboarding__c): the
  candidate's education entries created by the intake form - the proper,
  normalized version of the College_Name/Degree 1-5 flat fields.
- Onboarding_Token__c (lookup Onboarding_Token__c.Onboarding__c): the secure
  form-link tokens sent to the candidate (link, expiry, sent/opened/submitted
  status). Documented in its own section - the "Send Onboarding Form" button
  creates these.
- Session__c (lookup Session__c.Onboarding__c): scheduled meetings (welcome
  call, onboarding sessions) booked against this onboarding.
- Case (lookup Case.Onboarding__c): internal ops tickets raised about this
  onboarding.

NOT RELATED (common confusion): Onboarding__c has no link to Job_Requirement,
Job_Submission, Interview, or Background_Check - it is a service-intake
record, not an employer-placement record.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. BUSINESS RULES (validation rules)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Candidate_Approval_Required (active): status cannot be set to "Onboarding
  Completed" unless Candidate_Approval__c is checked. Error (shown on the
  Candidate Approval field): "Get the candidate approval of the resume before
  completion of the onboarding".
- Work_Authorization_Required (active): status cannot be set to "Onboarding
  Completed" while Work_Authorization__c is blank. Error (shown on the Work
  Authorization field): "Get the candidate approval of the resume before
  completion of the onboarding" - NOTE: this message is a copy-paste of the
  previous rule's text; the rule actually requires Work Authorization.
- Onboarding_Completion_Validation (active): users may not type the status to
  "Onboarding Completed" directly; the change is only allowed when the hidden
  Flow_Only_Field__c changed in the same save (which only the Complete
  Onboarding flow does). Error: "The 'Status' field cannot be set to 'Onboard
  Completion' directly. Please use Complete Onboarding button."
- Service_Agreement_Required_Before_Resume (active): status cannot be set to
  "Resume Creation" unless Service_Agreement_Signed__c is checked. Error:
  "Get the Service Agreement signed before starting on the Resume."
- ATS_Score_below_75 (INACTIVE): used to block completion when ATS_Score__c
  was below 75 or empty. Error: "ATS Score needs to be at least 75". The rule
  has been switched off - ATS score is no longer enforced.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. AUTOMATION (what runs on this object)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RECORD-TRIGGERED FLOWS (active):
- Create_Onboarding_from_Account_1 (on Account, after create, candidate record
  type only): THE creation path - auto-creates the Onboarding record for every
  new candidate Person Account, copies ~20 enrollment fields from the Account,
  sends the new-candidate email and a Slack notification (HttpCalloutGeneric).
- Onboarding_Service_Agreement_Email_Slack_Notification (after create, with a
  scheduled path): emails the service agreement to the candidate and posts a
  Slack notification; reads Service_Agreement_Sent__c.
- Onboarding_Alert_after_Service_Agreement_signed (after create/update when
  Service_Agreement_Signed__c is checked, with a scheduled path): Slack alert
  that the agreement came back signed.
- Update_Candidate_Information_from_Onboarding (after update; fires when any
  of ~21 candidate-data fields change): syncs the onboarding data back to the
  candidate Account. Per its own description, every mapped field is synced
  EXCEPT LinkedIn Password and Marketing Email Password (encrypted fields).

SCREEN FLOWS / BUTTONS ON THE RECORD PAGE (Onboarding_Record_Page1):
- Send Onboarding Form -> Onboarding_Send_Candidate_Onboarding_form: generates
  a token (CreateToken Apex), creates the Onboarding_Token__c with link/expiry/
  recipient, emails the candidate the form link.
- Send Services Agreement -> Send_Services_Agreement: sends the DocuSign
  envelope (dfsle managed-package bulk envelope action).
- Create Resume Request -> Onboarding_Send_Email_for_Resume: emails the resume
  request and stamps the record.
- Pause Onboarding -> Onboarding_record_Inactive: marks the onboarding
  Inactive with a reason and puts the candidate Account on hold
  (Candidate_Status__c, Reason_for_Hold__c).
- Complete Onboarding -> Onboarding_Complete_Onboarding: the only allowed way
  to complete; checks for / creates the Marketing__c engagement (hand-off to
  bench marketing), flips Flow_Only_Field__c past the validation rule, Slack
  notification.
- Candidate_Onboarding_Form (quick action -> flow Candidate_Onboarding_Form):
  defined and active but NOT placed on any page - currently unreachable.
- Guest side: Onboarding_Candidate_Intake_1 ("Onboarding:Candidate Intake-1")
  is the candidate-facing intake form behind the token link - it writes the
  candidate's answers onto the record, creates Education_History__c rows, and
  updates the token status and Latest_Onboarding_Status__c.

ALSO ON THE RECORD PAGE: an embedded PandaDoc managed-package panel (document
generation/e-sign), an inline run of the Attached_Resume_To_Lead flow, and a
Path component driving Status__c.

OBSOLETE / DRAFT (exist in metadata, do NOT run): Create_Marketing_record_
from_Onboarding_status_update (obsolete - replaced by the Complete Onboarding
button), Onboarding_Creation_Candidate_Form (obsolete), Onboarding_Reaches_
Resume_Creation_Send_Email_Notifications (obsolete), Onboarding_Candidate_
Intake (draft, superseded by Intake-1), Onboarding_Send_Email_Notifications
(invalid draft).

APEX: no trigger on Onboarding__c and no Apex class references it directly;
the only Apex involved is the generic CreateToken invocable (token generation)
and HttpCalloutGeneric (Slack callouts) called from the flows above.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. FIELDS (all 155, grouped by purpose)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- GROUP A: THE CANDIDATE & LIFECYCLE ----------------------------------------

Account__c (Candidate Name) [Lookup -> Account]
    The candidate (Person Account) being onboarded. Set automatically by the
    creation flow; 99% populated (765/771). The data-sync flow uses this link
    to push onboarding answers back onto the Account.

Status__c (Status) [Picklist]
    THE lifecycle field, driven by the Path on the record page: Welcome Call |
    Service Agreement | Resume Creation | Onboarding Completed | Inactive.
    Guarded by validation rules at every step: Resume Creation needs a signed
    agreement; Onboarding Completed needs candidate approval + work
    authorization and can only be reached via the Complete Onboarding button.
    Real data: Onboarding Completed 696 (90%) | Resume Creation 40 |
    Inactive 21 | Welcome Call 11 | Service Agreement 3.

Inactive_Reason__c (Inactive Reason) [Text]
    Why the onboarding was paused/made inactive - filled by the Pause
    Onboarding flow or manually. 24 records have one.

Flow_Only_Field__c (Flow Only Field) [Checkbox]
    Hidden technical switch: the Onboarding_Completion_Validation rule only
    allows Status = "Onboarding Completed" when this field changed in the same
    save, and only the Complete Onboarding flow flips it. Never touch manually.

OwnerId (Owner) [User]
    Standard owner - the Customer Success / onboarding employee working this
    candidate. On the layout; ownership matters because sharing is Read/Write
    org-wide, so the owner is a work-queue marker more than a security gate.

Owner_Name_Formula__c (Owner Name Formula) [Formula, Text]
    The owner's first + last name as plain text, for reports/list views that
    cannot show the Owner relationship nicely.

Description__c (Description) [LongTextArea]
    General free-form notes about this onboarding.

Notes__c (Notes) [LongTextArea]
    Additional working notes (the layout shows it under "Other information").

--- GROUP B: PROCESS MILESTONE CHECKBOXES -------------------------------------
The onboarding checklist proper - each box records that a step happened. All
are set manually by the onboarding team (none are formula-driven), and the
data shows the funnel: ~94% of records have the form sent, ~88% have an
approved resume, but only ~31% show the marketing hand-off box ticked.

Candidate_form_sent__c (Candidate form sent) [Checkbox]
    The intake form was sent to the candidate. True on 724 records (94%).

Candidate_form_filled__c (Candidate form filled) [Checkbox]
    The candidate returned/completed the intake form. True on 719 (93%).

Service_Agreement_Sent__c (Service Agreement Sent) [Checkbox]
    The service agreement went out (email/DocuSign/PandaDoc). True on 717.
    Read by the service-agreement notification flow.

Service_Agreement_Signed__c (Service Agreement Signed) [Checkbox]
    The candidate signed the service agreement. True on 719 (93%). Checking it
    fires the Slack alert flow; required before Status can reach "Resume
    Creation" (validation rule).

Resume_Created__c (Resume Created) [Checkbox]
    The ATS-optimized resume has been produced. True on 682 (88%).

Internal_Approval__c (Internal Approval) [Checkbox]
    Techsara's internal sign-off on the resume/profile. True on 682.

Candidate_Approval__c (Candidate Approval) [Checkbox]
    The CANDIDATE approved the resume. True on 681. Required before the
    onboarding can be completed (validation rule).

LinkedIn_Optimization__c (LinkedIn Optimization) [Checkbox]
    The candidate's LinkedIn profile was optimized by the team. True on only
    59 records (8%) - either rarely done or rarely recorded.

Assigned_to_Marketing__c (Assigned to Marketing) [Checkbox]
    The candidate has been handed off to the bench-marketing team (a
    Marketing__c engagement exists). True on 241 (31%). The Complete
    Onboarding flow handles the actual Marketing record creation.

Account_information_collected__c (Account information collected) [Checkbox]
    Candidate's account/billing information has been collected. (Exact
    operational meaning not fully documented - verify with team.)

Welcome_Script__c (Welcome Script) [TextArea]
    The welcome-call script/notes used for this candidate's kickoff call.

--- GROUP C: ONBOARDING FORM & TOKEN TRACKING ---------------------------------
Status mirrors of the token-based form pipeline (the tokens themselves are
Onboarding_Token__c child records). The "Latest_*" fields were added to show
the newest form-send state on the record; in preprod data they are almost
entirely empty - the token records carry the real state.

Onboarding_Form_Link__c (Onboarding Form Link) [Url]
    Older field for the candidate's form link. Never populated (0 records) -
    the link now lives on the Onboarding_Token__c record.

Onboarding_Form_Status__c (Onboarding Form Status) [Picklist]
    Older form-status field: Sent | Opened | Draft | Submitted | Expired |
    Cancelled. Populated on exactly 1 record (Cancelled); effectively unused -
    the token's own status field superseded it.

Latest_Onboarding_Form_Link__c (Latest Onboarding Form Link) [Url]
    Link of the most recently sent form. Empty on all records so far.

Latest_Onboarding_Sent_On__c (Latest Onboarding Sent On) [DateTime]
Latest_Onboarding_Opened_On__c (Latest Onboarding Opened On) [DateTime]
Latest_Onboarding_On__c (Latest Onboarding  On) [DateTime]
    Timestamps of the latest form send / open / (submission). All empty in
    preprod data today - built for the newest form pipeline, not yet writing.

Latest_Onboarding_Status__c (Latest Onboarding Status) [Text]
    Short text status of the newest form send, updated by the candidate
    intake flow (Onboarding_Candidate_Intake_1). Populated on 98 records -
    the only "Latest" field actually in use.

Candidate_Form_Additional_Details__c (Candidate Form Additional Details)
[LongTextArea]
    Free-text catch-all the candidate can leave on the intake form ("anything
    else we should know").

Declaration__c (I confirm that all the above information) [Checkbox]
    The candidate's accuracy declaration on the intake form. Help text: "I
    confirm that all the above information provided is accurate. Any
    information which is wrong may result in termination of my services."
    True on 95 records (newer form submissions only).

I_confirm_that_all_the_above_information__c (I confirm that all the above
information) [Checkbox]
    Duplicate of Declaration__c from an earlier form version - same label,
    kept for old data. New automation uses Declaration__c.

Start_Time__c (Start Time) [Picklist, global value set "Times"]
End_Time__c (End Time) [Picklist, global value set "Times"]
    A start/end time pair from the shared org-wide time-slot list (same set
    the Interview object uses). Not placed on the layout; most likely the
    candidate's daily availability window or welcome-call slot from an older
    form version (not fully documented - verify with team).

--- GROUP D: SERVICE PLAN & COMMERCIALS ---------------------------------------
What the candidate signed up to pay. All of these are copied from the
candidate Account at creation and synced back on change.

Plan__c (Plan) [Picklist]
    The service package the candidate enrolled in: Career Launcher | Career
    Accelerator | Premium / Fastrack | Ultimate Career Architect. Real data:
    Career Accelerator on 680 records (88%) - effectively everyone; Premium /
    Fastrack 5, Ultimate Career Architect 3, Career Launcher 0 (never used),
    83 blank.

Upfront_Amount__c (Upfront Amount) [Number]
    The upfront payment amount for the plan. Populated on 678 records (88%).

Offer_letter_amount__c (Offer letter amount) [Number]
    Amount tied to the candidate's (future) offer letter - the salary basis
    the success-fee part of the agreement is calculated on. Populated on 678
    records. (Exact contractual meaning - verify with team.)

Salary__c (Salary) [Percent]
    A PERCENT field despite the plain "Salary" label - the percentage-of-
    salary component of the candidate's fee agreement (income-share style).
    Populated on 678 records, copied from the Account at creation.

Salary_Expectations__c (Salary Expectations (Old Field)) [Text]
    LEGACY free-text salary expectation. Label says "(Old Field)"; replaced by
    the picklist below but still synced by the update flow for old data.

Salary_Expectations_Picklist__c (Salary Expectations) [Picklist]
    The candidate's target salary band: $60,000 - $80,000 | $80,000 -
    $120,000 | $120,000 - $160,000 | $160,000 - $200,000 | $200,000 +.
    Captured on the intake form; guides which roles marketing targets.

--- GROUP E: CONTACT & PERSONAL IDENTITY --------------------------------------
Collected on the intake form; key fields sync to the candidate Account.

Candidate_Email__c (Candidate Email) [Email]
    The candidate's primary email. 96% populated (744). Used as the send-to
    address for the agreement/form emails.

Secondary_Email__c (Secondary Email) [Email]
    Backup email. 51 records.

Phone__c (Phone) [Phone]
    Primary phone. 95% populated (736).

Secondary_Phone__c (Secondary Phone) [Phone]
    Backup phone number.

WhatsApp_Number__c (WhatsApp Number) [Phone]
    The candidate's WhatsApp contact (much of the candidate base communicates
    on WhatsApp). 92 records.

Date_of_Birth__c (Date of Birth) [Date]
    Candidate's date of birth (62% populated) - needed for background checks
    and some employer forms later in the journey.

Last_4_digits_of_SSN__c (Last 4 digits of SSN) [Number]
    Last four digits of the candidate's US Social Security Number - collected
    for job applications that require it. Only 30 records (sensitive; rarely
    captured).

Passport_Number__c (Passport Number) [Text]
    Passport number - identity anchor for international candidates; marked
    REQUIRED on the page layout. Populated on 432 records (56%).

Current_Address__c (Current Address) [Address]
    The candidate's current home address (full compound address field).

Billing_Address__c (Billing Address) [Text]
    Billing address as plain text, copied from the Account's billing address
    by the creation flow.

Shipping_Address__c (Shipping Address) [Text]
    Shipping/mailing address as plain text (rarely relevant; legacy).

Candidate_Time_Zone__c (Candidate Time Zone) [Picklist, global value set
"Candidate_Time_Zone"]
    Which timezone the candidate lives in: ET | PT | CT | MT | HT | AT | UTC
    (record-type default) | IST. Drives when the team schedules calls.

--- GROUP F: EEO SELF-IDENTIFICATION ------------------------------------------
US-style Equal Employment Opportunity questions collected on the intake form
so job applications can be filled out on the candidate's behalf. Synced to the
candidate Account by the update flow.

Gender__c (Gender) [Picklist]
    Male | Female | I_choose_not_to_disclose.

Race_Ethnicity__c (Race/Ethnicity) [Picklist]
    American Indian or Alaska Native | Asian | Black or African American |
    Hispanic or Latino | Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander | Two or
    More Races | Other (please specify) | I choose not to disclose.

Other_please_specify__c (Other (please specify)) [Text]
    Free-text companion when Race/Ethnicity = "Other (please specify)".

Disability_Status__c (Disability Status) [Picklist]
    Yes, I have a disability or previously had a disability | No, I do not

Military_Status__c (Military Status) [Picklist]
    Active Duty | Reserve or National Guard | Veteran | Retired Military |
    Military Spouse | No Military Service | Prefer not to say.

--- GROUP G: WORK AUTHORIZATION & IMMIGRATION ---------------------------------
The candidate base is largely international students/workers in the US, so
immigration status is core data - it decides which jobs the candidate can
legally take.

Work_Authorization__c (Work Authorization) [Picklist, global value set
"Work_Authorization_Picklist"]
    THE current work-authorization field: CPT | OPT | H1B | H4 | Green Card |
    USC | Other | OPT - Initial | OPT -  STEM. REQUIRED before onboarding can
    complete (validation rule). Populated on 648 records (84%); real data is
    dominated by OPT (575 - i.e. recent international graduates), then USC 21,
    H1B 17, Green Card 14, H4 11, CPT 5, Other 5.

Work_Authorization_Expiry_Date__c (Work Authorization Expiry Date) [Date]
    When the authorization (e.g. the OPT EAD card) expires - drives urgency:
    the candidate must be placed before this date.

Visa_Status__c (Visa Status) [Picklist]
    OLDER visa-status field: F1 | H1-B | CPT | OPT-EAD | H4-EAD | Green_Card |
    US_Citizen | Other. Populated on 413 records, mostly legacy (OPT-EAD 275,
    F1 108); a few records hold out-of-list values ("Green Card", "US
    Citizen") from data loads. New work goes in Work_Authorization__c.

Active_CPT__c (Active CPT?) [Checkbox]
    The candidate is currently on CPT (Curricular Practical Training - i.e.
    still enrolled at a university). True on 71 records.

Authorized_To_Work_In_US__c (Authorized To Work In US?) [Checkbox]
    Blanket "can legally work in the US" flag from the intake form.

Sponsorship_Required_For_VISA__c (Sponsorship Required For VISA?) [Checkbox]
    The candidate will need employer visa sponsorship (e.g. an H1B transfer) -
    limits which employers marketing can target.

Mention_your_Visa_dates_if_applicable__c (Mention your Visa dates if
applicable) [Text]
    Free-text visa validity dates as the candidate wrote them on the form.

Date_of_Arrival__c (Date of Arrival) [Date]
    Date the candidate arrived in the US. Never populated (0 records) - the
    free-text field below is what actually gets filled.

When_did_you_move_to_USA__c (When did you move to USA) [Text]
    Free-text answer to "when did you move to the USA". 442 records (57%).

--- GROUP H: LINKEDIN & MARKETING IDENTITY ------------------------------------
Techsara's marketing team operates the candidate's professional identity on
their behalf (applying to jobs as the candidate), so it stores the account
credentials the candidate shares. Handle with care - this is sensitive data.

LinkedIn_Profile_URL__c (LinkedIn Profile URL) [Url]
    The candidate's LinkedIn profile address (copied from the Account by the
    creation flow).

Linkedin_URL__c (Linkedin URL) [Url]
    Second LinkedIn URL field (the one the creation and sync flows map to the
    Account). 114 records. Two URL fields exist for historic reasons - check
    both when looking for the profile.

LinkedIn_Email_Id__c (LinkedIn Email Id) [Email]
    The email address the candidate's LinkedIn account is registered under.

LinkedIn_Username__c (LinkedIn Username) [Text]
    LinkedIn login username.

LinkedIn_Password__c (LinkedIn Password) [EncryptedText]
    LinkedIn login password, stored ENCRYPTED (masked from most users).
    Deliberately excluded from the Account sync flow because encrypted fields
    cannot be flow-copied.

LinkedIn_Password_Updated__c (LinkedIn Password Updated) [Text]
    Free-text note of when/whether the password was changed (e.g. after the
    engagement ends).

Marketing_Email_Id__c (Marketing Email Id) [Text]
    The dedicated email address created/used for marketing this candidate
    (job applications are sent from it). 432 records (56%).

Marketing_Email_Password__c (Marketing Email Password) [Text]
    Password for that marketing mailbox - stored as PLAIN text (unlike the
    LinkedIn password; a known data-hygiene risk). Excluded from Account sync.

Professional_Profiles__c (Professional Profiles) [LongTextArea]
    Other professional links (GitHub, portfolio, Indeed, etc.) as free text.

--- GROUP K: WORK HISTORY FOR RESUME CREATION (FLAT 1-5 REPEATS) --------------
Up to five past jobs captured on the intake form - the raw material the
resume team writes the resume from (the layout labels these sections "Work
Experience 1-4 (for resume creation)"). Sparsely used in data: company 1 on
44 records, company 2 on 40, company 3 on 23, company 4 on 15, company 5 on 0.

Work_Experiene__c (Work Experience) [LongTextArea]
    Free-text overall work-experience narrative (note the typo in the API
    name - "Experiene"). The catch-all next to the structured slots below.

Company_name_1__c / company_name_2__c / company_name_3__c / Company_Name_4__c /
Company_Name_5__c (Company name 1-5) [Text]
    Employer name for jobs 1-5 (note the inconsistent capitalization of the
